en: The product is a device for: - cashless payment of parking, ski, or other access cards or fees; - reading (RAD or barcode) parking tickets, parking refunds, Print@Home barcodes from paper or displays; - issuing lost parking tickets, ski and event tickets, or similar; - equipped with a 230/120 V connection terminal, Windows-based operating system on an Intel i3 processor board, SSD storage/drive, and a 15" LCD display; - suitable for outdoor use, IP43 protection; - temperature range +45°C to -40°C, depending on installation and heating option; - weight approx. 25 kg (+25 kg for the pedestal if used). (Information provided by the applicant, see attached image)

Other insecticides, rodenticides, fungicides, herbicides, sprout inhibitors and plant growth regulators, disinfectants and similar products, in the form of a brown, viscous liquid; the product is used – according to the company – as a seed dressing for bird deterrence in maize; packaged in 1000 L IBCs.

Other plastic goods in the form of an orange bicycle inner tube with a valve, neither reinforced nor combined with other materials; in various dimensions for different types of bicycles; not a part or accessory of heading HS 8714. (see illustration) (Information provided by the company)

Other parts for mowing machines, in the form of a retrofit kit (conversion kit), consisting of: 5 x sprockets (various sizes), 1 x adjusting hub, 2 x sleeves, 1 x spacer sleeve, 1 x drill sleeve, 1 x chain lubrication, 1 x hose, 2 x plates, 1 x ring, 2 x roller chains (various sizes), 2 x end links, 6 x deep groove ball bearings, 1 x key, 6 x retaining rings, 10 x screws (various sizes), 15 x washers (various sizes), 2 x hydraulic hoses (various sizes), 1 x adjustable T-fitting, 4 x clamping jaws, 1 x 2-way valve, 1 x threadlocker, 1 x spare parts label, 1 x mini-grip bag, 1 x assembly instructions; the retrofit kit (conversion kit) consists mainly of metallic components and is used for retrofitting and repairing mowing machines; Mostly packaged in a folding carton; the chain lubrication assembly is supplied separately. (Information provided by the company) (see illustration)

A mechanical connector for modular frames. It works with an integrated tensioning and locking mechanism to connect and secure these frames. There is a locking lever on one side. These frames can form all kinds of temporary or permanent structures, including walls, presentation rooms, meeting rooms, exhibition stands, etc. It has a length of approximately 161 mm and a diameter between 30 and 38 mm. The product has 3 different settings and a weight of approximately 280 g.

According to the description, this concerns various photo or print frames, the frame itself of which consists of a synthetic wood composite. The frames can be used for a single print or photo, but also for multiple photos or prints. A passe-partout may be present to serve as a decorative border for a small photo or for subdivision to accommodate multiple photos. This subdivision can also be created using various smaller frames/profiles made of synthetic wood composite. The frames come in various dimensions, thicknesses, and colors. The front of the frames features plexiglass or plain glass to protect the photo or print. The back consists of MDF, secured with metal clamps. Hooks may or may not be attached to the MDF, allowing the frame to be hung. In some cases, a type of MDF "foot" is also attached, allowing the frame to simply be placed on a piece of furniture.

Round cutting and grinding discs, manufactured from agglomerated synthetic abrasives, bonded with phenolic resin and reinforced with glass fibers. The abrasives consist primarily of aluminum oxide (corundum). The discs have a diameter ranging from 115 to 230 mm and a bore of 22.2 to 25.4 mm. The thickness of the discs varies from 1 to 6.3 mm. They are used for grinding and cutting various metals using electrically or non-electrically powered (hand) tools.

A synthetic preparation containing no petroleum or oil from bituminous minerals, offered in the form of an aqueous solution in packaging of 1 l, 5 l, or 25 l. The sprayable product is specially suitable for preventing the adhesion of welding spatter to metal workpieces, so that it does not need to be chipped off or ground away after welding. The preparation has a long-lasting anti-stick effect, is non-toxic, non-explosive, non-flammable, and non-carcinogenic. The preparation is also rust- and corrosion-resistant. It improves welded joints and weld seams.
A plastic music stand that can be attached to a digital piano using an adapter. The adapter is not part of this BTI. Dimensions: 50 cm x 21.5 cm x 4.8 cm.

According to the declared data, this is a liquid meat flavoring, which consists of a mixture of chemical aromatic substances dissolved in sunflower oil. Appearance: clear oily liquid of light yellow color. Aroma of roasted pork. Packaging: PE bottles.

According to the declared data and the submitted photo documentation, it is a foil (film) made of polyvinyl chloride (PVC). The foil is flexible (elastic), not lightweight, not reinforced, not laminated, not reinforced or otherwise combined with other materials, not printed, wound in a roll. Its thickness does not exceed 1 mm, the content of plasticizers is approximately 30% by weight. It serves as a protection for food and dishes against spoilage and external influences (insects, dirt); it is intended for direct contact with food. Dimensions 29 cm x 300 m – 50 cm x 1500 m.

According to the declared data, this is a heating element that is part of the HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) system of a passenger car. The product is used to heat the air (heating) in the vehicle interior and also serves to demist or defrost the windshield. The heat source is warm air from the vehicle engine. Material: aluminum alloy.

According to the information provided, this is a four-wheeled electric wheelchair for people with limited mobility. The wheelchair has adjustable armrests (armrests), which can be easily folded out and made comfortable to sit on, and it also includes a cane holder. The wheelchair is equipped with a separate adjustable (folding) steering column, on which the control panel is located and the basket is also attached. It is equipped with a reverse gear and when the electric drive is turned off, the wheelchair can also be pushed in front of you. It can be folded to facilitate transport. Technical parameters: — engine power: 350 W; — battery: Lithium 36 V 12 Ah; — charger: 40 V 2 A; — load capacity: 120 kg; — dimensions: 99 x 55 x 85 cm; — tire size: front 9", rear 10"; — max. speed: 10 km/h; — range: 40 km; — brake: electromagnetic; — angle of climb: 15°; — display: LED.

According to the declared data, this is an adjustable stop for the fifth door (trunk lid) of a passenger car. The product is made of a combination of plastic and rubber, with the plastic part prevailing and the rubber forming a stop "cap". The adjustability of the stop is ensured by a threaded or snap-in mechanism. The product is used to define the clearance and gaps of the door, helps align the door with the vehicle body, reduces vibrations and unwanted knocking, absorbs shocks when closing and protects the lock mechanism. The product is not intended for industrial assembly. Material: PP - GF30 / EPDM.

According to the declared data, this is a digital camera for use in a car. The camera is intended for recording audio and video while driving. It is not equipped with its own internal memory, the recordings are stored on an SD card. The product consists of an image sensor, lens, speaker, microphone, 2.45" LCD display, video and audio signal electronics, control buttons, memory card slot and USB slot, lithium polymer battery with a capacity of 200 mAh and a plastic body. The package includes a camera measuring 47 x 74 x 39 mm, a magnetic holder with a GPS module, a car cigarette lighter adapter with an extra USB port, a microSD card reader, cable holders, a spare 3M sticker for the holder and a manual with safety instructions.

According to the declared data, these are halogen lamps with tungsten filament. The lamps are part of photocopying equipment, where they are used to transfer heat to paper and harden the print (ink). The lamps are equipped with ceramic caps at the ends and cables with plastic terminals with contacts for connection to the electrical network. Lamp dimensions 8 x 396 mm or 8.5 x 422 mm. Designed for 230 V voltage.

According to the information provided, it is a silicon chip. An electrical circuit, the essence of which is semiconductor resistors connected as a so-called Wheatstone bridge (measuring principle: when the chip is deflected, the resistance changes and thus the bridge is balanced; the change in resistance is proportional to the deflection, which is proportional to the change in pressure). The product contains only passive elements (resistors); it cannot convert the electrical output into pressure data and is not even able to display pressure. Composition: silicon and microscopic metal contacts. The chips do not exceed 20 W, with a maximum power of up to 1 W.

According to the declared data, this is a treat for dogs; a chewy treat in the shape of small sticks (a white stick base made of beef hide wrapped in dried chicken meat). The product is intended for direct consumption by animals as a reward or treat (not intended for human consumption). Ingredients: chicken meat 65%, beef hide 30%, rice starch 5% (serves as a technological binder for fixing the meat layer to the rawhide base). The product contains less than 10% by weight of starch, but does not contain any dairy products. The finished products are packaged for retail sale, packed in plastic bags and then placed in cartons intended for distribution.

According to the declared data, this is a treat for dogs; a treat (treat) made mainly from chicken meat in the shape of small flat wheels (discs). The treats are intended as a reward during training or as a treat between feedings. Ingredients: chicken meat 97%, corn starch 2% as a binder, glycerin 1% humectant to maintain a semi-soft structure. The product contains less than 10% by weight of starch, but does not contain any dairy products. The finished products are packaged for retail sale, packed in plastic bags and then placed in cartons intended for distribution.

According to the declared data, these are products (upper and lower vibration dampers) made of nitrile-butadiene rubber (NBR). The products are intended to dampen the transmission of vibrations in the handle of a hammer drill.
According to the declared data, this is a large and small bristle brush in an aluminum case. The brushes are part of the sander's extraction device. Made of PA (polyamide) + Al (aluminum) material.

According to the declared data, this is a thrust bearing housing. The goods serve as the outer part of the thrust bearing housing of the electric motor of a water pump. The product has a bowl-shaped shape, outer diameter 136.2 mm, height 150.2 mm, a hole for a threaded set screw in the middle, holes for screws around the circumference, and a thread on the inner circumference for screwing onto the motor. Made of stainless steel.

According to the declared data, this is a thrust bearing housing. The goods serve as the outer part of the thrust bearing housing of the electric motor of a water pump. The product has a bowl-shaped shape, outer diameter 134.7 mm, height 100.48 mm, a hole for a threaded set screw in the middle, holes for screws around the circumference. Made of stainless steel.

According to the declared data, this is a thrust bearing housing. The goods serve as the outer part of the thrust bearing housing of the electric motor of a water pump. The product has a bowl-shaped shape, outer diameter 133.8 mm, height 103.1 mm, a hole for a threaded set screw in the middle, holes for screws around the circumference. Made of gray cast iron and sheathed with stainless steel sheet.

According to the declared data, this is a thrust bearing housing. The goods serve as the outer part of the thrust bearing housing of the electric motor of a water pump. The product has a bowl-shaped shape, outer diameter 93.87 mm, height 75.5 mm, a hole for a threaded set screw in the middle, holes for screws around the circumference. Made of gray cast iron and sheathed with stainless steel sheet.

According to the declared data, this is a crushed natural stone (limestone), which is only cleaned of mechanical impurities. The product is suitable for use in aquariums, terrariums, gardens and ponds.

According to the declared data, this is a broken natural stone (marble, sandstone, lava stone), which is only cleaned of mechanical impurities. The product is suitable for use in aquariums, terrariums, gardens and ponds.

According to the declared data, it is a foil (film) made of low-density polyethylene. The foil is flexible (elastic), not lightweight, not reinforced, not laminated, not reinforced or otherwise combined with other materials, not printed, wound in a roll. It serves as a protection for food and dishes against spoilage and external influences (insects, dirt); it is intended for direct contact with food. Dimensions 29 cm x 20 m – 59 cm x 300 m. Thickness: 8 - 9 µm (0.008 - 0.009 mm). Density: 0.92 g/cm³.

Other ceramic tableware, see attached photo, - blue/grey/black mottled, glazed, bulbous bowl, - dimensions: approx. 7.8 cm (diameter) x 3 cm (height), - ceramic product, fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - according to the results of scientific analysis, made of stoneware. "Other ceramic tableware (bowl), made of stoneware"

According to the application, the applicant's supplementary information, and the submitted product sample, the so-called "Assembly and Commissioning Kit" is a set of goods presented for retail sale for reactivating a urea dosing pump (not the subject of this ruling). The kit consists of a dispensing syringe (capacity 60 ml) made of plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39 with a Luer lock connection (goods of heading 3926) and a section of tubing with a quick connector and Luer lock female connector made of plastic (goods of heading 3917). With regard to their significance in terms of use, both the dispensing syringe and the tubing, including the connectors, are considered to be of equal rank. Since no distinctive component of the kit can be identified, it is classified under the last of the equally applicable headings, pursuant to General Rule 3(c). The "Assembly and Commissioning Kit" is packaged in a polybag for direct sale to the end user. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "other goods made of plastics, not covered by CN subheadings 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".

The product (see attached image) is an electric lighting fixture available in four versions, essentially consisting of a rectangular metal housing, an integrated white LED light source, a reflector, and a clear glass cover. The product is equipped with an approximately 5-meter-long power cord and plug. Technical data (excerpt): - Luminous flux: 2400 lm or 4000 lm - Beam angle: 130° - Color temperature: 6500 K - Power: 30 W or 50 W - Protection class: IP 54. The product is suitable for a variety of lighting purposes, both indoors and outdoors. It is available in two different wattages, each with an adjustable metal bracket for universal mounting and a metal stand with a base and carrying handle for floor placement. There is no indication that it is handmade. The goods are to be classified as "electric lighting equipment not elsewhere specified or included, not covered by subheadings (HS) 9405 11 to 9405 41, intended solely for use with LED light sources, not a spotlight, of metal and glass, not handmade".

Applicant's specifications: Filling hose for AdBlue/urea (AUS32), 1 m - ideally suited for refilling urea additives; enables clean refilling, no contamination or unpleasant odors in the interior - suitable for 5-liter and 10-liter canisters. Findings on a sample: A hose was submitted consisting of a transparent, flexible inner hose made of plastic with a matching funnel-shaped adapter (with filter function) and a black, grooved outer hose made of plastic, fitted with plastic connectors on both ends. The inner hose has a diameter of approximately 0.8 cm and the outer hose has a diameter of approximately 2.0 cm. It is assumed that the hose cannot withstand a pressure of 27.6 MPa or more. Conclusion: This is a different type of plastic hose, neither reinforced with nor combined with other materials, with fittings, closures, or connectors.

Interface module – consisting of a printed circuit board populated with a microcontroller and other components in a housing (dimensions: 127 x 76 x 30 mm) with status LEDs, a rotary switch (for addressing), several DIP switches (for configuration), and a connecting cable – for converting digital input signals into other types of digital output signals for connecting a remote control unit to the indoor unit of an air conditioner (neither of which are the subject of this information). "Electrical device with its own function, not elsewhere specified or included in Chapter 85, not covered by TARIC codes 8543 1000 00 to 8543 7090 87."

Circuit board with holder for battery-powered pole pruners - a product manufactured specifically according to a technical drawing, essentially consisting of a central carrier structure for electronic components (circuit board) equipped with two inductors (coils) and four capacitors, as well as an integrated plastic spacer, - designed as a permanently installed, device-specific, and functionally necessary assembly for battery-powered pole pruners, - for installation (mounting) in handheld battery-operated tools with an integrated electric motor (battery-powered pole pruners), - for use as a passive functional component for radio interference suppression of the device-specific electric motor of a battery-powered pole pruner and as a spacer. "Part identifiable as being intended exclusively or principally for handheld tools with an integrated electric motor, not for chainsaws or pneumatic tools, not a product of code number 8467 9900 10 0 - Circuit board with holder for battery-powered pole pruners"

Thallium iodide: According to the information provided, the product is chemically pure thallium iodide. It is a yellow solid. The CAS number is 7790-30-9. The product is used as a doping agent in scintillation applications. It is classified under TARIC code 2827 6000 90 as chlorides, chloride oxides and chloride hydroxides; bromides and bromide oxides; iodides and iodide oxides; iodides and iodide oxides, other.

The product (see attached image) is a composite item consisting of an electric light fixture and two sockets. It comprises a cuboid gray metal base measuring approximately 390 mm x 80 mm (H x d), a white, translucent plastic cover, an integrated E27 lamp socket (suitable for various light sources, e.g., halogen lamps, LEDs), and two sockets with hinged covers integrated into the base. It operates on mains voltage and is designed for outdoor use (IP 44), for example, in gardens or entrances. Neither the electric light fixture nor the sockets determine the character of the composite item in terms of their significance with regard to its use; therefore, it is classified under the last-mentioned heading of equally applicable headings. The characteristic element is determined by the metal, based on its extent and significance with regard to its use (providing shape and stability). There is no indication that the product was handcrafted. The product is to be classified as an "electric lighting fixture not elsewhere specified or included, not covered by subheadings (HS) 9405 11 to 9405 42, not a spotlight, of metal, not handmade".

According to the applicant's information and the submitted product images and samples, the product is a set of so-called "fascination mats" made of plastic, as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The products, each measuring approximately 500 x 500 x 7.5 mm (L x W x H), consist of three layers of plastic film, welded together around the edges and filled with a colored liquid (water and pigments). The product also has a non-slip, padded underside. It is intended to be laid flat on various surfaces (e.g., a table or floor) to create movement in the liquid by applying pressure (this is meant to improve coordination and balance). The nature of the product, which is composed of various materials, is determined by the extent and significance of its use through the plastic film. Classification under heading 9503 is not possible because, based on its objective characteristics, the product is not recognizably intended or suitable primarily for recreational play. Since the mats are not permanently placed on the floor but can also be used on other smooth surfaces (e.g., a table), classification as floor coverings under heading 3918 is also not possible. Six fascination mats are packaged together for sale. For customs tariff purposes, they are classified as "other goods made of plastics, other than those specified in subheadings (CN) 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".

Applicant's description: Automotive brake hose; intended for the aftermarket (not for industrial installation). The black hose is made of EPDM rubber, reinforced with textile materials, and has a steel guard on one end as well as intermediate pieces and connectors at the ends. Findings on a sample: A black, elastic hose made of soft rubber was submitted. The hose is reinforced with textile materials and has metallic connectors at the ends, as well as a black, elastic support and a black cylinder made of a hard material. A portion of the hose is also fitted with a metallic spiral. Finding: A different type of soft rubber hose is present, also with fittings, closures, or connectors (e.g., nipples, elbows), reinforced with other materials, or in combination with other materials, with fittings, closures, or connectors.

The product (see attached image) is an electric lighting fixture consisting of a round, bulbous metal wire frame decorated on the outside with thin plastic rods (approx. 2 mm diameter) arranged vertically at approximately 1 cm intervals. It features an integrated plastic LED candle in the base. The LED candle is equipped with a permanently installed LED light source, a solar panel, and an on/off switch. When switched on, it emits a continuous light that imitates a flame. The product is available as a set of two. - Dimensions: approx. 20 cm x 32 cm (diameter x height) - Dimensions: approx. 26 cm x 41 cm (diameter x height) The product is intended for ambient lighting. The material character of the product is determined, in particular with regard to its external appearance, size, and significance in relation to its use, by the plastic. The product is packaged in a cardboard box. The product is to be classified as an "electric lighting fixture not elsewhere specified or included, not covered by subheadings (HS) 9405 11 to 9405 39, photovoltaic, intended solely for use with LED light sources, not a spotlight, made of plastics".

The product (see attached image) is a light curtain consisting of a garland of colorless plastic-insulated electrical cables, from which three strands extend at intervals of approximately 100 cm. A colorless plastic star-shaped finial, approximately 20 cm in diameter, is attached to the end of each strand. Inside each finial is a string of 28 white LEDs that can be set to either steady or flashing light. The product includes a 2-meter-long power cord and a solar panel with mounting hardware (ground stake and wall mount). This string of lights is suitable for various decorative purposes, such as embellishing windows and balconies. The product is to be classified as an "electric lighting fixture not elsewhere specified or included, not covered by subheadings (HS) 9405 11 to 9405 39, photovoltaic, intended solely for use with LED light sources, not a spotlight, made of plastics".

Porcelain dishware, so-called bowl, photo attached, - white, glazed, oval bowl, - dimensions: approx. 20 cm (length) x 16.5 cm (width) x 7.5 cm (height), - ceramic product, fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - according to the application, made of porcelain. "Porcelain dishware (bowl)"

The product described as a "chrome-plated frame base" is made of chrome-plated aluminum and measures 40 x 342 x 460 mm (W x H x D). It essentially consists of a long base rail with a rib projecting upwards from each end. The upper end of the base is attached to a vanity unit using screws and the included mounting hardware. The frame base is a necessary and identifiable component of vanity units of the type used in bathrooms, ensuring the unit's stability at the appropriate height. The product is to be classified as "an identifiable metal part of furniture other than those covered by headings 9401 and 9402." Attachment: an illustration

The product (see attached image) is a replica of a standard, stick-shaped candle, approximately 3.7 cm x 23 cm (diameter x height), with a plastic body (available in various colors) and a flame replica made of white, translucent plastic. It features an integrated, continuously illuminated white LED light source. The candle replica is equipped with an integrated solar panel and is mounted on a plastic rod (approximately 40 cm long). When switched on, it emits a continuous light that imitates a flame. The product is universally positionable and serves as mood lighting for indoor and outdoor use. The product is classified as an "electrical lighting fixture, not elsewhere specified or included, not covered by subheadings (HS) 9405 11 to 9405 39, photovoltaic, intended exclusively for use with LED light sources, not a spotlight, made of plastics."

The goods (see attached image) are a string of lights approximately 4.85 cm long, consisting of a twisted garland made of two colorless plastic-insulated electrical cables with 20 continuously illuminated white LED light sources, spaced at regular intervals. Each light source has a hollow sphere (approximately 5 cm in diameter) made of colorless plastic attached. The spheres are wrapped on the outside with thin woven yarn in various colors, allowing light to pass through the gaps. The string of lights is equipped with a power cord and a solar panel. No defining material can be identified (plastic in terms of its use as a shaping material, woven yarn due to its external appearance); therefore, it is classified under the last-mentioned subheading of equally applicable subheadings. It is a string of lights intended for various decorative purposes. The product is to be classified as an "electric lighting appliance not elsewhere specified or included, not covered by subheadings (HS) 9405 11 to 9405 39, photovoltaic, intended solely for use with LED light sources, not a spotlight, of textile material".

A worm gear drive, essentially consisting of a gearbox housing manufactured specifically according to a technical drawing, containing a drive worm and an externally toothed spindle nut (worm wheel) which is driven by the drive worm during rotational movements, is used for longitudinal seat adjustment in a vehicle after being inserted into steel rails. "Gear drive, not a gearbox, worm gear drive"

Details: Accessory for laboratory equipment used to measure jaundice in newborns (human medicine). The probe is used as a reference for verifying the "Bilimeter 3D" device as part of quality control and is sold with a corresponding certificate. The probe consists of anodized aluminum milled parts into which a specially colored glass is bonded. The glass exhibits the same interference as the analyte bilirubin. Classification: Miscellaneous products of the chemical industry: diagnostic or laboratory reagents on a carrier, prepared diagnostic or laboratory reagents, also on a carrier, also packaged in sets, excluding goods of heading 3006; certified reference materials: other.

Refined copper foil. The goods are a foil of refined copper (99.9%) with a thickness of 0.012 mm to 0.14 mm, which is cut to approximately 580 mm x 650 mm or traded on rolls. The goods are used for electronic applications. The goods are to be classified under subheading 7410 1100 of the Combined Nomenclature as foils and thin strips of copper (whether or not printed or on paper, cardboard, plastic or similar substrates), with a thickness (excluding the substrate) of 0.15 mm or less, of refined copper.

The article illustrated by images and data sheets is a so-called toilet seat riser set, in the form of a composite product, consisting of: - a toilet seat riser, -- made of plastics as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39 (according to the application, polypropylene and polyvinyl chloride) -- with an integrated seat and lid with grip recesses and two hygiene cutouts, -- with movable armrests made of painted steel and armrest pads made of plastic, -- with dimensions of approximately 41 x 48.5 x 56 cm, adjustable to three different heights, -- with regard to the scope and use, the plastic determines the character of the seat riser and - a toilet seat riser, -- consisting of a specifically shaped plastic mounting housing, with an electric motor drive unit, lifting columns on both sides with guide pieces, a mounting device for the toilet seat riser, a hand control, a plug-in power supply unit and a mounting base, - for controlled raising and lowering (vertical stroke up to 95 mm) of the toilet seat riser. Both products are mounted on standard toilet bowls and make it easier for people with reduced mobility to use the toilet. The nature of the goods is determined by their size and the significance of the seat riser in relation to its use. The product, packaged disassembled with mounting hardware in cardboard boxes, is classified for customs tariff purposes as "plastic toilet seat and lid".

The article illustrated by images and data sheets is a so-called toilet seat riser set, in the form of a composite product, consisting of: - a toilet seat riser, -- made of plastics as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39 (according to the application, made of polypropylene and polyvinyl chloride) -- with an integrated seat and lid with a recessed handle and two hygiene cutouts, -- with plastic armrests, -- with dimensions of approximately 38 x 49 x 55 cm, adjustable to three different heights -- with regard to the scope and use, the plastic determines the character of the seat riser and - a toilet seat riser, -- consisting of a specifically shaped plastic mounting housing, with an electric motor drive unit, lifting columns on both sides with guide pieces, a mounting device for the toilet seat riser, a hand control, a plug-in power supply unit and a mounting base, - for controlled raising and lowering (vertical stroke up to 95 mm) of the toilet seat riser. Both products are mounted on standard toilet bowls and make it easier for people with reduced mobility to use the toilet. The nature of the goods is determined by their size and the significance of the seat riser in relation to its use. The product, packaged disassembled with mounting hardware in cardboard boxes, is classified for customs tariff purposes as "plastic toilet seat and lid".

These are product sets in various designs, essentially consisting of: - a nearly rectangular, elongated carrier plate made of sheet steel with rounded corners, equipped with adhesive pads on the back and, depending on the design, two small hooks on the front; - two or four circular magnets coated with plastic or rubber, each with two pointed steel prongs in the center, which are attached to the carrier plate; - a plastic or rubber fork for removing the magnets; - a cleaning cloth; and - instructions for use. The products are intended for holding, for example, soap or shampoo in the bathroom or household and are packaged together in a printed cardboard box for retail sale. - Applicant's information - The nature of the product sets in retail packaging is determined by the carrier plate due to its size. The nature of the carrier plate, which consists of various materials, is determined by the steel due to its size and its importance for the product's use. See attached illustration. Such products, classified as "steel goods other than those specified in the aforementioned codes," fall under tariff code 7326 9098 90 0. Classification under subheading 8302 5000 is not possible, as the products are not fully covered by that subheading.

According to the application and the submitted sample, the product described as "SunSun spare part for pressure pond filter CPF-180/250 connection set, 2-piece" consists of two silicone sealing rings with a round cross-section (plastic within the meaning of Note 1 to Chapter 39; according to scientific analysis) with diameters of 6 cm (white) and 5.5 cm (orange). These generally applicable, neutrally shaped rings are intended for use as sealing elements in a pressure pond filter (not the subject of this ruling). Classification as a recognizable part of goods under Section XVI is not possible due to their neutral shape and universal application. The sealing rings are packaged as a set of two in a labeled resealable bag. For customs tariff purposes, they are classified as "other goods made of plastics, not covered by TARIC codes 3926 1000 00 to 3926 9097 77".

Details: Replacement part outlet nozzle for bio pond filter. Findings on a sample: A black plastic connector was presented, which has an external thread on one end and is thickened around the middle. Finding: Connectors, made of plastic, other, other

Details: Replacement part, plastic connector for CBF-350B bio pond filter. No sample was submitted. Based on a submitted photograph, the product is a black connector with external threads on both ends and a thickened circumferential band on both sides. Finding: Connectors, made of plastic, other, other

Details: Outlet hose barb for bio-pond filter. Findings on a sample: A black plastic connector was presented, featuring a barb on one end and an external thread on the other. Conclusion: Connectors, made of plastic, other, other

Details: Spare part for swimming pool pump, plastic stepped outlet fitting. No sample was submitted. Based on a submitted photograph, the product appears to be a black connector in the form of a stepped fitting. Findings: Connectors, made of plastic, other, other

Applicant's specifications: - 2x wheel chocks - Dimensions: 90 x 15 x 10 cm - Material: Rubber - Yellow reflective strips for visibility - Easy mounting with screw grooves - Set of two for flexible use. Findings/Examinations of a Sample: Two black profiles with a trapezoidal cross-section (dimensions approx. 90 x 15 x 10 cm), reflectors attached to the sides, and holes on the top and bottom were submitted. The profiles are made of vulcanized rubber. Finding: Different product made of soft rubber.

Applicant's description: Replacement part for a pressure pond filter. This 20 mm diameter plastic inlet/outlet is the perfect replacement part for the SunSun pond filter. The original inlet/outlet can be easily replaced, ensuring uninterrupted cleaning of the pond. A sample was not submitted. The plastic connector was illustrated by photographs and an exploded view drawing. Finding: This is a different plastic connector for pipes and hoses.

Applicant's information: SunSun spare part outlet assembly HW-504A/505A, intended as a component or spare part for an aquarium filter system or aquatics application, intended for installation or use within a technical system, not a standalone device, but a part/accessory. A product sample was not submitted. The goods were illustrated by photographs and described by a data sheet. According to this, it is a plastic connection assembly. The three PVC pipe sections (two straight and one curved) are rigid and are supplied together with plastic connectors/fittings (a hose clamp, a plastic screw, an outlet, two connecting sleeves, and a spray tube end cap) and a rubber suction cup. Findings: The characteristic features of these are rigid plastic pipes made of vinyl chloride polymers.

These are steel screws (not stainless steel) with a domed round head and a ball-shaped end, featuring a metric thread (M22) extending to the head with a blunt end. Each screw is equipped with a matching steel nut and washer. These coupling balls are packaged and mounted on towing vehicles, where they serve as components of a trailer hitch. Dimensions: Ball diameter: approximately 50 mm; Overall length: approximately 118 mm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products, classified as "other screws of steel, with thread, with head, with accompanying nut and washer", fall under TARIC code 7318 1595 89. They are not classified under heading 8708, as, according to Note 2(1)(a) of ABS XV, they are parts of general use which, according to Note 2(b) of ABS XVII, are excluded from ABS XVII and therefore from heading 8708.

The product described as a "3-tier rolling cart" is a piece of furniture (dimensions: 87 x 43 x 66 cm - L x W x H) made of various materials. It essentially consists of a plastic trolley with three open, rectangular shelves connected by four support columns, each with a slightly raised edge. Two perforated metal panels on the sides accommodate eight polypropylene hooks. A push handle is located on each of the two narrow sides of the top shelf. The unit is supported by four small swivel casters (Ø 76 x 21 mm) on the underside, two of which are equipped with locking brakes. The plastic component, due to its size and importance as a stabilizing element, defines the material character of the product. Designed for floor placement, this product is intended for furnishing living spaces or workshops, for example. It is used for storing and briefly transporting various items or materials. The unassembled and unpackaged goods are to be classified as "furniture made of plastic other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402". (see illustration in the annex)

The product described as "L Pen Ballpoint Pen" is a ballpoint pen with a non-replaceable refill and paste-like writing ink. The writing instrument is approximately 17.2 cm long and consists essentially of a two-tone (pink at the bottom, black at the top) plastic casing with a printed company logo on the side, a stylized pink plastic hand with outstretched thumb and forefinger attached to a spring, and a refill with a metal ball at the writing tip. The product is to be classified as a "ballpoint pen, not with liquid ink, with a non-replaceable refill." Attachment: an image

So-called terminal bushing, - consisting of a specific, elongated, approximately cylindrical, hollow hard lead alloy manufactured according to a technical drawing with varying external tapers, conical on one side, - the goods have the dimensions: 12.45 x 15.3 x 30.5 mm (small inner diameter x large inner diameter x length), - for a voltage of less than 1000 V, - for installation in a vehicle battery as a terminal cap, - serves to create an electrical connection by welding on one side and clamping a battery terminal on the other. The goods are to be classified as "electrical device for connecting electrical circuits, for a voltage of less than 1000 V, not a plug device, connecting and contacting element for wires or cables". Attachment: 1 Figure

A so-called disposable pressure microcatheter, in the form of a composite product, essentially consisting of an approximately 1500 mm long catheter body with proximal and distal shafts, a pressure sensor inside the distal end, a relief tube, a needle connector, and a handle. The pressure sensor, in terms of its function and significance for use, determines the essential nature of the composite product. The package includes the pressure microcatheter, packaging material in the form of a carrier tube and a sterile packaging tray, as well as instructions for use. The pressure catheter, in terms of its significance for use, determines the essential nature of the product. At the distal end (the tip of the catheter) are two radiopaque markings, which serve to determine the position of the catheter and, in particular, the pressure sensor within the coronary arteries. See the attached illustration. The goods are designed to be connected to an intravascular ultrasound imaging system (not part of this binding tariff information decision) and, during cardiac catheterization, are used to be inserted into the coronary arteries of the human body. There, the pressure sensor measures the blood pressure before and after identified narrowings (coronary stenoses) within a measuring range of -30 to +300 mmHg. The electrical signals from the pressure sensor at the catheter tip are converted into radio signals via the handle and transmitted to a wireless acquisition module (intravascular ultrasound imaging system). The goods are single-use products. They are classified as "electronic devices for measuring or monitoring the pressure of liquids, not covered by headings 9014, 9015, 9028 or 9032".

Hollow profile made of an aluminum alloy. The goods are profiles made of an aluminum alloy (EN AW-6063-T5) with a uniform cross-section along their entire length, enclosing a single hollow cavity, and measuring 20 mm x 40 mm. One profile has a groove and the other the corresponding tongue. The profiles are 1764 mm long and are anodized or black powder-coated. The profiles are supplied together with two brackets and four screws. The profiles are the defining characteristic of the product. The goods are used as starter and end caps for fence posts. The goods are to be classified as bars and profiles, of aluminum, of aluminum alloys, hollow profiles, under TARIC code 7604 2100 00.

Carrying system, photos see attachment, - packaged in a polybag, - designed as a strap system for wearing on the upper body, - with a continuous pad extending over the shoulders and upper back (flat, with a length of approx. 42 cm and a pad width of max. approx. 21 cm) with an outer surface made of solid-color fabrics of heading 5903, coated on one side (inside) with plastic (not cellular plastic), an inner surface made of solid-color spacer fabrics and with one pad(s) of foam plastics in the shoulder strap area and two pads in the back area; glued at the edges and bound with narrow strips of fabric, - at the front with an approx. 2 cm wide, length-adjustable webbing strap made of fabrics, sewn on approximately in the middle, connecting the shoulder straps, with a plastic snap fastener; The lower section features an approximately 2.5 cm wide, length-adjustable woven webbing strap connecting the shoulder straps to the back panel; it is equipped with a total of four elastic woven loops and a sewn-on woven band approximately 4 cm wide with a plastic snap fastener on the back panel; all textile fabrics are made of textile materials; it is made by joining the pieces together; there is no indication of handwork; it does not meet the conditions for classification under heading 9020; the fabrics, in particular with regard to their size, give the goods their essential character. "Other made-up articles (carrying systems) of textile materials, of woven materials, not handmade"

A so-called AI-supported tracking device, essentially consisting of a specifically shaped plastic housing (approx. 322 x 381 x 142 mm) with an integrated handle, an LCD, a control pad, a lithium-ion battery, a CPU, a Bluetooth module, a memory module, a telemetry module, an antenna unit, a WiFi module, a GPS module, integrated software intelligence, and other electrical and electronic components (see illustration in the appendix). The tracking device (radio receiver), together with a broadband transmitter (radio transmitter, not the subject of this vZTA decision), forms a functional unit for controlling and monitoring horizontal drilling (HDD drilling) by using radio tracking to determine the inclination, roll, and position of the drill head. For this purpose, the transmitter is positioned near the drill head and sends an electromagnetic field signal to the tracking device to display the drill's position parameters in real time. The measured values ​​can be displayed, saved, and transmitted wirelessly. The goods are classified as "Geophysical apparatus, excluding compasses, other than subheadings (HS) 9015 10 to 9015 40".

Applicant's description: Stickers used during the edging of spectacle lenses to prevent the lens from twisting in the grinding machine. Transparent, individually peelable stickers made of plastic (polyethylene with polyester coating). The stickers are rolled onto a backing paper in a printed cardboard box. Findings on a sample: Oval, transparent, self-adhesive flat products were submitted on a protective paper backing, each with a hole in the center. Identification: Self-adhesive flat products made of plastic.

Applicant's information: Polymer mixture of various copolymers. A sample was not submitted. Confidential information on the composition of the granules was available. According to this information, alpha-methylstyrene predominates by weight among the monomers. Finding: Other plastic within the meaning of Note 3 to Chapter 39, not elsewhere specified or included, in primary form.

The product illustrated by the applicant's information and a product sample is a 20-piece set for demonstrating arithmetic problems in the form of set theory. The round elements have a diameter of approximately 50 mm and a thickness of approximately 1 mm and are each made of colored plastic film (red, blue) and a ferrite magnet. The set is packaged for sale in a clear polybag with a product sticker. The tiles, coated on both sides with different colored plastic film, serve to illustrate arithmetic problems in mathematics lessons through pictorial and abstract representations. With regard to their significance for use, particularly for pictorial representation, the different colored plastic films define the character of the elements, which consist of two different materials. Therefore, classification under heading 8505 is not possible. Such goods are classified under customs tariff law as "other plastic goods other than those specified in subheadings (CN) 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".

Stainless steel tubes. The goods are square stainless steel tubes (304) with a uniform square cross-section along their entire length, with an edge length of 25 mm. The tube is 280 mm long and has a hole at each end on one side. The goods are manufactured by welding. The goods are used as a base for IV stands. The goods are to be classified under subheading 7306 6110 of the Combined Nomenclature as other tubes and hollow sections (e.g., welded, riveted, folded or with simply butted edges), of iron or steel, other, welded, of non-circular cross-section, of square or rectangular cross-section, of stainless steel.

Applicant's description: XXL desk mat, 70x30 cm, super soft, for keyboard, mouse and other accessories; non-slip underside; flat-stitched edges. Findings on a sample: A rectangular mat measuring approximately 68.5 cm x 30 cm with rounded corners was submitted. The mat consists of a black, elastic, cellular material (soft rubber) on the underside and a light blue knitted fabric on the top. The cellular rubber layer is clearly the thicker layer, and the weight per square meter is more than 1500 g. Finding: Other goods made of soft rubber, of cellular rubber, other

Application details: Citrus fiber, produced from depectinized citrus pomace, in the form of a fine, cream-colored powder with a neutral odor and taste and very high swelling capacity. The residue from pectin production is washed with water and alcohol. The product is then dried and ground. The product is suitable for human consumption and is used, among other things, for dietary fiber enrichment. It could also be used as a supplementary feed for animals. Plant materials and plant waste, plant residues and plant by-products of the type used for feeding, also in the form of pellets, not elsewhere specified or included, pomace (excluding grape pomace).

Applicant's description: GMP ("Good Manufacturing Practice") compliant, xeno- and serum-free culture medium for the maintenance and propagation of undifferentiated human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) under feeder-free conditions. The product is in the form of a liquid nutrient solution to support both automated and manual workflows. Description: Prepared nutrient substrates for the cultivation and maintenance of microorganisms (including viruses and the like) or plant, human, or animal cells.

Description: Litter for use in cat litter boxes, consisting of a mineral, gray granulate based on bentonite or natural clay. The product is sold in predominantly blue printed, transparent plastic bags of 6 and 12 kg. Findings: Light to dark gray granulate with a grain size of 1-2 mm. According to the investigations, it is not activated bentonite. A perfume is perceptible when the product is moist. Classification: Chemical products and preparations of the chemical industry or related industries (including mixtures of natural products), not elsewhere specified or included: other.

The article illustrated by a product sample is a strip curtain made of PVC, a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The transparent strips (dimensions approximately 1 x 500 x 2290 mm) are fitted on the top side with two screwed-on mounting brackets made of base metal for hanging them in a fastening system (not the subject of this binding tariff information). The underside features an integrated lead strip. The individual products are used in cleanroom environments to separate different air zones and to guide the laminar airflow (according to the application). Given the scope and significance of the product's use, the plastic is considered to be a defining characteristic. Such products are classified under customs tariff law as "other plastic goods, other than those specified in subheadings (CN) 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".

The laptop charging cart is a product composed of various components, consisting of a cabinet and electrical connectors. It is used for charging, storing, and transporting laptops or tablets. The cabinet-like product, measuring approximately 64 cm x 76 cm x 98 cm, has two doors for opening and closing and four casters. Inside, there are 32 storage compartments for notebooks/tablets. The product is intended for use in schools. No single component can be identified as the defining characteristic of the product. It is therefore classified under the last of the applicable headings as furniture. The cabinet body is made of metal. The product is to be classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of an office type, not a bed." (See attached image)

Mixture of fragrance substances; vanilla flavoring. The product is a vanilla flavoring made from synthetically produced vanillin and ethanol. The flavoring is imported in 10- or 25-liter canisters and in 200- or 220-liter steel tanks and is intended for the industrial production of beverages and other foodstuffs. It is a mixture based on a fragrance substance, which is to be classified under subheading 3302 1040 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Pipe connector. The goods are a tubular section made of stainless steel (1.4404). According to the specifications, this section is cut at a right angle from a welded tube with a circular cross-section by simply cutting it to length without any further processing (deburring, chamfering). The outside diameter is 114.3 mm with a wall thickness of 2.6 mm, and the length (cut length) is 122 mm. The pipe section is used to manufacture fittings, specifically concentric reducers for butt welding. In its current state, the pipe section is already suitable for butt welding. The goods are to be classified as "Pipe connectors, other, of stainless steel, connectors for butt welding, other" under subheading 7307 2390 of the Combined Nomenclature.

These are approximately 2000 mm long, so-called visibility bars, consisting of four individual, nested steel tube sections, fully coated with paint. One of the tube sections is equipped with four permanent magnets on its lower outer surface. The products are attached to so-called impact protection profiles (not the subject of this binding tariff information) to increase upward visibility. - Applicant's information - The nature of the goods, which are composed of various components, is determined by the steel tube sections with regard to their scope and significance for use. See attached illustration. Such products, as "steel goods other than those specified in the aforementioned subheadings," belong to subheading 7326 9098 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Decorative item, photo attached, - with maximum overall dimensions (L x W) of approx. 28 cm x 12 cm, - consisting of a five-pointed star with a shaping wire made of base metal (iron according to the application), which is completely wrapped with a single-color band of apparently velvet fabric made of synthetic chemical fibers according to the application with incorporated metallized strips of synthetic spinning mass (with an apparent width of less than 1 mm), - provided with a hanging loop at the top edge, - with an attached bow made of the above-mentioned material at the bottom edge. Fabric tape, "fir branches," three plastic "holly fruits," a plant part (according to the application: pine cones), and two metal bells attached to cords—assembled by joining components, without any indication of handwork—does not meet the conditions for classification under heading 9505. In particular, the fabric tapes of textile materials determine the essential character of the goods, especially considering their size. "Other made-up articles, of textile materials, not handcrafted"

Feed-in terminal lower part as an electrical connecting element, - essentially consisting of an approximately cuboid body, - with a length of 30.0 mm and a width of 9.5 mm, - with a bore of 4.0 mm, - for a voltage of 500 V, - for use as an electrical contact element in industrial busbars (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision), - for making an electrical connection by crimping on a top part and fitting a cable lug (both not the subject of this binding tariff information decision). The goods are to be classified as "electrical apparatus for connecting electrical circuits, for a voltage of less than 1000 V, not a plug-in device, other than subheadings (CN) 8536 9001 to 8536 9040". Annex: 1 Figure

Decorative figure, photo attached, - packaged in a cardboard box, with mounting material (ground stakes and guy ropes), - in the form of an inflatable, stylized snowman with hat and scarf; with dimensions of 60 cm x 47 cm x 124 cm according to the application, - made of various approximately 0.1 mm thick, single-color woven fabrics, - with a zippered opening on the underside; inside equipped with a sewn-in "sandbag", a blower pump with power cord and plug for inflating the "snowman", and an LED module; The LED module serves only to enhance the decorative effect and is therefore not a product of heading 9405; it is assembled by joining components; there is no indication of handwork; it does not meet the conditions for classification as a fixed article under heading 9505; and due to the fabric used, it is not a product of Chapter 39: "Other made-up articles (decorative figures), of textile materials, of woven materials, not hand-worked."

Description: Reddish to green, highly viscous liquid in a tank truck or 181 kg drum. A mixture of the reaction products of a hydrogenation of adiponitrile (hexanedionitrile, adiponitrile). The main component of the mixture of variable composition (UVCB) is bishexamethylenetriamine (BHMT). Classification: Chemical products or preparations consisting predominantly of organic compounds, not elsewhere specified or included; in liquid form at 20°C; other.

Applicant's information: Films and foils made of unfoamed polyethylene terephthalate, neither reinforced nor laminated or similarly bonded to other materials, without backing, unprocessed or only surface-treated or only cut into squares or rectangles, thickness <= 0.35 mm. Findings on a sample: A milky-opaque, rectangular PET film with a thickness of less than 0.35 mm was submitted. According to the submitted photograph, the goods are on rolls. Findings: Other films, not made of cellular plastics, neither reinforced nor laminated or similarly bonded to other materials, without backing, made of other polyesters, made of polyethylene terephthalate, with a thickness of 0.35 mm or less, other

Exhaust pipes, so-called intermediate pipes for further installation in an exhaust system, drawings see annex, - in the form of vehicle-specific, curved exhaust pipes, - according to the application: - - made of stainless steel, - - without indication of industrial assembly, - are installed downstream of a catalytic converter in the exhaust system of passenger cars, - serve in particular to discharge the combustion gases, - classification as "part of an exhaust pipe" under subheading (CN) 8708 9299 is not possible, as the exhaust pipes in question already constitute exhaust pipes, - based on their objective characteristics (including shape) and properties, they are clearly intended mainly for motor vehicles of Chapter 87. "Parts for motor vehicles of heading 8703 (exhaust pipes), exhaust pipes other than those specified in subheadings 8708 10 to 8708 91, not for industrial assembly"

Stainless steel pipe fittings. According to the application documents, the goods are stainless steel pipe bends and elbows (material UNS S32750, EN 1.4410). The products have angles of 30°, 45°, 60°, or 90° and are traded in various diameters. The ends are cut straight and beveled on the outside. The goods are suitable for butt welding. The goods are to be classified under subheading 7307 2310 of the Combined Nomenclature as pipe fittings, pipe closures, and pipe connectors (e.g., bends, sockets), of iron or steel, other, of stainless steel, fittings, closures, and connectors, for butt welding, bends and elbows.

Appliqués, photo attached, - two pieces packed in a polybag, - each rectangular, with dimensions (L x W) of approximately 14.5 cm x 3.5 cm, - made of an embroidery of heading 5810 (lettering) with a base of a two-layer textile laminate with an outer layer (face side) of plain-colored fabrics and an inner layer of apparently nonwoven textiles, - fitted with an eyelet made of brass and plastic according to the application in the area of ​​the short sides, - hemmed on all edges, - made up by joining, - without indication of handwork. "Other made-up articles (appliqués), of textiles, of embroidery, not handmade"

These are circular cylindrical hollow steel products in various dimensions, universally used in many different applications. They serve as spacers to ensure a defined distance between two components while simultaneously transmitting forces. Dimensions: Height: approximately 4–6 mm; outer diameter approximately 12 mm; inner diameter approximately 6–8 mm. – Applicant's information – See attached image. Such products, classified as "steel goods other than those specified in the aforementioned TARIC codes," fall under TARIC code 7326 9098 90. They do not fall under heading 7307, as they are not intended for joining two pipes or pipe sections, connecting a pipe to another device, or closing pipe openings (Explanatory Note to the Common Foreign and Trade Regulations, heading 7307 (HS), paragraph 01.0).

Cooking bag, photo attached, - according to the application, packaged in a printed cardboard box, - rectangular, with dimensions (H x W) of approximately 25 cm x 19 cm, - three-layered; with an outer and inner layer of plain or multicolored woven fabrics and an intermediate layer of wadding; sewn together at the edges, - with an overlapping opening below the top edge, - equipped with a hanging loop, - all textile products are made of textile materials, - made up by sewing, - no indication of handwork, - according to the application, used for storing and heating potatoes/vegetables in the microwave, - does not constitute a container of heading 4202, as the goods are neither specifically named in the heading nor similar to any of the containers mentioned therein. "Other made-up articles (cooking bags), of textile materials, of woven materials, not handmade"

The so-called mechanical pencil is a composite product consisting of a fountain pen (its defining characteristic being its use) and a sharpener attached to the top. The fountain pen, measuring approximately 12 x 154 mm (diameter x length), has a metal casing, a clip, and is filled with a 5.6 mm pencil lead. At the end of the writing instrument, below the attached sharpener, is an opening into which the lead is inserted. A push mechanism then advances the lead from the casing in sections. The product includes six spare leads. The packaged product is to be classified as "Fountain pens (twist and push-action pencils)." (See attached image.)

The goods described as a "garden cabinet with additional compartment" are metal furniture with external dimensions of 100 cm x 50 cm x 85 cm (W x D x H). The furniture essentially consists of two front cabinet doors and a removable top lid with a storage compartment underneath. Small drainage holes are located in the corners of the storage compartment. There is no irrigation system. The product is intended to be placed on the ground and is used, for example, in gardens. The goods are classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed." (Image: see annex)

The product described as a "mobile charging trolley for charging computers" is a steel product consisting essentially of a steel frame with a base plate at the bottom, to which two rubber tires and two feet are attached. Two steel tubes extend upwards from this base plate, joined in a U-shape, and have a specifically shaped mounting device or holder in the center at the top end, designed to accommodate a charging computer (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision). The charging trolley is used in automotive workshops to facilitate the handling, storage, provision, and transport of charging computers, which supply power to the vehicle's electrical system during repairs, thereby protecting the car battery. The product is classified as furniture under Chapter 94, as its use is primarily for setting up and providing access to the charging computer in a fixed location, rather than for transport. The goods are to be classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of an office type, not a bed". Attachment: an illustration

The "Endless Colored Pencils" set consists of colored pencils with a durable plastic casing. The colored pencils, approximately 13 cm long, are double-ended and come in a set of eight, packaged in a plastic pouch for long-lasting use. The set is classified as "colored pencils with a durable casing, not graphite pencils." (Image: see attached)

Decorative item, photo attached, - packaged in a polybag; according to the application, 40 pieces in various colors, - in the shape of a stylized bow; with maximum dimensions (L x W) of approximately 2.5 cm x 1.2 cm, - made of plain and printed fabrics of, according to the application, 100% polyester (synthetic chemical fibers), - assembled by joining, - without indication of handwork, - due to the fabrics used, not goods of subheading (CN) 6307 9010 "Other made-up articles (decorative articles), of textile materials, of woven materials, not handwork"

Applicant's information: Cutting strips for the paper industry. The cutting strips are available in various cross-sections, lengths, colors, and shapes (square or rectangular) and are all used in paper cutting machines. Findings on two samples: White square profiles of varying lengths and cross-sections. The profiles are unprocessed and, according to the tests performed, consist of polyamide. Conclusion: These are profiles made of other plastics, specifically condensation polymerization products (in this case, polyamide).

The goods described as a "kitchen shelf with paper towel holder" are a shelf measuring approximately 30 x 11 x 37 cm (W x D x H) made of powder-coated metal. The goods have two shelves, four plastic hooks, a holder for a paper towel roll, and mounting hardware for wall attachment. The unit is foldable, packaged unassembled in a cardboard box for retail sale, and, due to its design, is primarily intended for kitchen use, for storing items such as spices and other kitchen utensils. The goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of an office type, not a bed." Attachment: an illustration

These are products made entirely of base metal, in the form of a steel wire frame. The underside features two parallel steel sheet towel holders positioned approximately in the center, and two opposing outer sides each have five steel wire hooks. The top of the frame is fitted with two flat, lateral steel sheet support arms angled 90° inwards. The goods are designed to be attached to, for example, a cabinet or shelf using these support arms and serve to hold and hang various items such as cups, towels, or other kitchen utensils below the shelf. The products are packaged in a colorfully printed cardboard box along with a leaflet containing technical data. Dimensions (length x width x height): approximately 26.8 cm x 25.8 cm x 11 cm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products, classified as "goods similar to coat hooks, of base metal," fall under tariff code 8302 5000 00 0. Not heading 9403, as the products do not meet the definition of furniture laid down in Note 2 to Chapter 94. Furthermore, according to Note 2(1)(c) of Section 15, they are general-purpose parts which are exempt from Chapter 94 pursuant to Note 1(d) to Chapter 94.

The product described as "NAPPA WB Laundry Container with Lid" is a composite item consisting of various components, essentially comprising a cuboid inner box made of plastic (acrylic) with two handles on the upper, short sides and a genuine nappa leather cover, featuring a hinged opening with a magnetic closure at the top. The chest measures approximately 30 x 37 x 66 cm and is available in smoke gray, snow white, and black-brown. The nappa leather is the defining characteristic of the product in terms of its appearance and value. The floor-standing item serves as storage for various items (e.g., laundry). The product is to be classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402 and subheadings (HS) 9403 10 to 9403 83". Attachment: 1 Figure

Details: Cat litter for use in litter boxes in the form of a grey-black, granular material, consisting of approximately 70% by weight bentonite (unactivated), approximately 30% by weight refractory clay, sodium bicarbonate, and activated carbon. The litter is sold in 18 kg plastic bags. Indication: Chemical products and preparations of the chemical or related industries (including mixtures of natural products), not elsewhere specified or included: other.

Scarf-like goods, in children's size, photo see attachment, - approximately tubular; lying flat with dimensions (W x H) of approx. 27 cm x 20 cm, - according to the application, reversible; on one side made of approx. 2.5 mm thick, double-sided napped knitted fabric (so-called fleece) made of, according to the application, 100% polyester (synthetic chemical fibers); on the other side made of approx. 0.6 mm thick, colorfully woven fabrics made of, according to the application, 100% cotton, - sewn together at the short ends to form a "circular scarf" (thus finished), - without any indication of handwork, - is worn around the neck in the manner of a scarf, - with regard to size and external appearance, the knitted and woven fabrics are to be considered equivalent, thus neither of the two surface products gives the goods their essential character; It is therefore to be assigned to the last of the equally applicable headings (6117 / 6214) in this nomenclature, - it meets the criteria for classification as scarf-like goods, and is therefore not a product of heading 6217. "Scarf-like goods, of woven fabrics, of cotton, not handmade"

Details: Cat litter in the form of grey granules consisting of approximately 90% by weight bentonite (unactivated) and approximately 10% by weight fire-resistant clay. Approximately 0.5% by weight of a blue-colored zeolite has been added to the litter. The product is sold in 12 kg bags. Classification: Chemical products and preparations of the chemical or related industries (including mixtures of natural products), not elsewhere specified or included: other.

Side panels, photo see attachment, - according to the application: -- two pieces in different designs (with "window" or "door") packed together in a cardboard box, -- each rectangular, with dimensions (L x W) of approx. 290 cm x 195 cm, -- made of approx. 0.1 mm thick, single-color fabrics of heading 5903, coated on one side (inside) with embossed plastic (no cell structure visible), made of 100% polyester (synthetic man-made fibers), -- equipped with sewn-on Velcro tabs for attachment to the frame of a pavilion, -- hemmed at the edges by folding and stitching, -- side panel with "window": --- equipped with a "window" with dimensions (L x W) of approx. 175 cm x 100 cm made of clear plastic, --- in particular with regard to the extent, the textile fabrics determine the essential character of the goods, -- side panel with "door": --- with a "Zipper door" made from the aforementioned fabrics, - without any indication of handwork, - manufactured by joining pieces, - serving as side walls for a pavilion; based on their objective characteristics, they do not constitute either tarpaulins or an (incomplete) tent of heading 6306. "Other made-up articles (side walls) of textile materials, of woven fabrics, not handworked"

Copper strip. The goods are a strip of refined copper with a thickness of less than 0.15 mm, a width of 12.5 mm, and a length of 100 m. The strip is traded in coils. The strip is laminated with plastic. The goods are used as flat copper wire for induction loops. The goods are to be classified as foils and thin strips of copper (whether printed or on paper, cardboard, plastic, or similar substrates), with a thickness (excluding the backing) of 0.15 mm or less, on a backing, of refined copper, other, under tariff code 7410 2100 90.

These are ramp protection barriers made entirely of steel, consisting of an almost U-shaped bent steel tube with a central crossbar, also made of steel tubing. In conjunction with a mounting sleeve (not the subject of this binding tariff information), these products serve as impact protection (ram protection). Height: approximately 1300 mm; width: approximately 974 mm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "steel goods other than those specified in the aforementioned subheadings" under subheading 7326 9098 of the Combined Nomenclature.

These are steel screws with a Torx (registered trademark) head and a self-tapping thread that does not extend to the head, with a pointed thread end. The screws (the defining component) are packaged in a cardboard box together with pre-assembled plastic dowel plates and separately enclosed polystyrene end caps. The goods are used for fastening external thermal insulation composite systems (ETICS) or insulation boards (e.g., to wooden substrates). Length: approximately 140 mm; plate diameter: approximately 60 mm; thread diameter: approximately 6 mm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "other wood screws of steel (not stainless steel), with thread" under tariff code 7318 1290 90 0.

Boric acid. The goods are chemically pure boric acid (molecular form H3BO3), which is a white, odorless solid. The CAS number is 10043-35-3. The goods are to be classified as boron oxides; boric acids, other, under TARIC code 2810 0090 00.

The so-called BMU cell essentially consists of a specially shaped plastic tube, sealed with rubber caps and featuring multiple stepped ends in three different sizes (1/2", 3/8", and 1/4"). It is equipped with an arrow indicating the flow direction, a flat scanning surface on one end, two connection ports, and a barcode label. See the attached illustration. The device is integrated into the tubing system of an extracorporeal circuit. It serves to conduct blood and to attach the venous sensor head of a blood parameter monitor (not the subject of this VZTA decision), which monitors the venous blood parameters oxygen saturation, hemoglobin, hematocrit, and temperature during extracorporeal circulation. The cell is classified as an "accessory, recognizably primarily intended for use with a medical monitoring device for the simultaneous monitoring of two or more parameters."

Potassium nitrate. The product is chemically pure potassium nitrate (molecular formula KNO3). It is a colorless to white prilled solid. The CAS number is 7757-79-1. The product is to be classified as nitrites; nitrates, nitrates, of potassium, under TARIC code 2834 2100 00.

Top, size 36/38, see attached photo, - made of approximately 0.6 mm thick, single-color, ribbed knit fabric consisting of, according to the application, 53% viscose (artificial chemical fibers), 39% polyamide and 8% elastane (both synthetic chemical fibers), - extending over the waist (back length: approximately 60 cm), - with a round neckline, - without an opening or closure, - with a sewn-in inner part in the style of a bustier made of, according to the application, synthetic chemical fibers, which is sewn to the outer layer at the top edge and equipped with sewn-in, convex-shaped, thin pads and with an elastic band at the bottom (therefore not a product of heading 6109), - sleeveless, - hemmed at the bottom edge by folding over and stitching, - is not suitable, by its cut and design, to support, shape or correct a single bust (therefore not a product of heading 6212). "Other clothing (upper garment), knitted, of man-made fibers"

Applicant's description: Semi-transparent, flexible, approximately 5 cm wide, cloudy, stretchable, non-adhesive film made of ethylene-propylene copolymer for laboratory use. Polyethylene content predominates. The film is approximately 0.14 mm thick and covered with a protective film. No sample was submitted. Findings: Other sheets, plates, films, foils, tapes, and strips, not of cellular plastics, neither reinforced nor laminated or similarly bonded to other materials, without a backing; of ethylene polymers; with a thickness greater than 0.125 mm; other; other; other

Applicant's information: Dextrin powder. Findings/investigations on a sample: White, flour-fine powder. The powder is soluble in water; no starch is visible microscopically. The measured DE value is approximately 7.6% by weight (based on the dry matter). Finding: Dextrins with a dextrose equivalent of less than or equal to 10%.

The article illustrated by data sheets and a material sample is a so-called "pasture tent" (dimensions approx. 610 x 370 x 250 cm), consisting of: - a prefabricated, one-piece roof and side panels made of a woven fabric coated on both sides with plastics as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39, the plastic coating being visible to the naked eye; and - a frame made of base metal and assembly materials necessary for construction. The tent serves as a mobile, seasonal shelter for horses, sheep, or cows and can also be used for the temporary storage of straw, hay, or machinery in the pasture. The panels made of cut plastic film, in particular with regard to their use (protection from the elements), define the character of the unassembled product. According to the applicant, the product is packaged in a box and is classified under customs tariff law as "other goods made of plastics, other than those specified in subheadings (CN) 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".

Xenon enriched with xenon-129 isotope. The product is characterized as a colorless gas. According to the information provided, it is xenon with a purity of more than 99.99% by weight, enriched with the xenon isotope 129Xe to a concentration of 80 at% or more. The xenon isotope 129 is registered under CAS number 13965-99-6. The product is traded in pressurized gas cylinders and used for hyperpolarization and magnetic resonance measurements. Based on its chemical composition, the product is to be classified under subheading 2845 9090 of the Combined Nomenclature as isotopes (excluding isotopes of heading 2844); inorganic or organic compounds of these isotopes, even if chemically non-uniform; other; other.

Boron trifluoride enriched with boron-11 isotope. The product is characterized as a colorless gas. According to the information provided, it is chemically homogeneous boron trifluoride with a purity of more than 99.99% by weight, enriched with the boron isotope 11B to a content of more than 99.9% at. The product is registered as a chemical under CAS number 20654-88-0. According to the information provided, it is used for semiconductor manufacturing. Based on its chemical composition, the product is to be classified under subheading 2845 9090 of the Combined Nomenclature as isotopes (excluding isotopes of heading 2844); inorganic or organic compounds of these isotopes, even if not chemically homogeneous; other.

Germanium tetrafluoride, enriched with germanium-72. The product is characterized as a colorless gas. According to the information provided, it is germanium tetrafluoride with a purity of 99.9% by volume or more, enriched with the germanium isotope 72Ge to a content of 50 to 53 at% or 55 to 58 at%. The product is used for semiconductor manufacturing. Based on its chemical composition, the product is to be classified under subheading 2845 9090 of the Combined Nomenclature as isotopes (excluding isotopes of heading 2844); inorganic or organic compounds of these isotopes, even if not chemically homogeneous; other; other.

A so-called pin made of drive steel, essentially consisting of an approximately 8 mm long, base metal product manufactured according to a technical drawing, with several steps and a hole on one end. This pin serves to fix the position of the rack in the housing of a mechanical dial gauge for measuring geometric quantities (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision). Due to its specific dimensions and shape, it is a recognizable part for these dial gauges. (See illustration in the annex.) The goods are classified as "a part, recognizably intended primarily for use in an apparatus for measuring or checking, not elsewhere specified or included in Chapter 90."

A toy in the form of a dinosaur construction kit – made of plastic, assembled with dimensions of approximately 7 x 5 x 4.5 cm – consisting of eight parts, some of which are painted – the components are designed to fit together and are not suitable for playing with on their own – includes illustrated instructions, the back of which shows all available dinosaurs in the series – intended for children's entertainment – ​​the parts are packaged in a bag containing slime (DEBTI-22639/26-2) and two stickers (DEBTI-22639/26-3), inside a plastic egg with a protruding bone, for individual sale.
