All components are classified separately because the goods do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to perform a particular activity and therefore do not constitute a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b). Classification as a combination within the meaning of Note 4 to Chapter 95 is also not possible due to the mass of the slime and the size of the stickers compared to the size of the construction kit. Therefore, all components must be classified separately. For customs tariff purposes, the goods are classified as "toys, kits, made of plastic other than those covered by subheadings (CN) 9503 0010 to 9503 0030".

The goods in question are slime in the form of a moist, slightly sticky, greenish, and non-stable mass. It is intended to elicit disgust or shock upon viewing or touching. The slime is packaged in a printed plastic bag containing parts of a dinosaur model kit (DEBTI-22639/26-1). The slime, along with the model kit, instructions, and two stickers (DEBTI-22639/26-3), is packaged together in a plastic egg with a protruding bone and a plastic band for individual sale. All components are classified separately because the goods do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to carry out a particular activity and therefore do not constitute a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b). Classification as a combination within the meaning of Note 4 to Chapter 95 is also not possible due to the mass of the slime and the size of the stickers compared to the size of the model kit. Therefore, all components must be classified separately. For customs tariff purposes, the goods are classified as "entertainment articles, other than Christmas articles".

These are two irregularly shaped stickers (dimensions approximately 4.0 x 4.0 cm and 4.5 x 3.5 cm, respectively) made of several layers of plastic and a core layer of cellular plastic (not flat products of heading 3919), intended for decorative purposes. Each sticker is printed in color on the front with an image of a dinosaur head, has a self-adhesive backing, and is mounted on a backing paper. The stickers are packaged together with a dinosaur model kit with instructions (DEBTI-22639/26-1), the parts of which are contained in a bag of slime (DEBTI-22639/26-2), in a plastic egg with a protruding bone, for individual sale. All components are classified separately because the goods do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to carry out a particular activity and therefore do not constitute a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b). Classification as a combination within the meaning of Note 4 to Chapter 95 is also not possible due to the mass of the slime and the size of the stickers compared to the size of the kit. Therefore, all components must be classified separately. Such goods, as "other printed matter, other than that of TARIC code 4911 91 00 10", fall under TARIC code 4911 91 00 90.

So-called measuring probes for dial gauges, essentially consisting of a brass product approximately 10 mm long, which has a thin thread (M 2.5) on one end and a slightly thicker, knurled cylindrical body on the other, into which a steel ball is pressed. The product is installed in a dial gauge (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision) and serves there as a probe element that contacts the test object and thereby performs the measurement. (See illustration in the annex.) The product is classified as "a part, identifiable as being primarily intended for use in an apparatus for measuring or testing, not elsewhere specified or included in Chapter 90."

Blood glucose meter, in the form of a retail package, essentially consisting of: - a portable, battery-operated blood glucose meter, measuring 95 x 53 x 15 mm and weighing 52 g (see illustration in the appendix), with an LCD display for showing the blood glucose value, with a measuring range of 20 to 630 mg/dL or 1.1 to 35.0 mmol/L (depending on the model), three operating buttons, a measurement memory, an automatic shut-off function, and an insertion slot for the test strip; - a lancing device; - 10 lancets; - 10 test strips; - a battery; - a USB cable; - instructions for use; a quick start guide; a blood glucose logbook; and - a case suitable for long-term storage. To determine the blood glucose value, a drop of blood is applied to the test strip inserted into the designated slot of the meter. The measurement is performed using an electrochemical process in which the glucose is oxidized by an enzyme. The resulting electrical current is proportional to the blood glucose level, the measured value of which is displayed. The components of the product are packaged together in a carton. The product is classified as "medical electrodiagnostic device, not covered by subheadings (CN) 9018 1100 to 9018 1910".

A so-called blood glucose meter, in the form of a retail package, essentially consisting of: - a portable, battery-operated blood glucose meter (approx. 94 x 52 x 14 mm, approx. 50 g in weight), which is essential for its use (see illustration in the appendix), with an LCD display for showing the blood glucose level, with a measuring range of 20 to 630 mg/dL or 1.1 to 35.0 mmol/L depending on the model, three operating buttons, a measurement memory, an automatic shut-off function, and an insertion slot for the test strip; - a lancing device; - 10 lancets; - 10 test strips; - a battery; - a USB cable; - instructions for use, quick start guide, blood glucose logbook; and - a case suitable for permanent storage. To determine the blood glucose level, a drop of blood is applied to the test strip inserted into the designated slot of the meter. The measurement is performed using an electrochemical process in which the glucose is oxidized by an enzyme. The resulting electrical current is proportional to the blood glucose level, the measured value of which is displayed. The components of the product are packaged together in a carton. The product is classified as "medical electrodiagnostic device, not covered by subheadings (CN) 9018 1100 to 9018 1910".

A so-called blood glucose meter, in the form of a retail package, essentially consisting of: - a portable, battery-operated blood glucose meter, measuring 47 x 85 x 14 mm and weighing 43 g (with batteries), with an LCD display for showing the blood glucose level, operating buttons, and an illuminated insertion slot for the test strip; - a lancing device with an AST cap; - 5 lancets; - 5 test strips; - batteries; - instructions for use, quick start guide, blood glucose logbook; - a case suitable for long-term storage; and - a USB cable. (See illustration in the appendix.) To determine the blood glucose level, a drop of blood is applied to the test strip inserted into the designated slot of the meter. The measurement is performed using an electrochemical process in which the glucose is oxidized by an enzyme. The amount of electrical current generated is proportional to the blood glucose level, the measured value of which is displayed. The components of the product are packaged together in a carton. The product is classified as "medical electrodiagnostic equipment, not covered by subheadings (CN) 9018 1100 to 9018 1910".

A so-called blood glucose meter, in the form of a retail package, essentially consisting of: - a portable, battery-operated blood glucose meter, measuring 52 x 95 x 16 mm and weighing 44 g (with batteries), with an LCD display for showing the blood glucose level in mmol/L, several operating buttons, and an illuminated insertion slot for the test strip; - a lancing device with an AST cap; - 10 lancets; - 10 test strips; - batteries; - instructions for use, quick start guide, blood glucose logbook; - a case suitable for long-term storage; and - a USB cable. (See illustration in the appendix.) To determine the blood glucose level, a drop of blood is applied to the test strip inserted into the designated slot of the meter. The measurement is performed using an electrochemical process in which the glucose is oxidized by an enzyme. The amount of electrical current generated is proportional to the blood glucose level, the measured value of which is displayed. The components of the product are packaged together in a carton. The product is classified as "medical electrodiagnostic equipment, not covered by subheadings (CN) 9018 1100 to 9018 1910".

So-called infrared heat lamp, essentially consisting of a 27.0 x 28.5 x 19.5 cm tabletop unit weighing approximately 1.5 kg, with side handles on the swiveling housing, a ceramic glass panel, a 300-watt halogen lamp as the light source, a two-meter power cord, control buttons, and a timer for automatic shut-off after the set time has elapsed. (See attached image.) The product has an irradiation field of 30 x 40 cm and is used for irradiating the human body for heat therapy that promotes blood circulation, for example, in cases of colds, muscle tension, or ENT disorders (e.g., sinusitis). The product is classified as a "medical device, infrared irradiation device."

"Blasting media" These are products made of aluminum alloys (EN-AW 6060, EN-AW 5056 and EN-AW 5019) in the form of cylindrical or rounded wire granules (granules) with sizes ranging from approximately 0.6 mm to 1.6 mm. Electrolytic aluminum is used as the raw material for production. After melting and subsequent atomization, it is shaped (extruded). The cooled aluminum wire is drawn over dies to obtain a specific cross-section and finally cut to the appropriate size by a machine. The products serve as blasting media for surface treatment and are packaged loose in big bags per ton. - Applicant information - See attached image. Due to their size, they are not considered aluminum powders as defined by [relevant regulations/standards]. Heading 7603. Such products are classified as "other (than those specified in headings 7616 1000 10 0 to 7616 9990 91 0) aluminum goods" under heading 7616 9990 99 0 of the Customs Tariff.

According to the application details and the submitted product sample, the product is a set of goods packaged for retail sale (cardboard box with printed band), consisting of: - an arm attachment with loop openings, an L-shaped support arm with a locking pin, an axially movable rotating disc, and an approximately cylindrical pin (so-called yarn pin) made of green, molded plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39; - an elastic armband made of textile materials with a plastic buckle for fastening to the forearm; and - a storage bag made of textile materials with a drawstring. The disassembled product is used for the controlled unwinding of, for example, wool (not the subject of this inquiry) during knitting or crocheting. The nature of the product, which is composed of various materials, is determined in particular by the extent and significance of the plastic in relation to its use. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "other plastic goods not covered by CN subheadings 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".

A so-called secondary ion mass spectrometer, essentially consisting of: - Ultra-high vacuum chambers with vacuum pumps and measuring tubes - Vacuum manipulator for sample positioning - Video cameras for sample observation - Ion sources for exciting secondary ion emission - Ion sources for layer-by-layer ablation of the sample - Electron source for charge compensation - Time-of-flight mass spectrometer for mass analysis of the secondary ions - Detectors for detecting the generated secondary ions and electrons - Integrated control cabinet for the power supply electronics with connected workstation (computer). The individual components are connected to each other via cables and form a functional unit. The device is used for the chemical surface and micro-area analysis of solids of varying composition, achieving a mass resolution of > 25,000 and a lateral resolution of the liquid metal ion source of < 50 nm. The goods are classified as "instrument for physical or chemical analysis, not covered by subheadings (CN) 9027 1010 to 9027 5000, as a mass spectrometer." (see illustration in the annex)

Pipe of non-alloy steel; coiled pipe. The goods are a coiled pipe of non-alloy steel (1.0345). The pipe was manufactured by longitudinal seam welding and cold drawing. The pipe length is 29 m. The pipe diameter is 17.2 mm and the wall thickness is 2.35 mm. The coiled pipe has a diameter of 277 mm and a height of 480 mm. The ends each have a threaded connection. The coiled pipe is used as a heating coil in high-pressure pumps. According to its material properties, the goods are classified under subheading 7306 3077 of the Combined Nomenclature as: Other pipes and hollow sections (e.g., welded, riveted, folded or with simply butted edges), of iron or steel, other; welded, of circular cross-section, of iron or non-alloy steel, other; other; of an outside diameter of 168.3 mm or less, other.

The product described as an "Industrial-Line tool trolley" is a mobile piece of furniture made of cold-rolled steel, measuring approximately 67.5 x 47.9 x 85.5 cm (W x D x H). It is a cabinet with seven stacked drawers, a plastic work surface (in this case, an EVA mat), a push handle with a support bar, perforated side panels, and four ball-bearing casters (two swivel and two fixed) with rubber coatings. Two keys are included. The steel construction, in terms of its significance for the product's use and size, defines its character. This versatile piece of furniture (e.g., for use in workshops, garages, and warehouses) is placed on the floor, can be moved using the casters, and serves to store and organize tools (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision). The goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of an office type, not a bed". Attachment: two illustrations

The product described as an "Industrial-Line tool trolley" is a mobile piece of furniture made of cold-rolled steel, measuring approximately 106 x 47 x 85 cm (W x D x H). It is a cabinet with six stacked drawers, a storage compartment including a bottom compartment with a door, a plastic work surface (here: EVA mat), a push handle with a support bar, perforated side panels, and four ball-bearing casters (two swivel casters with locking brakes and two fixed casters) with rubber coatings. Four keys are included. The steel construction, in terms of its significance for the product's use and size, defines its character. This versatile piece of furniture (e.g., for use in workshops, garages, and warehouses) is placed on the floor, can be moved using the casters, and serves to store and organize tools (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision). The goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of an office type, not a bed". Attachment: an illustration

Stainless steel pipe; coiled pipe. The goods are a coiled pipe made of stainless steel (1.4307). The pipe was manufactured by longitudinal seam welding and cold drawing. The pipe length is 29 m. The pipe diameter is 17.2 mm and the wall thickness is 2.31 mm. The coiled pipe has a diameter of 277 mm and a height of 480 mm. The ends each have a threaded connection. The coiled pipe is used as a heating coil in high-pressure pumps. Based on its material properties, the goods are classified under subheading 7306 4020 of the Combined Nomenclature as other pipes and hollow sections (e.g., welded, riveted, folded or with simply butted edges), of iron or steel, other, welded, of circular cross-section, of stainless steel, cold drawn or cold rolled.

Animal toys, see attached photo, - five pieces as a set of goods together in a cardboard folding box, open at the front and printed with a reference to dog toys according to the application, for individual sale and put together to satisfy a specific need (entertainment of pets), - made of knitted textile materials (two pieces): -- as a "gingerbread man" (approx. 27 cm x 13 cm x 7 cm): --- made of plain-colored velvet knitted fabric (front and on the "arm" ends with corresponding embroidered motifs); at the lower end with a colorful, two-strand rope made of textiles, representing "legs", --- filled with wadding and equipped with an integrated squeaker mechanism, -- as a "reindeer head" (approx. 12 cm x 8.5 cm): --- with a spherical body (Ø approx. 8.5 cm) with an integrated squeaker mechanism made of what appears to be plastic, which is completely covered with a cover of plain-colored velvet fabric; with sewn-on ears, antlers (each made of knitted velvet) and an embroidered "reindeer face", -- both assembled by joining them together, - made of rubber (two pieces): -- as a "ball" (approx. 7 cm in diameter): hollow inside, with a recess and several bone-shaped indentations, -- as a "teething ring" (approx. 12 cm in diameter): in the shape of a flower, partly with a tetrahedron pattern, with a built-in squeaker mechanism, -- both made of non-cellular thermoplastic rubber (TPR) according to the application, - made of ropes of textile materials (one piece): -- in the form of a tug toy made of a colorful, three-strand rope (approx. 1.3 cm in diameter each), knotted at the ends and fringed, around which another such rope is wound in the middle, - clearly intended for animals due to its nature and presentation, therefore not goods of heading 9503, - Among other things, due to its own intrinsic value, it is not a fixed article of heading 9505; in particular, with regard to its size, the knitted goods of textile materials, compared to the rubber and rope goods, determine the essential character of the assortment. "Other made-up articles (animal toys), of textile materials, knitted"

Pet toys, see attached photo, - five pieces as a set of goods together in a cardboard folding box, open at the front and printed with a reference to dog toys according to the application, for individual sale and assembled to satisfy a specific need (entertainment of pets), - made of knitted textile materials (two pieces): -- as a "monkey" (approx. 28 cm x 17 cm x 8.5 cm) and as a "donut with icing" (Ø approx. 11.5 cm): --- made of solid-color plush and/or velvet knitted materials (both with embroidered "faces"); The "monkey" also features a colorful, two-stranded rope made of textiles sewn into the ends of its "feet," both filled with wadding, equipped with a built-in squeaker, and assembled by joining the pieces together. Made of rubber (two pieces): -- as a "ball" (approx. 7 cm diameter): hollow inside, with a recess and several bone-shaped indentations; -- as a "three-winged boomerang" (approx. 12 cm diameter): in the shape of a flower, partly with a tetrahedron pattern, with a built-in squeaker; -- both made of non-cellular thermoplastic rubber (TPR), according to the application; - made of textile ropes (one piece): -- as a so-called "monkey's fist" (approx. 7.5 cm diameter) with an approx. 19 cm long loop; made of a knotted, colorful, three-stranded rope, approx. 1.3 cm thick; - recognizable to animals due to its nature and design. Therefore, not goods of heading 9503, - inter alia, due to their own intrinsic value, not fixed articles of heading 9505, - in particular with regard to the quantity, the knitted goods of textile materials, compared to the rubber goods and the rope goods, determine the essential character of the assortment of goods. "Other made-up articles (animal toys), of textile materials, knitted"

The goods in question are an incomplete brush. The product consists of a beechwood handle (according to the applicant) with curved plastic bristles as the insert material, depending on the model, 35 cm, 45 cm, or 65 cm wide. A fitting for a handle is located at the top (not the subject of the binding tariff information decision). The goods possess the essential characteristics of a brush and are intended for household cleaning. The product is to be classified as "brush, other than those covered by subheadings (CN) 9603 1000 to 9603 9010, brushes for household cleaning".

According to the application and the submitted sample, the goods in question are so-called "star bows" in various sizes and colors, each consisting of: - a strip of synthetic yarn approximately 10 or 15 mm wide (due to the strip width exceeding 5 mm, this constitutes a product (strip) of Chapter 39), - folded or rolled into a rosette and held together with a base metal staple, - with a diameter of approximately 5 or 7 cm and a height of 1.5 or 2.5 cm, - and equipped with a self-adhesive pad on the back. A total of fifteen bows (9 small, 6 large) in three colors (pink, light blue metallic, and silver) are packaged in a polybag with a cardboard insert and are intended for decorating gifts. Under customs tariff regulations, these are classified as "other goods made of plastics, statuettes and other ornamental articles".

According to the application and the submitted sample, the goods in question are so-called "star bows" in various sizes and colors, each consisting of: - a strip of synthetic spinning material approximately 10 or 15 mm wide (due to the strip width exceeding 5 mm, this constitutes a product (strip) of Chapter 39), - folded or rolled into a rosette and held together with a base metal staple, - with a diameter of approximately 5 or 7 cm and a height of 1.5 or 2.5 cm, - and equipped with a self-adhesive pad on the back. A total of fifteen bows (9 small, 6 large) in three colors (green, metallic red, and gold) are packaged in a polybag with a cardboard insert and are intended for decorating gifts. Under customs tariff regulations, these are classified as "other goods made of plastics, statuettes and other ornamental articles".

Bicycle handlebar bag, so-called premium handlebar basket bag, photo attached, - with an outer layer made of textiles, - with four plastic feet on the bottom, - with a frame made of base metal running along the top edge, - with a plastic adapter attached to the frame on the back; with an included mounting device for attaching it to a bicycle handlebar, - with two carrying handles that can be joined together, - with an open slip pocket on the front, - with a sewn-on textile cover at the top with a drawstring closure, - - lined; equipped with an inset zippered pocket inside, - with dimensions: approx. 35 cm (width) x 25 cm (height) x 25 cm (depth), - without any indication of being handmade. "Similar container, other than those specified in subheadings 4202 1110 to 4202 3900, with an outer surface of textile materials, other than those specified in subheading 4202 9291, not handmade"

Children's costume, size 110, photo attached, - assortment of goods consisting of a so-called "sleeve cape", a tie, a "magic wand" and "glasses", - assembled to satisfy a specific need and packaged together in a polybag for individual sale, - "sleeve cape": -- made of various approximately 0.4 mm thick, single-color knitted fabrics made of, according to the application, 100% polyester (synthetic chemical fibers), -- reaching below the knees (back length: approx. 89 cm), thus not a jacket or cardigan, -- with an attached hood, -- with a continuous opening at the front, only at the top edge with a Velcro closure from left to right; therefore not a dress, -- with long sleeves, therefore not a cloak within the meaning of heading 6101, -- printed with a motif ("Gryffindor crest") at chest level, -- hemmed at the bottom with an overlock stitch, -- is generally not worn over any other clothing and for protection against the weather due to its cut and design (therefore not a coat), - tie: -- in a tied form; approximately 23 cm long and 6 cm wide, -- made of a two-layer textile product, -- with a sewn-on elastic band with a hook-and-loop fastener for fastening at the neck, -- made by joining pieces, - "wand": -- approximately 34 cm long; made of plastic, - "spectacles": -- with a plastic frame; Without glasses, - particularly with regard to its size, the so-called "sleeve cape" determines the essential character of the goods set, - as a mask costume made of textile materials, it does not belong to the goods covered by heading 9505. "Clothing, other than that specified in headings 6101 to 6113, knitted or crocheted, of man-made fibres"

This is a pad of 24 connected double pages (dimensions: approximately 21 x 21 cm), bound together on the left edge with adhesive binding. Some of the content is only visible when the back cover is removed. Each double page is printed on the outside with the number 1 to 24 and illustrations, and on the back with puzzles, recipes, craft ideas, or interesting facts. Inside each double page is an illustrated story for reading aloud. This product is intended to decorate the 24 days of Advent before Christmas for children aged seven and up and is packaged in a printed cardboard box along with 19 ornaments with neutral images (DEBTI-23847/26-2), three ornaments with Christmas motifs (DEBTI-23847/26-3), and one ornament with lettering (DEBTI-23847/26-4). Classification as a set of goods put up for individual sale is not possible, as the pad of texts for reading and the tags do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to carry out a particular activity. Consequently, all components of the set must be classified separately. See illustration in the annex. Such goods fall under tariff code 4901 99 00 00 9 as "text-characterized booklets and similar printed matter intended for reading."

These are 19 irregularly shaped tags made of thin cardboard, printed on both sides with comic-style illustrations in color. They are punched out of five pre-cut sheets (dimensions: approximately 21 x 21 cm). The tags have a hole at the top and are intended for decorative use. The goods are packaged in a printed cardboard box together with a notepad (DEBTI-23847/26-1), three tags with Christmas motifs (DEBTI-23847/26-3), and one tag with lettering (DEBTI-23847/26-4). Classification as a set of goods put up for individual sale is not possible, as the notepad and the tags do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to carry out a particular activity. Consequently, all components of the set must be classified separately. See attached illustration. Such goods are classified as "other prints (image prints), other than those mentioned in code number 4911 91 00 10 0" under code number 4911 91 00 90 0 of the customs tariff.

These are three irregularly shaped tags made of thin cardboard, printed on both sides with Christmas motifs (here: Christmas tree, Santa Lucia, horseman with a Santa hat). They are punched out of two pre-cut sheets (dimensions: approximately 21 x 21 cm). The tags have a hole at the top and are intended for decoration during Advent. Due to their motif and the inclusion of Christmas elements, they are clearly intended for decorative use only during the Christmas season. The items are packaged in a printed cardboard box along with a pad (DEBTI-23847/26-1), 19 tags with neutral printed images (DEBTI-23847/26-2), and one tag with lettering (DEBTI-23847/26-4). Classification as a set of goods put up for individual sale is not possible, as the notepad and the pendants do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to carry out a particular activity. Consequently, all components of the set must be classified separately. See attached illustration. Such goods fall under tariff code 9505 10 90 00 0 as "Christmas articles, not of glass".

This is an irregularly shaped tag made of thin cardboard, printed in color on both sides with lettering. It is punched out of a pre-cut sheet (dimensions: approximately 21 x 21 cm). The tag has a hole at the top and is intended for decorative use. The item is packaged in a printed cardboard box together with a pad (DEBTI-23847/26-1), 19 tags with neutral printed images (DEBTI-23847/26-2), and three tags with Christmas motifs (DEBTI-23847/26-3). Classification as a set of goods presented for individual sale is not possible, as the pad of texts and the tags do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to facilitate a particular activity. Consequently, all components of the set must be classified separately. See attached illustration. Such goods are classified as "prints other than those listed in the aforementioned code numbers" under code number 4911 99 00 00 0 of the customs tariff.

Glassware for interior decoration, so-called Waterworld plants in a glass cylinder, photo see annex, no sample was submitted, classification is based on the information provided in the application, - in the form of a cylindrical container, - made of clear glass; without any indication of glass-ceramic, lead crystal or manual glass removal, - open at the top; with a preserving jar lid and a seal apparently made of plastic, - with a live plant attached to a ceramic ring at the bottom of the container (does not meet the conditions for classification under heading 0602), - with a plastic fish placed inside the container, - filled with water, - the glass, due to its importance in terms of use and value, determines the essential character of the goods. "Glassware for interior decoration, neither of glass-ceramic nor of lead crystal, not handmade"

A so-called finger rest, in the form of an oval, ribbed plastic plate as a support surface for the fingers of the injecting hand, with a central, precisely fitting opening for the plunger of a glass syringe used for injecting medicinal solutions. (See illustration in the annex.) The goods are classified as "part identifiable as being primarily intended for use with a medical glass syringe".

Connector, essentially consisting of a plastic housing with four internal metal contact pins on one side and the corresponding number of angled protruding contact pins for printed circuit board mounting on the opposite side, for a voltage of less than 1000 V, for establishing an electrical connection by inserting a corresponding mating part after mounting (soldering) on ​​a printed circuit board. The goods are to be classified as "electrical device for connecting electrical circuits, for a voltage of 1000 V or less, connector for printed circuit boards". Attachment: 1 Figure

Stainless steel cable with threaded ends. The goods are a 900 mm long, flexible, plastic-coated stainless steel cable with a diameter of 1.5 mm (2.0 mm including the coating). Brass end pieces with M4 threads for attaching brushes are fitted to both ends of the cable. The stainless steel cable is a defining characteristic. The goods are used for cleaning pipes. The goods are to be classified under TARIC code 7312 9000 00 as rope loops and similar articles of iron or steel, excluding insulated electrical products, other.

Similar container, see attached photo, - with an outer surface made of plastic film, - with a flap closure with a snap fastener, - unlined; inside equipped with an open slip pocket and two flaps, each with a snap fastener, for attaching small pieces of jewelry, - with dimensions: approx. 6 cm (width) x 5 cm (height) x 2 cm (depth), - fitted with a carabiner hook made of base metal attached to an eyelet, - not classified as a bag or handbag item due to the attachment method. "Similar container, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 4202 1110 to 4202 3900, with an outer surface made of plastic film, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 4202 9211 to 4202 9215"

The goods described as a "garden seating set" are a set presented for individual sale, consisting essentially of: - a wooden bench; 113 x 75 x 77 cm (L x W x H), - two wooden chairs; 50 x 75 x 77 cm (L x W x H), and - a wooden table; 110 x 52 x 45 cm (L x W x H). The seating is equipped with custom-fit, loose seat and back cushions and is available in cream and anthracite. A dining table is not included due to the low height. The nature of the set is determined by the number and intended use of the seating. The products are designed to be placed on the ground and are suitable for furnishing, for example, patios. The unassembled, packaged assortment of goods is to be classified as "seating furniture other than that covered by heading 9402, not covered by subheadings (HS) 9401 10 to 9401 59, with a wooden frame, upholstered". Attachment: an illustration

So-called universal safety plug, consisting of a specifically shaped plastic housing with a removable plastic cap, a plug on one side and a cable connection on the opposite side, and an integrated, replaceable fuse, for a voltage of 12 V, for automotive cigarette lighters (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision), for making an electrical connection after the assembly of a cable by inserting a corresponding mating contact (characteristic main activity of the combined machine) and for protecting electrical circuits or connected loads. The goods are to be classified as "electrical device for connecting electrical circuits, for a voltage of 1000 V or less, plug, other than for coaxial cables or for printed circuits, not for specific aircraft, other than those specified in TARIC subheadings 8536 6990 82 to 8536 6990 86". Annex: 1 Figure

Light alloy wheels, so-called blanks, - according to the application: - - in the form of specifically manufactured, un-tired, one-piece wheels made of an aluminum alloy, - - in various sizes and designs, - - not yet fully machined (blanks): - - - are not used unchanged, - - - have approximately the shape of the finished wheels and - - - are used only for the manufacture of the wheels, - - - the still missing openings for wheel bolts (so-called bolt circle) and engravings, as well as the not yet correct size of the center hole and the not yet correct offset depth, are harmless for classification as unfinished wheels, since the blanks in their present state already have the essential characteristics of finished wheels, - - intended for use on passenger cars and trailers, - - are (in the finished state) attached to the flange of the wheel hub of passenger cars and trailers with wheel bolts or wheel nuts, - since the goods are within Section XVII both as parts of a passenger car (heading 8708) If items are considered both parts of a trailer (heading 8716) and a principal use cannot be determined, they are to be assigned to the heading last mentioned in the nomenclature of the equally applicable headings (8708, 8716), provided that, based on their objective characteristics (including shape and dimensions), they are clearly intended primarily for means of transport of Chapter 87. "Parts (wheels) of trailers of heading 8716"

According to the applicant's information and the submitted sample, the product is a Christmas stocking. The approximately 17 x 12.5 cm open-topped, fillable product consists of sewn-together colored pieces of woven fabric (felt) and is decorated on the front – depending on the version – with Santa Claus, a snowman, or a reindeer (Rudolph), as well as the words "Merry Xmas". The product has a textile hanging loop at the top. Such products traditionally serve to decorate the Christmas festivities. A polybag filled with various sweets (see DEBTI-24237/26-2 to -4) is placed inside the stocking. Joint classification as a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b) is not possible due to the lack of a common need. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as a "Christmas article, not made of glass".

Applicant's information: Hollow chocolate figure from the article "Christmas Felt Stocking". Confidential information is available regarding the composition. Findings on samples: A hollow figure in the shape of Santa Claus (height: approx. 10 cm) made of milk chocolate; odor: chocolate; taste: sweet, milk chocolate. The hollow figure is wrapped in brightly printed metal foil. Classification: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: other: other. The goods are packaged together with other confectionery in a polybag, which is placed inside a Christmas stocking (DEBTI-24237/26-1) (see DEBTI-24237/26-3 and -4). Joint classification as a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b) is not possible due to the lack of a common need.

Confectionery; Gummy candies. The goods are gummy candies traded in a mismatched set with a felt stocking with a Christmas design, a chocolate bar, and a hollow chocolate figure (none of which are part of this binding tariff information). The gummy candies are packaged in 50g plastic foil bags. The goods should be classified under subheading 1704 9065 of the Combined Nomenclature as non-cocoa confectionery, other, other, other, gummy candies and jelly products, including fruit pastes in the form of confectionery. The goods are packaged together with other confectionery in a polybag, which is inserted into a Christmas stocking (DEBTI-24237/26-1) (see DEBTI-24237/26-2 and -4). Joint classification as a set within the meaning of General Rule 3(b) is not possible due to the lack of common demand.

Applicant's information: Chocolate bar from the article "Christmas Felt Stocking". Confidential information is available regarding the composition. Findings on samples: Milk chocolate bar (dimensions: approx. 5.5 x 2.5 x 1.5 cm), filled with a beige, creamy mass; odor: chocolate; taste: sweet, chocolate and milk cream. The bar is wrapped in brightly printed plastic film (labeling (excerpt): "choco & cream"). Finding: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other, in the form of bars, sticks or tablets: filled. The goods are packaged together with other confectionery in a polybag, which is placed inside a Christmas stocking (DEBTI-24237/26-1) (see DEBTI-24237/26-2 and -3). Joint classification as a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b) is not possible due to the lack of common demand.

Refined copper rod. According to the description, the goods are a blow-clad rod made of refined copper (Cu-HCO₃) and aluminum (Al1050). The rod has a width of 31 mm and a total thickness of 20 mm. The copper layer is 8 mm thick, and the aluminum layer is 12 mm thick. The length is 52 mm. The aluminum layer has a chamfer on both sides. The goods are used as a contact plate for the cathode system in zinc electrolysis. The copper content is predominant by weight. Based on its material composition, the goods are classified as rods and profiles of copper, of refined copper, under TARIC code 7407 1000 00.

Transport securing tube, photo see attachment, - tubular, according to the application in different lengths and widths, - on one side made of a woven band of, according to the application, 100% polyester (synthetic chemical fibers), - on the other side made of a textile laminate of heading 5903 bonded together across its entire surface, with: -- an outer layer of an embossed plastic (not cellular plastic), -- an intermediate layer of a woven textile fabric, -- another intermediate layer of a plastic (not cellular plastic), -- an inner layer of a woven textile fabric, - depending on the version, printed with inscriptions, - serves as transport securing; is placed on the tires of the vehicle to be transported and fastened by means of a lashing strap pulled through the "tube" (not subject to the binding tariff information); it thus prevents the vehicle from slipping, - manufactured by sewing together lengthwise, - without indication of handwork, - among other things. Due to its use, this does not include a conveyor belt or drive belt of heading 5910. "Other made-up articles (transport securing hose) of textile materials, of woven materials, not handmade"

A so-called mobile residual oil measuring device, presented as a retail package, essentially consisting of a measuring device whose characteristics are defined by its use, permanently installed in a specially manufactured plastic case, a power supply, a PTFE connecting hose (Ø 6 mm), an instruction manual, a calibration certificate, and a USB flash drive (all components are located in the case). The measuring device, which is operated with the case open, essentially consists of a stainless steel housing (282 x 168 x 139.7 mm) with a sample gas inlet, sample gas outlet, a touchscreen, status LEDs, a dosing chamber, a measuring chamber, a vacuum diaphragm pump, a pressure sensor, a PID sensor, a humidity sensor (for internal measurements), a power supply input, a Modbus RTU via an RS485 interface, an analog output, and other electrical, electronic, and optical components. It serves for the early detection of potential contamination in compressed air systems. For this purpose, a partial flow of compressed air is extracted from the system and directed to the PID sensor. Hydrocarbons are ionized by a special UV lamp, generating an ion current proportional to the concentration of ionized molecules. This current is amplified and converted into electronic and voltage signals. Measurement results (measuring range: 0.001 to 5.000 mg/m³) are displayed, stored internally, and can be output in both analog and digital formats. The product is classified as an "electronic gas analyzer."

Wire of non-alloy steel. The goods are cold-rolled wire of non-alloy steel (DC01). The wire has a rectangular cross-section with a width of 15.8 mm and a thickness of 2.0 mm. The goods are coiled in rings. According to the information provided, the goods are used as raw material for the manufacture of fittings. Based on its material properties, the goods are classified under TARIC code 7217 1039 00 as wire of iron or non-alloy steel, uncoated, whether or not polished, with a carbon content of less than 0.25% by weight, with a maximum cross-sectional dimension of 0.8 mm or more.

The goods described as a "storage box" are wooden furniture with dimensions (W x H x D) of 35 x 120 x 25 cm, essentially consisting of an approximately cuboid body with a small base plate at the top and bottom, a back panel at the top and bottom, and five parallel, upward-curving, and rounded recesses on the completely open front, designed to hold stools. The product, intended for floor placement, is used to furnish kindergartens or schools for storing student stools. The goods are classified as "furniture of wood other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402, without a specific spatial connection." Attachment: Illustration

The goods described as a "wall-mounted boot rack" are a piece of wooden furniture measuring 73 x 50 x 15 cm (L x H x D). They consist essentially of two L-shaped wooden profiles with holes or fixings for wall mounting, and between them two parallel wooden slats, each with ten 15 cm long, rounded rungs running diagonally upwards. The goods are intended for storing items such as boots (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision) in kindergartens or schools. The goods are classified as "furniture made of wood other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402, without a specific spatial connection." Attachment: an illustration

The product described as an "Industrial-Line tool trolley" is a mobile piece of furniture made of cold-rolled steel, measuring approximately 122 x 47.9 x 85.5 cm (W x D x H). It is a cabinet with six stacked drawers, a storage compartment with a shelf and double doors, a plastic work surface (in this case, an EVA mat), a push handle with a support bar, perforated side panels, and four ball-bearing casters (two swivel casters with locking brakes and two fixed casters) with rubber coatings. Four keys are included. The steel construction, in terms of its significance for the product's use and size, defines its character. This versatile piece of furniture (e.g., for use in workshops, garages, and warehouses) is placed on the floor, can be moved using the casters, and serves to store and organize tools (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision). The goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of an office type, not a bed". Attachment: two illustrations

The goods described as a "tool trolley" are a mobile piece of furniture made of cold-rolled steel, measuring approximately 82 x 46 x 95 cm (W x D x H). It is a cabinet with seven stacked drawers, a narrow side compartment with a lockable door, a stainless steel work surface with integrated plastic storage compartments on both sides, a push handle, and four ball-bearing casters (two swivel casters with locking brakes and two fixed casters) with rubber coatings. Two keys are included. The steel, in terms of its significance for the intended use and size, determines the nature of the goods. This versatile piece of furniture (e.g., for use in workshops, garages, and warehouses) is placed on the floor, can be moved using the casters, and serves to store and keep tools readily available (not the subject of this binding tariff information ruling). The goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of an office type, not a bed." Attachment: an illustration

Handcarts, so-called tray trolleys, photo attached, - according to the application: - - in the form of four-wheeled transport trolleys, - - made of stainless steel, - - with dimensions of: 53 x 42 x 180 cm or 60 x 39 x 180 cm, - - equipped with twelve rails for trays on the sides, - - each equipped with two vertical securing bars, - - each equipped with four swivel casters for moving the trolleys, - used in the commercial sector, in particular in the catering industry and canteens, for the transport and provision of trays with food or items on them, - are pushed by hand and primarily serve the transport of trays, therefore not furniture of heading 9403. "Other non-self-propelled vehicles (tray trolleys)"

Hand trolleys, so-called tray and shelf trolleys, photo see attachment, - essentially consisting, according to the application: - - an aluminum frame with side elements and support surfaces made of medium-density fiberboard, - - several parallel sliding guides for tray support, - - equipped with four swivel casters for moving the trolleys, - in different versions and dimensions, - - so-called single models with one-sided loading and - - so-called double models with two-sided loading, - used in commercial settings, especially in canteens, schools and hospitals, for receiving, storing, providing and transporting trays, - are pushed manually and primarily serve the transport of trays and containers, therefore not furniture of heading 9403. "Other non-self-propelled vehicles (tray trolleys)"

So-called infrared massage device, in the form of a multifunctional unit, essentially consisting of a specially shaped device with an integrated massage surface and infrared heat source in a plastic housing with power cord, controls, detachable handle, wrist strap, and two interchangeable massage attachments. (See illustration in the appendix.) The device is used for massaging the human body, which is achieved through tapping impulses (a modified form of vibration massage). Infrared heat can be added separately to the massage program. The massage function is its defining primary function. The product is classified as an "electric vibration massage device."

Sheet of non-alloy steel. According to the information provided, the goods are a flat product of non-alloy steel (Q235). The sheet has a length of 3140 mm, a width of 150 mm, and a thickness of 6 mm. It was produced by hot rolling and cutting. The goods are used, according to the information provided, as cutting guides (burning table strips) in plasma and oxy-fuel cutting systems. Based on its material properties, the goods are classified under TARIC code 7211 1400 95 as flat rolled products of iron or non-alloy steel, with a width of less than 600 mm, neither clad nor coated, hot rolled only, other, with a thickness of 4.75 mm or more, with a width of 500 mm or less, other.

Cutting table strips – a product made of unalloyed structural steel according to a technical drawing, with a nearly rectangular base and a serrated or wavy contour on one side – serve, when installed in a CNC-controlled plasma or oxyfuel cutting system, as a tool support within the cutting table to hold the workpiece in position and simultaneously allow the cutting jet to pass between the individual ribs. "Part identifiable as being solely or principally intended for use with machines of headings 8456 to 8465, not a product of TARIC codes 8466 1020 00 to 8466 9350 00 – Cutting table strips"

Applicant's description: Polyurethane film without reinforcement with other materials or cellular structure. The film has the following structure: 1) Self-adhesive polyester carrier 2) Colored glass beads embedded in polyurethane-polyester hot melt 3) Polyurethane protective film. Findings on a sample: Two rectangular sections of a gray film with glass beads embedded on one side were submitted (thickness approx. 0.185 mm). The film is covered with colorless, transparent, peelable films on both sides. The protective film on the side with the embedded glass beads is self-adhesive. Conclusion: This is a plastic film (here polyester urethane) without reinforcement. The protective films and the glass beads do not affect the classification.

A case-like container (see photo in the annex), with an outer surface made of textile materials, a carrying handle and an adjustable shoulder strap, four plastic feet, a hinged opening, a zipper running along three sides of the upper edge, lined and padded, with an internal cross-shaped divider, and measuring approximately 33 cm (width) x 26 cm (height) x 20 cm (depth). It is designed for transporting and storing a specific medical device with specific accessories. "Similar container, other than those specified in subheadings 4202 1110 to 4202 3900, with an outer surface made of textile materials, other than those specified in subheading 4202 9291."

Digital broadband radio monitoring receiver, in various versions, essentially consisting of a cuboid housing with an RF antenna input, interfaces, one or more converter modules (depending on the version), digital processing cores, memory modules, a synchronization board, status LEDs, and other electrical and electronic components (see illustration in the annex). The receiver serves to measure the high-frequency alternating electrical voltage at the RF antenna input and to determine the resulting electrical quantities, thus enabling the determination of the time course of the electrical voltage of a radio signal and the digitized output of the determined data to a higher-level unit (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision). It is intended for signal acquisition, spectrum analysis, signal recording, and technical radio monitoring. The goods are classified as "Equipment for measuring or checking electrical quantities, other than counters of heading 9028, specifically designed for telecommunications, other than subheading (HS) 9030 10 to 9030 39".

According to the application details and the submitted product sample, the product is a so-called "ultra-flat TV wall mount." The mount consists of two semicircular base plates made of plastic, as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39, which have three mounting holes and are fitted on the front with a specifically shaped retaining bracket made of base metal. The two-part wall mount is designed for permanent wall mounting using screws and serves to hold a flat-screen TV. The design of the wall mount, particularly its dimensions, is determined by the plastic material. The product, along with two wall spacers, a small spirit level, a paper ruler, assembly instructions, and the necessary mounting hardware, is packaged in a printed retail container for direct sale to the end consumer. Under customs tariff law, such products are classified as "plastic building materials not elsewhere specified or included, not covered by subheadings (CN) 3925 1000 to 3925 3000, fittings and similar goods for permanent attachment to walls or other parts of buildings".

Three-part set consisting of a cup-shaped mug, hollow chocolate figures, and pralines, so-called gift set consisting of confectionery in a mug with Easter designs, photo see annex, - presented for individual sale (the hollow chocolate figures and the pralines are placed in the mug in a clear polybag with a textile ribbon), - the goods do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to carry out a particular activity; they therefore do not constitute a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b) and must be classified separately, - cup-shaped mug (other ceramic tableware): - - glazed, square, cup-shaped mug with handle; decorated on the outside with floral motifs featuring rabbits engaged in various activities (according to the application, in two different versions), - - dimensions: approx. 7.5 cm (width) x 9.3 cm (height) x 7.5 cm (depth), - - ceramic product; fired after shaping; Containing clay mineral material, - - according to the scientific analysis, made of stoneware, - - not a ceremonial item of heading 9505, as the goods have a use value. "Other ceramic tableware (cup), made of stoneware"

Three-part assortment consisting of a cup-shaped mug, hollow chocolate figures, and pralines, so-called gift set consisting of confectionery in a mug with Easter designs, see photo in the annex, - presented for individual sale (the hollow chocolate figures and the pralines are placed in the mug in a clear polybag with a textile ribbon), - the goods do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to carry out a particular activity; they therefore do not constitute a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b) and must be classified separately, - Hollow chocolate figures: - - in the form of three egg-shaped hollow figures, - - made of milk chocolate (smell: of chocolate; taste: sweet, of milk chocolate), - - in the dimensions: approx. 5 cm x 3 cm, - - the products are individually wrapped in yellow, pink, or turquoise metallic foil. "Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations, other, chocolate and chocolate products, other, unfilled"

Three-part set consisting of a cup-shaped mug, hollow chocolate figures and pralines, so-called gift set consisting of confectionery in a mug with Easter designs, photo see attachment, - presented for individual sale (the hollow chocolate figures and the pralines are placed in the mug in a clear polybag with a ribbon made of textiles), - the goods do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to carry out a specific activity; They do not constitute a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b) and must be classified separately. - Chocolates: - - in the form of three cuboid, bite-sized products made of milk chocolate, - - - filled with a light beige, firm cream, in the style of chocolates (smell: of chocolate; taste: sweet, of milk chocolate and milk cream), - - in the form of two cuboid, bite-sized products made of milk chocolate, - - - filled with a light brown, firm cream, in the style of chocolates (smell: of chocolate; taste: sweet, of milk chocolate and nougat), - - in the dimensions: approx. 3.5 cm x 2 cm x 1.5 cm, - - the chocolates are individually wrapped in light green or green printed metal foil (labeled: "Milk cream" or "nougat cream"). "Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations, other, chocolate and chocolate products, pralines, whether or not filled, other"

Applicant's description: So-called teat liner (rubber or soft rubber), consisting of a dimensionally accurate, specifically shaped, flexible rubber tube manufactured according to a drawing, with a total length of approximately 300–340 mm and an outer diameter of approximately 50–62 mm, as well as an integrated head for attachment and sealing in the teat cup and a milk hose section (straight or angled), for use as a teat liner after installation in the teat cup of a milking machine. No product sample was submitted. The product was illustrated by photographs and technical drawings. These show that it is a tapered product with an integrated attachment and sealing head. Finding: This is a different product made of soft rubber.

Clothing cover, see attached photo, - with an outer layer made of textiles, - with a small insert pocket made of clear plastic film, - with a hanging loop at the top, - foldable in two; the two halves can be connected by two plastic buckles and two hook and loop fasteners, - when folded, each with a sewn-on carrying handle at the top, - with a zipper running along three sides of the inside, - lined; inside equipped with a slip pocket with a flap closure and three retaining straps with hook and loop fasteners, - with dimensions (unfolded): approx. 73 cm (width) x 235 cm (height) x 3 cm (depth), - intended for the transport and storage of clothing (protective suit). "Similar container, other than those specified in subheadings 4202 1110 to 4202 3900, with an outer surface of textile materials, other than those specified in subheading 4202 9291"

A so-called video processor, packaged as a retail kit, consists of a video processor whose essential function is to provide visual feedback, a white balance adjustment device, five different cables, two software CDs, two fuses, and an instruction manual. The processor, a roughly cuboid-shaped device, is operated via touchscreen or keypad and features an electrical connector with a locking lever and an endoscope socket for a video endoscope, an integrated air/water pump, a connection socket for a water bottle unit to irrigate the organ under examination, an LED light source, a USB port on the front, and various electrical connections on the rear. The video processor is used for processing and optically displaying image information during endoscopic diagnostics and therapy performed by physicians. The components of the kit are packaged together. The goods are classified as "parts identifiable as being primarily intended for medical endoscopes."

Application details (assumed to be correct): Fruit juice mixture with fruit purees, chamomile flower extract, and cocoa powder, packaged for retail sale (500 ml bottle). Alcohol: not included. Products or fats from products of headings 0401 to 0404: not included. Sucrose or invert sugar: included. Characteristics of the submitted sample: brown, cloudy, free-flowing liquid with finely dispersed fruit fiber particles. Taste: sweet, fruity, slightly acidic with a cocoa note. Due to the added cocoa, the product has lost the character of a fruit juice diluted with water. Non-alcoholic beverage, other than those specified in UPos 2202 1000 to 2202 9915 of the CN, containing sugar (sucrose or invert sugar), other.

Cable reel (see illustration in the annex) – consisting of a mechanical cable reel construction with shields made of galvanized sheet steel, a drum body, a rope clamp, deep groove ball bearings, brass slip rings and insulating discs made of plastic, as well as brush holders, with a separately mounted rope drum – when installed in a winding device and fitted with a rope and counterweight, it is used in locations with harsh environmental conditions (e.g., at extreme temperatures) for winding and unwinding ropes or cables and for the continuous transmission of current between a stationary connection and a rotating drum. "Part, identifiable mainly or exclusively for machines with an independent function, not elsewhere specified or included in this chapter, not a product of subheadings (CN) 8479 9015 to 8479 9020 – cable reel"

A so-called Coriolis transmitter, available in various versions, is sold as a retail package consisting of the transmitter itself, which is the defining characteristic of the product, and a sensor cable. The transmitter essentially comprises a cylindrical aluminum housing (Ø: 110 x L: 203 or 205 mm, depending on the version) with a backlit LCD, four operating buttons, and two status LEDs on the front. On the back are connection terminals (analog inputs and outputs, sensor input, power supply, digital interface, etc.), cable glands, a microprocessor, and other electrical and electronic components (see illustration in the appendix). The transmitter receives induction signals from a Coriolis flow sensor (the main product, not the subject of this binding tariff information decision). These signals are converted, scaled, displayed, and output in analog (4-20 mA) and digital (pulse signal) formats to a higher-level unit (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision). As a display and evaluation unit, it enables the visualization of signals from the connected sensor (main product), the calculation of other measured values, and their analog and digital output. The goods are packaged in a cardboard box along with operating instructions. The goods are classified as "accessories, identifiable as being primarily intended for use with a device for measuring or monitoring the flow of liquids, not covered by headings 9014, 9015, 9028 or 9032".

Intrinsically safe power supply (see illustration in the annex), consisting of a printed circuit board containing, among other things, resistors, capacitors, transistors and electronic integrated circuits, in a housing with LED status and control indicators and electrical connections, for amplifying and galvanically isolating incoming signals in potentially explosive atmospheres (characteristic main activity) and for signaling a line break or short circuit. "Electrical device with its own function, not elsewhere specified or included in Chapter 85 (combination of signal isolator/amplifier - characteristic main activity - and visual signaling device), not covered by subheadings (CN) 8543 1000 - 8543 7060"

Cargo bike trailer, so-called multifunctional cargo trailer, photo see attachment, - according to the application: - - made of an aluminum frame with a stable base plate made of rigid plastic, - - with two air-filled 20-inch rubber wheels on metal or aluminum spoked rims with plastic hubcaps, - - with a textile cabin body and removable canopy made of synthetic fiber polyester fabric, - - with a drawbar and coupling system made of structurally rigid steel or coated metal with elastic functional elements for mechanical traction transmission, - in various model versions: - - with the dimensions: passage width 71 cm, cabin height 61.5 cm – 75 cm, overall length 120 cm - 133 cm, - - maximum load capacity of luggage of 40 kg – 49 kg and a packing volume of 130 liters – 220 liters, - without wagon set, - intended for the transport of goods. "Trailer for all types of vehicles, not a caravan, not for agricultural purposes, trailer for transporting goods, without a tank body, not intended for transporting goods with high radioactivity, new, not a semi-trailer (bicycle trailer)"

The furniture set described as "Polyrattan Corner Lounge XXL Black/Anthracite" is a product package intended for individual sale, consisting primarily of: - a table measuring approximately 70 x 70 x 40 cm (L x W x H), - six upholstered seating options in the form of a seating group with backrests measuring approximately 280 x 210 x 70 cm (L x W x H), and two individual seating elements measuring approximately 70 x 70 x 40 cm (L x W x H). The seating is equipped with precisely fitting, loose, anthracite-colored seat and back cushions. Both the seating and the table each have an aluminum frame completely covered with a black synthetic rattan-style wicker. The table features a removable glass top and, due to its low height, is not designed for eating while seated on the accompanying seating. The nature of the goods assortment is determined by the number and intended use of the seating furniture. The products are intended to be placed on the ground and are used, for example, to furnish terraces. The unassembled, packaged goods assortment is to be classified as "seating furniture other than that covered by heading 9402, not covered by subheadings (HS) 9401 10 to 9401 69, with a metal frame, upholstered." Attachment: an illustration

A housing component for a blood pressure monitor, essentially consisting of an approximately 48.4 mm long cast part made of aluminum alloy, specially manufactured according to a technical drawing. The part, which is conical on one side and has an opening (approximately 65 mm in diameter), comprises a mounting surface and several holes for attachment and serves as a frame for the measuring mechanism of an analog blood pressure monitor with a bellows. See the attached illustration. The goods are classified as a "part identifiable as being primarily intended for a medical blood pressure monitor".

Applicant's description: A light yellow film/flat product made of cellular plastic (polyurethane foam). Non-adhesive and contains no abrasives. Findings on a sample: A rectangular section (approx. 210 x 160 mm; approx. 1.3 mm thick) of an ochre-colored film made of a cellular material was submitted. Conclusion: It is a different film, made of plastics, cellular plastic, polyurethane, or soft foam.

A so-called high-resolution time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometer, essentially consisting of: - ultra-high vacuum chambers with vacuum pumps and measuring tubes, - a vacuum manipulator for sample positioning, - video cameras for sample observation, - ion sources for exciting secondary ion emission, - ion sources for layer-by-layer sample removal, - an electron source for charge compensation, - a time-of-flight mass spectrometer for mass analysis of the secondary ions, - detectors for detecting the generated secondary ions and electrons, - a workbench with an integrated control cabinet for the power supply electronics, - a computer with software for instrument control, data acquisition, and data processing (see figure in the appendix). The individual components are connected via cables and form a functional unit. The instrument is used for the chemical surface and micro-area analysis of solids of varying composition. The lateral resolution is 80 nm, and the mass resolution is up to 17,000 amu (atomic mass unit). The goods are classified as "instruments for physical or chemical analysis, other than those covered by subheadings (CN) 9027 1010 to 9027 5000, as mass spectrometers".

A so-called seat cushion with massage function, in the form of a composite product consisting of a seat cushion and a massage device, weighing approximately 6.8 kg, essentially comprising a padded seat cushion with a 59 x 9 x 50 cm seating area and a 59 x 14 x 95 cm backrest with a fixed back frame, a neck section adjustable in height and angle, and an electrically operated massage unit located in the back and neck area, consisting of paired, rotating massage heads for mechanical massage, modeled on classic Shiatsu massage (pressure massage using fingers). The product features a spot function, two intensity levels, and is equipped with a wired control unit (functional unit). See the attached illustration. The device is used for massaging the neck and/or back area. The massage device is the defining component of the composite product with regard to its use. The goods are classified as "massage equipment, not covered by subheading (CN) 9019 1010".

A so-called Shiatsu massage cushion, essentially consisting of a cushion-like device measuring approximately 31 x 23 x 11 cm and weighing approximately 1.3 kg, with an on/off switch and a power adapter. See the attached illustration. The device has a total of four counter-rotating massage balls (so-called massage heads) arranged in pairs, which mimic the pressure and kneading movements of a Shiatsu massage. Two of the four massage balls are equipped with a switchable heat and light function, which glows red when the heat function is active. Switching on the device activates both the Shiatsu massage and the heat function. Furthermore, the cushion-like device has a removable cover and a Velcro strap for attachment. The device is used for massage (its primary function) of the neck and back or calf area, and secondarily for heat therapy (multifunctional device), which serves to enhance the massage effect by warming the muscles and tissue. The goods are packed in a cardboard box. The goods are classified as "massage device, not covered by subheading (CN) 9019 1010".

Massage cushion, so-called 4D neck massager, essentially consisting of a U-shaped neck massage cushion with a removable cover, a power adapter with cable, and instructions for use. The massager, measuring approximately 55 x 39 x 19 cm and weighing approximately 1.8 kg, is equipped with a power socket, a control panel with various buttons, two hand straps, and four rotating kneading rollers located behind a removable fabric cover. It also features two heated "clamping nodes" that mimic the pressure and kneading movements of a massage. See the attached illustration. This device, equipped with a switchable heat function (multifunctional device), is used for massaging (its defining main function) various areas of the human body (e.g., neck, back, shoulders). The goods are packaged in retail packaging. The goods are classified as "massage device, not covered by subheading (CN) 9019 1010".

Massage mat, in the form of a foldable massage mat for full-body stretching, including a power adapter and instructions. The mat, measuring approximately 127 x 55 x 10 cm and weighing approximately 5.5 kg, is equipped with seven air chambers, a headrest, a power socket, a carrying handle at the foot end, and a remote control (functional unit) connected to the mat via a cable. See attached illustration. By inflating and deflating the various air chambers, the device creates alternating pressure, thus generating a mechanical massage effect, which is the primary function of the device. Four different programs with three different intensity levels can be selected. The mat features heat and vibration functions, which can be activated individually (multifunctional device). The product is packaged in retail packaging. The product is classified as a "massage device, not an electric vibration massager."

So-called Shiatsu massage cushions, essentially consisting of a cushion-like, multifunctional device measuring approximately 40 x 40 x 10 cm, with a control button, automatic shut-off, and four pairs of rotating massage heads, which are equipped with switchable light and heat functions, as well as a power supply unit. See illustration in the annex. The device, which has a removable cover, is used for massaging (its defining main function) the shoulders, neck, back, and legs, with the rotating massage heads mimicking the pressure and kneading movements of a Shiatsu massage. The goods are packaged in a retail container with instructions for use. The goods are classified as "Massage device, not covered by subheading (CN) 9019 1010".

So-called Shiatsu foot massager, essentially consisting of a multifunctional device weighing approximately 3.1 kg and measuring approximately 37.5 x 43 x 11 cm, with a total of 18 rotating massage heads (3 x 3 per foot) that mimic the pressure and kneading movements of a Shiatsu massage, a main switch with LED, a control button, four height-adjustable feet for individually adjusting the angle of the massager, and a power cord with plug. See attached illustration. The device, which serves as the primary function for the mechanical massage of the foot reflex zones, offers two adjustable massage speeds, with the second speed setting also including a heat function. The product is packaged in a cardboard box. It is classified as a "massage device, not an electric vibration massager".

"Keychain with carabiner and bottle opener" - a free-arm, multi-component product consisting of: - a bottle opener (defining feature) made entirely of a zinc alloy, in the form of a flat, elongated rectangle, with a cap lifter in the middle and both ends formed into elongated loops; - a key ring made of base metal; - a carabiner made of a zinc alloy, one end formed into an elongated loop; - all components are connected to each other by a fabric strap through the loops; - total length: approximately 17.5 cm; - for opening bottles with crown caps; - packaged in a polybag. See attached illustration. Such products, classified as "Hand tools (household tools), not elsewhere specified or included, with a working part of base metal," fall under TARIC code 8205 5100 00.

Uranium dioxide (UO2) fuel powder. According to the information provided, the goods are an anthracite-colored, fine-grained uranium dioxide powder. The powder is enclosed in gas-tight containers for transport and is used to manufacture fuel tablets or pellets, which in turn are used to produce fuel rods for the manufacture of fuel elements for nuclear reactors. The goods are classified according to their material composition as radioactive chemical elements and radioactive isotopes (including fissile and fertilizable chemical elements or isotopes) and their compounds; mixtures and residues containing these products; uranium enriched with U-235 and its compounds; plutonium and its compounds; alloys, dispersions (including cermets), ceramic products and mixtures containing uranium enriched with U-235, plutonium or compounds of these products; uranium enriched with U-235 and its compounds. Alloys, dispersions (including cermets), ceramic products and mixtures containing uranium enriched with U 235, others classified under subheading 2844 2035 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Interior roller blinds, photo attached, - as per application, -- in various designs, -- made of approximately 0.1 mm thick, solid-color, pleated, translucent fabrics of 100% polyester (synthetic fibers), -- equipped with motorized or manual operating systems according to customer requirements, - manufactured by joining components, - the textile fabrics determine the nature of the goods in terms of their significance with regard to use and quantity. "Interior roller blinds, made of textiles, of woven fabrics, of synthetic fibers"

Heating pad, see attached photo, - composite product consisting of a heated, pillow-like cushion and a removable cover, - packaged in a printed cardboard box, - pillow-like cushion: -- approximately rectangular, with dimensions (L x W) of approx. 41.5 cm x 31.5 cm, -- with a cover made of plastic films welded together at the edges, -- with two inserted, spot-welded cushion layers made of apparently non-woven textiles, between which an electric heating element is sewn; in one corner with a socket for the detachable power supply (with slider for adjusting three heat settings) -- as a pillow-like cushion with an electric heating device, it is not covered by the goods of Chapter 85, - Cover: -- approximately rectangular, with dimensions (L x W) of approximately 47 cm x 34.5 cm, -- made of plain-colored, single-sided (outer) brushed fabrics consisting, according to the application, of 98% cotton and 2% other fibers, -- with a continuous opening on one short side with a snap fastener, -- suitable for washing and designed so that the aforementioned cushion can be easily attached or removed at any time, - in particular due to its importance with regard to use, the cushion determines the essential character of the heating pad. "Goods similar to bedding, other than those mentioned in subheadings (HS) 9404 21 to 9404 40, not filled with feathers or down"

Applicant's information: Resistant dextrin powder. White to light yellow, fine powder obtained from tapioca starch. DE equivalent < 10. Findings on a sample: White, flour-fine powder. The powder is soluble in water; no starch type is discernible microscopically. The measured DE value is approximately 8.1% by weight (based on the dry matter). Finding: Dextrins with a dextrose equivalent of less than or equal to 10%.

Long trousers, size L, see attached photo, - packaged in a polybag, - made of approximately 0.6 mm thick, solid-color fabric on the front (except for the shin areas) and on the back in the seat area; padded and partially quilted in the knee area, - made of solid-color, single-sided (inside) napped knitted fabric on the front in the shin area and on the back (except for the seat area), - both fabrics consist of polyester and elastane (both synthetic chemical fibers) according to the application, - finished at the waist with an approximately 5 cm wide, double-stitched front waistband, elasticated at the back, - without opening or closure, - without any indication of the wearer (unisex), therefore women's clothing, - with a small, inset pocket with zipper below the waistband at the front, - with ankle-length legs; Hemmed at the leg openings by folding over and sewing down, - not work or occupational clothing, - particularly with regard to the size, the woven fabrics give the goods their essential character compared to knitted fabrics, therefore, among other things, not goods of heading 6103. "Long trousers, of woven fabrics, for women, of synthetic fibers, not work or occupational clothing, not hand-printed using the batik method"

Applicant's information: This is a connector, fitting, or nozzle that is installed in a foot brake module. The connector consists of a housing, a guide sleeve, and a locking ring, all made of plastic; it also includes a soft rubber O-ring, a clamping ring, and a metal star washer. The connector is used to connect an air hose to the foot brake module. No sample was submitted. The plastic connector was illustrated by a technical drawing and product information. Finding: This is a connector (made of plastic) for pipes and hoses.

Anorak, size XXL, see attached photo, - made of approximately 0.2 mm thick, single-color fabrics made of, according to the application, 100% polyester (synthetic chemical fibers), - fully padded and lined, - weighing approximately 545 g, - extending over the crotch (back length: approximately 83 cm); shorter at the front by up to approximately 6 cm, - with a hood with drawstring, - with a full-length opening at the front with a zipper extending to the edge of the hood, with a short overlap from right to left at the top (women's clothing), - with long sleeves; with elasticated knit inserts at the sleeve ends, - with one inset chest pocket and two inset pockets below the waist, all with zippers, - decorated with a printed logo at chest height, - not tapered at the bottom hemmed edge (therefore not a blouson), - generally worn over any other clothing and for protection against the weather (therefore not a jacket). "Anorak, made of woven fabrics, for women, made of synthetic fibers, with a unit weight of less than 1 kg"

Windbreaker-like garment, size L, see attached photo, - packed in a simple drawstring bag made of textile materials, - made of approximately 0.2 mm thick printed woven fabrics of heading 5903 of textile materials, laminated on one side (inside) with a plastic film, - unlined, - extending over the crotch (back length: approximately 86 cm); rounded at the back, shorter at the front by up to approximately 7 cm, - with a stand-up collar, - with a full-length opening with a zipper at the front; with a short overlap at the collar edge from right to left (women's clothing), therefore not a product of subheading (CN) 6210 4000, - with long sleeves; The sleeves can be narrowed with hook-and-loop fasteners and are equipped with a windproof gaiter on the inside; two zippered inset pockets below the waist; reflective prints; hook-and-loop fasteners near the bottom edge; generally worn over other clothing for weather protection, therefore not a jacket. "Clothing (windbreaker-like garment), made of products of heading 5903, of woven fabrics of a type described in heading 6202"

Copper pipes. According to the information provided, the goods are pipes made of refined copper (CW024A). The pipes are bent multiple times and have an outside diameter of 4 mm or 6 mm.
