The ends are fitted with brass fittings. According to the information provided, the goods are used in the plumbing, heating, and air conditioning (PHVAC) sector. Based on their material composition, the goods are classified under subheading 7411 1090 of the Combined Nomenclature as "Pipes of copper, of refined copper, other".

Blouson, size L, see attached photo, - made of various approximately 0.2 mm thick, single-color fabrics, - with elastic knitted inserts at the elbows, sleeve ends, and lower back hem, - both woven and knitted fabrics are made of synthetic chemical fibers according to the application, - fully padded, - with a piece weight of approximately 445 g, - extending over the crotch (back length: approximately 78.5 cm); rounded at the back, shorter at the front by up to approximately 6.5 cm, - with a stand-up collar, - with a full-length opening at the front with a zipper extending to the collar points; with a short overlap at the collar edge from right to left (women's clothing), therefore not a product of heading 6201, - with long sleeves extending beyond the lower edge of the garment; Close-fitting at the sleeve ends, - with one inset chest pocket and two inset pockets below the waist, all with zippers, - with reflective prints, - adjustable hem with a drawstring, - meets the criteria for classification as a blouson, therefore not a jacket. "Blouson, made of woven fabrics, for women, made of synthetic fibers, with a unit weight of less than 1 kg"

Long trousers, size L, see attached photo, - packed in a simple drawstring bag made of textile materials, - made of approximately 0.2 mm thick, plain-colored fabrics of heading 5903 of textile materials, laminated on one side (inside) with a plastic film (not cellular plastic), - fitted at the waist; with an attached, partially elasticated waistband; with narrowing Velcro fasteners at the sides, - with an expanding insert at the front, which can be narrowed at the waistband with a snap fastener from left to right (men's clothing), therefore not goods of subheading (CN) 6210 5000, - with reflective prints, - with glued-on fabric trim on the inside of the lower legs, - with ankle-length trouser legs; fitted with narrowing Velcro fasteners at the leg openings and in the lower leg area and with zippers extending to the knees. "Clothing (long trousers), made of products of heading 5903, of woven fabrics, for men"

Applicant's information: The compressed air hose with a wall thickness of 3 mm is pressure-resistant up to 15 bar. The compressor hose also contains a fabric reinforcement, which gives the polyvinyl chloride hose additional stability and extends its service life. The air hose has a standard quick-release coupling including a hose barb, which is compatible with all common devices and machines. Length: 10, 15, or 30 meters (depending on selection). Outer diameter: 12 mm. Inner diameter: 6 mm. Connection: 1/4". Wall thickness: 3 mm. Material: Plastic; copper-plated steel. A product sample was not submitted. The light blue hose was illustrated by photographs. These also show that the flexible hose has connectors. Finding: This is a different flexible, reinforced plastic hose that cannot withstand a pressure of 27.6 MPa.

Two interconnected garments, consisting of an anorak-like garment made of fabrics of heading 5903 (outer part) and a blouson made of fabrics of chapters 54/55 (inner part), size L, see photo in the annex, - both parts are connected by zippers and a snap fastener, but can also be worn separately; separate classification of both garments, as they cannot be classified together under one heading, - anorak-like garment (outer part): -- made of various, approximately 0.6 mm thick, plain-colored fabrics of heading 5903 (therefore not goods of heading 6201) of textile materials, laminated on one side (inner side) with a film of plastic (not cellular plastic), -- fully lined, -- reaching over the waist (back length: approximately 72 cm); rounded at the back, straight at the front and up to approx. 8 cm shorter, -- with a stand-up collar, with Velcro fastening from left to right, -- with a full opening at the front with a zipper extending to the base of the collar and an overlapping flap with Velcro fastening from left to right (men's clothing), -- with long sleeves; The garment features a snap fastener and a hook-and-loop fastener adjustable in length via a reversible loop, as well as hook-and-loop fasteners at the sleeve ends; removable protectors, apparently made of plastic, are fitted in the shoulder, elbow, and back areas, some with anti-slip features; various inset and patch pockets; an internal connecting zipper for attaching to trousers; various prints, some of which are reflective; hook-and-loop fasteners at the waist and near the bottom hem allow for narrowing; and it meets the criteria for classification as an anorak-like garment, therefore not a jacket. "Clothing (anorak-like garment) made of products of heading 5903, of woven fabrics, of a type described in heading 6201"

Two interconnected garments, consisting of an anorak-like garment made of fabrics of heading 5903 (outer part) and a blouson made of fabrics of chapters 54/55 (inner part), size L, see photo in the annex, - both parts are connected by zippers and a snap fastener, but can also be worn separately; Separate classification of both garments, as they cannot be classified together under one heading, - Blouson (inner part): -- made of approximately 0.2 mm thick, plain-colored fabrics of synthetic chemical fibers (according to the application: nylon), -- with a unit weight of approximately 460 g, -- quilted throughout, padded lined, -- extending over the crotch (back length: approximately 72 cm), -- with a stand-up collar, -- with a full-length opening at the front with a zipper extending to the collar points, with a short overlap at the top edge from right to left (women's clothing), therefore not goods of heading 6201, -- with long sleeves extending beyond the lower edge of the garment; With adjustable Velcro closures at the sleeve ends, two inset open pockets below the waist, reflective prints, and a drawstring hem, this garment meets the criteria for classification as a blouson, and is therefore not a jacket. "Blouson, made of woven fabrics, for women, made of synthetic fibers, with a unit weight of less than 1 kg"

A board-to-cable connector for mounting on a printed circuit board, essentially consisting of an approximately cuboid-shaped plastic housing measuring 37 x 15 x 4 mm, with 51 internal contact pins on one side and the corresponding number of solder pins angled at 90° on the other. The product is designed for a voltage of less than 1000 V and serves to connect electrical circuits after insertion of a corresponding mating contact and mounting on a printed circuit board. The product is classified as "electrical device for connecting electrical circuits, for a voltage of less than 1000 V, connector for printed circuits". Attachment: 1 Figure

Other ceramic tableware, so-called ceramic cup, see attached photo, - white, glazed, cylindrical cup with handle, - dimensions: 8.2 cm (diameter) x 9.6 cm (height), - ceramic product, fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - according to the results of scientific analysis, it is neither porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware, nor fine earthenware; the cup is to be considered other ceramic ware. "Other ceramic tableware (cup), made of ceramic other than porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware, or fine earthenware"

The product described as a "3-in-1 toilet set" is a composite product, essentially consisting of a toilet brush and a furniture (comprising a stand and storage area) with dimensions of 20 x 16 x 66 cm. The product essentially comprises a base plate made of plastic-coated cement, from which a powder-coated iron pole extends upwards. At the top of this pole is a holder for smartphones in a suitable shape with a plastic insert, and below this is a small, powder-coated iron holder with an enlarged, rounded end for toilet paper. The stand also includes a plastic container attached to the base plate, which serves to hold a toilet brush. The toilet brush has a plastic holder and bristles, as well as a metal handle. The furniture and the toilet brush constitute a composite product, the nature of which is determined by the importance of the furniture for its intended use. The furniture is designed to be placed on the floor. This is a piece of furniture made of various materials (metal, plastic, and cement), without any single material being identifiable as giving it its distinctive character. It is therefore classified under the last of the equally applicable subheadings. There is no indication that it is handmade. The goods are classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402 and subheadings (HS) 9403 10 to 9403 83, not handmade." Attachment: 1 illustration

Other ceramic tableware, so-called ceramic cup, photo see attachment, - white, glazed, beaker-shaped cup with handle, - with a light beige area on one side from the top to the bottom rim of the cup (so-called printed area), - dimensions: 8.2 cm (diameter) x 9.7 cm (height), - ceramic product; fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - according to the results of the scientific examination, it is neither porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware nor fine earthenware; the cup is to be considered other ceramic ware. Other ceramic tableware (cup), made of ceramic other than porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware or fine earthenware.

According to the application details and the submitted sample, the product is an entertainment item in the form of a hanger with a printed spider in a spiderweb. The oval-shaped product, approximately 17 to 20 cm in diameter and 2.2 cm high, consists of a molded plastic body covered on both sides with a printed foil depicting a stylized spiderweb and a spider with illuminated LED eyes. The product features a suction cup for hanging, a battery compartment with an on/off switch, and an integrated motion sensor with a sound module. When activated, this module plays a creepy, increasingly loud howling sound (creating a surprise/startle effect). The howling sound can also be played continuously via a switch. Such products are intended as surprise items, particularly for Halloween. Under customs tariff regulations, it is classified as an "entertainment item, including magic and novelty items."

Other ceramic tableware, so-called ceramic cup, photo see attachment, - white, glazed, cup-shaped cup with handle, - dimensions: 7.4 cm (diameter) x 8.0 cm (height), - according to the application with a capacity of approx. 210 ml, - ceramic product; fired after shaping, containing clay mineral material, - according to the results of the scientific examination, it is neither porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware nor fine earthenware; the products are to be regarded as other ceramic goods, "Other ceramic tableware (cup), made of ceramic other than porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware or fine earthenware"

Scarf-like article, photo attached, - in the form of a triangular scarf, with sides measuring approximately 44.5 cm x 45 cm x 67.5 cm, - made of a rectangular, diagonally folded and sewn-at-the-edges, approximately 0.2 mm thick, plain-colored fabric made of, according to the application, 100% polyester (synthetic man-made fibers), - decorated on the front with embroidered motifs and lettering, - made by joining, without any indication of handwork, - according to the application, serves as an accessory for dogs; due to its neutral shape and dimensions, it can also be worn by humans (thus not recognizable as saddlery), - due to its intrinsic utility, it is not a festive article of heading 9505. "Scarf-like article (triangular scarf), of woven fabrics, of synthetic man-made fibers, not hand-worked"

Scarf, photo attached, - in the style of a pointed cap, with maximum dimensions (L x W) of approximately 73 cm x 10 cm, - made from a precisely manufactured, approximately 3 mm thick, single-color knitted fabric, - with a sewn-on pom-pom of contrasting yarn at the gathered end, and a loop formed by folding and sewing at the other end, through which the gathered end can be inserted, - according to the application, all textile products consist of 100% polyester (synthetic chemical fibers), - made up by joining, - according to the application, it serves as an accessory for dogs; due to its neutral shape and dimensions, it can also be worn by humans (thus not recognizable as saddlery), - due to its intrinsic utility, it is not a formal article of heading 9505 "Other made-up clothing accessory (scarf), knitted"

Applicant's description: A ready-made, ready-to-use yoga/gymnastics mat, manufactured and placed on the market exclusively for the practice of yoga, Pilates, and general physical exercise. The product consists of five firmly bonded layers: The top layer is a 0.4 mm thick layer of cork granules (175 g), which serves as the exercise surface for grip and skin contact. This is followed by a layer of solvent-free polyurethane adhesive (25 g) to bond the layers. The middle layer consists of a 0.1 mm thick polyester fabric (50 g), which provides reinforcement and dimensional stability. A further layer of EVA hot melt adhesive (25 g) bonds the middle layer to the bottom layer. This bottom layer consists of vulcanized natural rubber, black, with a thickness of 3.5 mm and a weight of 2,025 g; it forms the non-slip surface of the mat. The mat weighs approximately 2,300 g with a total thickness of approximately 4 mm and dimensions of 1,830 × 610 mm. Findings on a sample: A multi-layered mat with rounded corners was presented. The mat consists of a thick, cellular, elastic, black base layer and a thin cork top layer. A textile material is sandwiched between the layers. The mat is rolled up and equipped with a carrying strap. Findings: Other goods made of soft rubber, cellular rubber, other

"Replica of a wristwatch" - goods composed of various components, consisting of: - a watch case (characteristic element) made of base metal (steel) with four lugs and retaining pins, a metal link bracelet with folding clasp, a protective crystal, a case back, a permanently glued crown, and a rotating bezel (glass ring) (= heading 9111); - a dial, two push buttons, a minute hand, a second hand, and three chronograph hands (= heading 9114); - the watch is identical to its functional counterpart except for the missing movement, but is non-functional due to the glued-on crown; - intended for display at trade fairs and events as a sample for end customers. See attached illustration. Classification under heading 9023 is precluded due to the lack of demonstration character and because the glued-on crown renders the goods a non-functional dummy. Such products are classified as "cases of base metals for a watch of heading 9102" under TARIC code 9111 2000 00.

Feed charcoal for dogs and cats - charcoal produced from the carbonization of freshly harvested wood chips (according to the applicant) under anaerobic conditions, in granular form (particle size: < 3 mm), - packaged in 500 g or 2 kg bags, - for use as feed charcoal for dogs and cats. "Charcoal, not from bamboo, not from shells or nuts, not exported from Somalia"

Applicant's information: Resistant dextrin powder from tapioca starch. White or slightly yellowish powder. DE equivalent < 10. Findings/investigations on a sample: White, flour-fine powder. The powder is soluble in water; no starch type is discernible microscopically. The measured DE value is approximately 7.8% by weight (based on the dry matter). Finding: Dextrins with a dextrose equivalent of less than or equal to 10%.

Applicant's information: Resistant dextrin powder. White to slightly yellow powder derived from corn starch. DE equivalent < 10. Findings on a sample: White, flour-fine powder. The powder is soluble in water; no starch type is discernible microscopically. The measured DE value is approximately 7.1% by weight (based on the dry matter). Finding: Dextrins with a dextrose equivalent of less than or equal to 10%.

According to the applicant's information and the submitted sample, the product is a decorative item in the shape of a teddy bear. The item, measuring approximately 30 x 12 x 8 cm, is predominantly made of knitted fabric and is partially filled with wadding and sand. The brown bear is dressed in a sweater and a red and white scarf and wears a Santa hat. To enhance the decorative effect of this character-enhancing item, an LED is integrated into the pom-pom of the hat (battery compartment on the back of the head). Products decorated with such Christmas elements are intended to enhance the Christmas season. Due to the material composition of the goods, they are not toys within the meaning of heading 9503. For customs tariff purposes, they are classified as a "Christmas article, not of glass".

This is an assortment of four so-called lapel pins on a sales card. The goods are made of base metal. The pins consist of flat, specifically shaped plates with colored prints of various motifs and brand logos on the front. Each pin has a metal pin and a rubber clasp on the back, allowing it to be attached to clothing, bags, or other textiles. - Applicant's information - Classification under subheading 7117 9000 is not possible due to the material composition. See attached image. Such products belong to subheading 7117 1900 of the Combined Nomenclature as "other (than that specified in subheading 7117 1100) fancy jewelry of base metals".

Crane without crane bridge (see illustration in the annex) - consisting of a movable hoist with load-handling device with trolleys and rollers, headstock with drive, power supply and control system, - supplied without a steel crane bridge (crane girder) and not yet assembled, - as a kit for an overhead crane for moving loads vertically and horizontally, usually within a fixed building (e.g., assembly hall, production hall), - in a single sales unit with a control unit (supplement). The crane components determine the character of the whole. "Part, identifiable as being intended solely for equipment of heading 8426 (overhead traveling cranes), not yet assembled, not a product of subheadings (CN) 8431 4100 to 8431 4920, in a set of goods put up for retail sale with non-characteristic supplement - crane without crane bridge"

According to the application details and the submitted sample, the product is a molded plastic fastening clip as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The transparent product, measuring approximately 8.4 x 2.2 x 3.9 cm (L x W x H), has two clip arms with serrated jaws, each equipped with a metal ring acting as a spring. Additionally, one arm handle has a through-hole to which a textile cord is attached. The product serves as a universal, portable fastening clip for tying, for example, foil balloons (not the subject of this ruling). The nature of the product, which is composed of various materials, is determined in particular by the size and significance of the plastic clip arms in relation to its use. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "other goods made of plastics, other than those specified in code numbers 3926 1000 00 0 to 3926 9097 77 0".

The goods described as a "bench" are floor-standing seating furniture with dimensions of approximately 120 cm x 48 cm x 38 cm (W x H x D). The furniture consists essentially of a four-legged wooden frame and an unpadded seat made of rattan (Viennese wickerwork). Due to its importance for its use and its size, the wood determines the material character of the assembled goods. The packaged and unassembled goods are to be classified as "Seating furniture (other than that of heading 9402), other than subheadings (HS) 9401 10 to 9401 59, with a wooden frame, unpadded." (See attached image)

Tent, photo see attachment, - according to application: -- packed in a simple bag with zipper and carrying handles and in a printed cardboard box; arriving unassembled, with assembly material (ground pegs, guy ropes), -- designed as a folding pavilion; with a square base of 3 m x 3 m and a height of 2.5 m to 2.7 m (individually adjustable), -- with a foldable frame with a scissor mechanism made of apparently base metal, -- with a roof covering made of approximately 0.1 mm thick, single-color polyester fabric (synthetic chemical fibers) coated on one side (inside) with plastic (no visible cell structure), which is to be attached to the frame with Velcro straps, - the bag meets the requirements as usual packaging within the meaning of General Rule 5 b), - assembled by joining components, - meets the criteria for classification as a tent, since the goods enable the formation of an enclosed space. "Tent, made of textile materials, of synthetic chemical fibers"

The "shoe bench" is an unpadded piece of seating furniture with a rectangular wooden seat and a metal frame, combined with a lower shelf, also made of wood; overall dimensions of the packaged and unassembled goods: 100 cm x 40 cm x 41 cm (W x D x H). Due to its importance for use and its external appearance, the seating furniture determines the character of the goods, which are composed of various components. The furniture is intended to stand on the floor and serves as a furnishing in homes. Due to its design, it is suitable for use in different rooms. The goods are classified as "seating furniture other than that covered by heading 9402 and subheadings (HS) 9401 10 to 9401 69, with a metal frame, unpadded." (Image: see annex)

The goods described as a "rolling trolley" are a three-tiered table/serving/side table trolley. Measuring approximately 50 x 28 x 70 cm (W x D x H), the product consists of three stacked wooden shelves and two frames made of U-shaped metal rods, each fitted with four casters at the bottom. It serves both for short-distance transport and storage of goods, thus functioning as a mobile shelving unit. The metal frame is the defining characteristic due to its importance as a stabilizing element. The packaged goods are classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (See attached image)

The product is a wall shelf made entirely of steel with five hooks beneath the shelf. The one-piece product consists of a steel tube frame bent at a right angle and equipped with mounting holes on the back for wall attachment. The bent upper section forms the shelf. Its front edge is bent at a right angle to prevent items from falling. Five metal hooks are positioned side-by-side beneath the shelf for hanging items. The product measures approximately 40 x 11 x 10.4 cm (W x H x D). The packaged product is to be classified as "furniture of metal other than headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". See attached image.

These are so-called wine racks made of stainless steel, consisting of two rectangular frames of different sizes with rounded corners, each with a total of four crossbars. Two or three roughly cylindrical frames are attached to each of the four crossbars, connecting the two rectangular frames and serving as shelves for wine bottles. Dimensions (H x W x D): approximately 47 cm x 34 cm x 15 cm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products fall under TARIC code 7323 9300 90 as "other household articles of stainless steel". They do not fall under heading 8306, as the practical value of the products outweighs their decorative value.

These are nearly round, flat products made of steel (not stainless steel) with a raised rim. The outer surfaces are partially wavy, and the underside is fitted with circular, non-slip plastic or rubber inserts. The goods are packaged in a plastic bag and a labeled cardboard box and are intended for household use, e.g., for serving and presenting drinks or food. Total length: approximately 35 cm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products fall under TARIC code 7323 9900 90 as "other household articles of steel (not stainless steel)." They do not fall under heading 8306 because the goods are intended for everyday use.

The product described as a "decorative column" is a round wooden piece of furniture measuring 80 cm x 30 cm x 30 cm (H x W x D). The circular top surface has a raised edge and is designed to hold various items. It does not include a special holder specifically for use with plants, planters, or pots. This floor-standing piece of furniture can be used as a furnishing in different rooms of a home. The packaged goods are classified as "furniture of wood other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402, without a specific spatial connection." (See attached image.)

The goods described as a "textile shelf" are a piece of furniture on casters measuring 63 x 52 x 226 cm (L x W x H). The floor-standing unit has ten wooden shelves and a metal frame. The metal frame, which provides stability, defines the nature of the goods, which are made of various fabrics. The shelf is used for displaying goods such as textile samples (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision). The product is to be classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by TARIC subheading 9403 2080 20". Attachment: an illustration

The goods are a circular piece of furniture for wall mounting; approximately 55 x 12 cm (diameter x depth). The shelf consists of two rings connected by three offset grid panels and two crossbars, all made of metal. The product has two eyelets for wall mounting. The goods are intended for storing objects and thus for furnishing homes. The goods, which are labeled and packaged in a plastic bag, are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". See attached image.

The so-called rolling clothes rack is a floor-standing piece of furniture in the form of a clothes rack. It essentially consists of a wheeled frame measuring approximately 43 x 83 cm, made of two plastic crossbeams with four casters, upon which a metal grid is placed. Each crossbeam is fitted with two vertical metal bars, adjustable in height from approximately 93.5 cm to 170 cm, which are connected at their upper ends to a metal crossbar by means of plastic connectors along their entire length. The metal components, according to their extent and importance for the intended use, determine the nature of the goods. The unassembled goods, packaged in a cardboard box, are classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (Image: see attachment)

The so-called rolling clothes rack is a floor-standing piece of furniture in the form of a metal clothes rack. It essentially consists of a four-legged frame, approximately 43 x 83 cm in size, with two crossbars for storing items such as shoes and two vertical bars supporting a clothes rail at the top. The height is adjustable from 108 cm to 175 cm. The connecting pieces and the four casters are made of plastic. The metal components, according to their extent and importance for the product's use, determine the material nature of the assembled goods. The unassembled goods, packaged in a cardboard box, are to be classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20" (see attached image).

The "umbrella stand, mesh" is a metal piece of furniture in the form of an umbrella stand, measuring 40.5 cm x 14 cm. Packaged in a plastic bag, the item is intended to be placed on the floor and is used for holding umbrellas in entrance areas. The packaged goods are to be classified as "furniture other than headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (Image: see annex)

The product described as a "sink shelf for under-sink cabinet" is a multi-part assembly consisting of: a shelf unit, essentially comprising two U-shaped metal side supports and two basket-like inserts, each with a base and sides made of plastic; and four hooks and two side-mounted plastic cups. The shelf unit defines the product's function and appearance. Its material character is determined by the base metal components, which provide stability. The unit measures 40 cm x 18.2 cm x 40.5 cm (W x D x H) and, depending on the version, is height-adjustable from 26 to 38 cm (plus 5.5 cm edge height and 7 cm for the brackets) using telescopic rods. The product is designed to be placed on kitchen cabinets and used for storing kitchen utensils. The packaged and unassembled goods are classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (see illustration in the annex)

The "mesh magazine rack" is a floor-standing piece of metal furniture measuring approximately 39 x 17.5 x 27 cm, consisting essentially of: - two mesh-like sides - two semicircular carrying handles and - a lower shelf. Packaged in a plastic bag, the product is used in homes and serves to hold items such as magazines. The goods are classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (see illustration in the annex)

The goods described as a "freestanding shelf unit with 4 shelves" are floor-standing furniture. The shelf unit, composed of various materials, consists essentially of a metal frame and four bamboo shelves and has the following dimensions: 39 x 33 x 95 cm (W x D x H). The material character of the goods is determined by the metal, which is essential for their use as a stabilizing element. It is intended for permanent residential furnishing. The packaged goods are to be classified as "furniture other than those covered by headings 9401 and 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by TARIC subheading 9403 2080 20". Attachment: an illustration

This is a product made of various materials, in the form of a wall shelf measuring approximately 45 x 11.8 x 18 cm (L x W x H), consisting of a metal frame with two mounting points for wall attachment, a wooden shelf with a surrounding metal bracket, and a metal support below with five wooden coat hooks. The metal determines the material character of the shelf due to its importance as a stabilizing element. The piece of furniture is intended for storing items (e.g., clothing) and for furnishing wardrobes. The product is to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". See attached image.

Suspenders, pocket square, and bow tie, in adult size, see attached photo, - assortment of goods, packaged together in a cardboard box with a lid covered with transparent plastic film for individual sale and assembled to satisfy a specific need, - made of approximately 0.2 mm thick, printed fabrics of cotton according to the application, - suspenders: -- made of three bands of different lengths (2 x approx. 87 cm, 1 x approx. 42 cm) and approx. 3.5 cm wide; the long bands are reinforced on the inside with a thin non-woven fabric made of textiles, and the short band is slightly gathered with an elastic band (rubber band) made of textiles, -- sewn together in a "Y" shape; with two leather pieces covering the joint, -- the long bands with metal clips for adjusting the length, -- all ends of the bands are fitted with metal clips and leather button loops for attaching to trousers; Additionally with six button clips made of base metal, - Bow tie: -- in the maximum dimensions of approx. 11 cm x 5 cm, -- made of four strands (twice doubled); reinforced on the inside with a thin non-woven fabric made of textiles and sewn together in the middle to form a "bow tie", -- is worn around the neck with a double-layered band of fabric, with a woven-in scale on the inside, and closed with a hook fastener made of base metal; length adjustable by means of another hook made of apparently base metal, -- made up by joining the components, - Pocket square: -- square, with an edge length of approx. 26 cm, -- hemmed on all edges by folding and stitching (thus made up), -- due to its dimensions, it appears as a decorative handkerchief, - especially with regard to its circumference, the suspenders determine the character of the merchandise assortment. "Suspenders made of fabric"

Tie and pocket square, photo see attachment - assortment of goods, together in a cardboard box with a lid made of transparent plastic film, opened for individual sale and assembled to satisfy a specific need, - tie: -- up to approx. 7 cm wide and approx. 154 cm long; Tapering to a point at the ends, -- made of approximately 0.4 mm thick, colorfully woven fabrics of, according to the application, 100% silk, -- reinforced with an inserted, shape-adapted piece of double-napped fabric made of textile materials, -- equipped with a lining, -- with a sewn-on tab on the back for tucking in the narrower end when tied, -- finished by joining the pieces together, -- without any indication of being handmade, - Pocket square: -- square, with an edge length of approximately 28 cm, -- made of approximately 0.25 mm thick, colorfully woven fabrics of, according to the application, 100% silk, -- hemmed on all edges by folding and stitching (thus finished), -- due to its dimensions, it appears to be a decorative handkerchief, - the tie, particularly with regard to its size, determines the character of the goods assortment. "Tie, made of fabrics, of silk"

The goods described as a "stackable shoe rack with two shelves" are floor-standing furniture made of black metal, consisting essentially of: - two side supports forming the frame sides of the rack and - two framed, close-mesh wire shelves. The rack measures 70 x 24 x 36 cm (W x H x D) and is intended for storing items such as shoes. Several such racks can be stacked on top of each other. The packaged goods are to be classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by TARIC subheading 9403 2080 20". Attachment: an illustration

The product described as a "small parts storage unit" is a cabinet measuring approximately 32 x 47 x 14 cm (W x H x D) with a metal housing and 37 plastic drawers, each with a handle and a label. The product has pre-drilled holes on the back and is designed to be wall-mounted. It is intended for storing various items, for example, in workshops. Due to its importance as a stabilizing element, the metal determines the material nature of the product. The product is to be classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by TARIC subheading 9403 2080 20". Attachment: an illustration

The product described as a "kitchen cabinet with sink and cutting surface" is a multi-part item measuring approximately 57.4 x 75.5 x 115 cm (W x L x H), consisting essentially of: - a metal cabinet with a steel frame and four casters (two with locking brakes), - a small sink with an adjacent cutting surface, - a cold water tap, and - a plastic drain trap. The cabinet contains two shelves and a holder for a gas cylinder. The item, standing on the ground, serves as part of an outdoor kitchen. The product is partially unassembled. Since no defining characteristic can be identified, it is classified under the last of the equally applicable headings. The packaged item is classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by TARIC subheading 9403 2080 20". Attachment: 1 image

The product described as a cartridge is an approximately 6.5 cm long, lead-like tip of a capacitive stylus, essentially consisting of the tip and an electronic component for installation in wooden-cased touch pens. The product enables the operation of capacitive touchscreens. The goods are classified as a recognizable "part for other writing instruments (touch pen)."

The product described as "Telescopic Corner Shelf 3 Tiers incl. Mirror" is a composite item consisting of a piece of furniture (its defining characteristic due to its size and importance for use) and a mirror attached to the furniture. The furniture is approximately 226-258 cm high and consists primarily of several interlocking, chrome-plated metal tubes and three plastic trays for holding shower accessories. The shelves—one of which is equipped with two hooks for hanging items—have integrated drainage holes. Once assembled, the shelf is used in the shower or bathtub area of ​​bathrooms. The product is suspended between the ceiling and floor using the metal rod. Its material character is defined by the metal components, which are essential for its load-bearing and stabilizing function. The packaged goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by TARIC subheading 9403 2080 20". Attachment: an illustration

The goods described as a "welding cart" are a metal piece of furniture measuring approximately 70 cm x 39 cm x 88 cm (L x W x H), consisting essentially of three stacked shelves, a handle, and four wheels. Two securing chains are located at the front. The cart is designed to hold gas cylinders, welding equipment, etc. (not covered by the Binding Tariff Information ruling). The product is intended to be placed on the floor and is used to equip workshops. The goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402, not of an office type, not a bed." (See attached image.)

Applicant's description: Expanded coconut fiber tablets, fertilized; round tablets pressed from shredded coconut fibers in various sizes (30 mL, 125 mL and 250 mL), several tablets each packaged in a folding carton. The goods are intended for use in plant cultivation. Finding: Chemical products and preparations of the chemical or related industries (including mixtures of natural products), not elsewhere specified or included; chemical products or preparations consisting predominantly of organic compounds, not elsewhere specified or included; other.

Network loudspeaker (see attached image) – consisting of a horn loudspeaker, audio frequency amplifier, Ethernet controller, processor, and D/A converter in a mounting enclosure (diameter x length: 246 x 292 mm) with Ethernet connection (RJ-45), – for converting electrical audio frequency impulses into sound vibrations – characteristic main function – and for wired reception of audio data from an IP network, – together with accessories (mounting bracket, installation manual) in a common retail package. The network loudspeaker determines the character of the whole. "Single loudspeaker in an enclosure (combination of single loudspeaker – characteristic main function – and apparatus for communication in a wired network, in a product set presented for individual sale with non-characteristic accessories)"

The "rim and tire rack" is a floor-standing piece of furniture, essentially consisting of: - a four-legged metal base - two interlocking metal central tubes inserted vertically into the base - four plastic support plates placed on the central tubes. Due to its size and importance for its use, the metal determines the material character of the assembled goods. The rim rack measures 1080 mm x 660 mm x 660 mm and is designed to hold four tires with a diameter of up to 225 mm. The furniture is used, for example, in workshops. The packaged and unassembled goods are classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (see illustration in the annex)

The product consists of a wooden shelf (acacia) and seven stainless steel coat hooks concealed beneath the shelf. The shelf (dimensions approx. 100 x 20 x 20 cm - L x H x D) has a rounded front panel and is mounted to the wall using a back panel and wall-mounting hardware. The wood, in terms of its size and external appearance, defines the character of this product, which is made of two materials. The packaged goods are to be classified as "furniture of wood, other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402, without a specific spatial connection." See attached image.

The goods described as "Acacia Wall Desk" are a piece of furniture for wall mounting, composed of various materials. The product has dimensions (W x D x H) of 120 x 38 x 37 cm and consists essentially of a frame made of powder-coated iron with four pre-drilled holes in the center for wall mounting, a rectangular shelf with slightly raised edges on the sides and wall, and two drawers. The material character of the goods is determined by the metal components, which are essential for their use as stabilizing elements. The packaged goods are to be classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by TARIC subheading 9403 2080 20". Attachment: an illustration

The product described as a "3-in-1 Bamboo Toilet Brush Set" is a composite product, essentially consisting of a toilet brush and a piece of furniture (comprising a stand and a shelf). The product consists primarily of a base plate made of plastic-coated cement, from which a powder-coated steel pole extends upwards. At the top of the pole is a bamboo holder for smartphones, and below this is a small bamboo holder with an enlarged, rounded end for toilet paper. The set also includes a plastic container attached to the base plate, which serves to hold the toilet brush. The toilet brush has a plastic ferrule and bristles, as well as a bamboo handle. The furniture and the toilet brush constitute a composite product, the nature of which is determined by the furniture's importance for its intended use. The furniture is designed to be placed on the floor. It is a piece of furniture made of various materials (metal, wood, plastic, and cement), but no single material is identifiable as having a defining characteristic. The goods are therefore classified under the last-mentioned of the equally applicable subheadings. There is no indication of handwork. The goods are classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402 and subheadings (HS) 9403 10 to 9403 83, not handcrafted". Attachment: an illustration

These are stainless steel screws with a cylindrical head featuring an internal Torx drive (registered trademark) and a self-tapping thread that does not extend to the head, with a pointed thread end. Knurling is located above the thread. The head has milling ribs on the underside. After further processing, the screws are used to fasten thermal insulation boards to a wooden mounting structure and a concrete substructure. Overall length: 212 mm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "other stainless steel wood screws" under TARIC code 7318 1210 90.

Similar container, so-called tool storage pouch for belt or backpack, see photo in the annex, - with an outer surface made of textile materials, - with a sewn-on snap fastener flap on the back for attaching the container to a belt or backpack, as well as with two horizontally sewn-on flaps, - with a flap closure with Velcro fastener, - unlined; without internal dividers, - with dimensions: approx. 5 cm (width) x 12 cm (height) x 3 cm (depth), - without indication of being handmade, - packaged in a colorfully printed cardboard box. "Similar container, other than those mentioned in subheadings 4202 1110 to 4202 3900, with an outer surface made of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheading 4202 9291, not handmade"

Similar container, see attached photo, - made entirely of leather, - with a sewn-on loop on the back for attachment to a belt, - with a flap closure with a snap fastener, - unlined; without internal dividers, - with dimensions: approx. 5 cm (width) x 12 cm (height) x 3 cm (depth), - intended for the transport and storage of tools of different tool families, - without indication of handcraftsmanship, - packaged in a color-printed cardboard box. "Similar container, other than those mentioned in subheadings 4202 1110 to 4202 3900, with an outer surface of leather, other than those mentioned in subheading 4202 9110, not handcrafted"

The "decorative cover for parasol bases" is a freestanding frame made of wooden slats (acacia wood, according to the application), measuring approximately 62 cm x 62 cm x 26 cm. It consists of four legs connected on all four sides by four wooden struts with gaps between them. The top panel is formed from wooden slats, also spaced apart. A round recess in the center of the top panel allows for the insertion of a parasol pole. The product serves as a cover for parasol bases but can also be used as a table or for storing items. The goods are to be classified as "furniture of wood other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402, without a specific spatial connection." (Image: see annex)

Tension straps, photo see attachment, - according to the application -- 12 pieces as a set in four different colors/lengths (2 x 95 cm, 2 x 65 cm, 4 x 50 cm, 4 x 30 cm), -- each consisting of an elastic cord with a diameter of approx. 8 mm; made of untwisted rubber threads with an almost square cross-section (edge ​​length: approx. 0.1 mm) braided with textile yarns, -- folded over at the ends and fixed with a metal wire so that the attached hooks made of plastic-coated, base metal do not slip off the cord; the hooks are additionally provided at the ends with a small sleeve (so-called rubber protector), - without indication of handwork, - assembled by joining together, - in particular with regard to the use, the elastic cord (merchandise by the meter of heading 5604) determines the character of the goods in relation to the metal hooks. "Other made-up articles (tension straps), of textile materials, other than those mentioned in TARIC codes 6307 9010 00 to 6307 9098 20, not handmade"

A so-called vein massager, in the form of a retail-packaged set, consisting of a vein massager (the device being the primary component in terms of its use), a power supply, four batteries, a storage bag, and instructions for use. The vein massager, which comprises two cuffs enclosing the foot and lower leg with integrated air cushions, air hoses, and a pump/control unit for stepless adjustment of the massage intensity, uses an electrically powered inflation and deflation of various air chambers to create alternating compression of the tissue. This is intended to reduce swelling in the legs, alleviate muscle tension, and improve venous blood circulation by restoring venous function. The electrically powered alternating pressure treatment constitutes an electromechanical massage. The components of the set are contained in a single sales package. The goods are classified as "massage device, other than those covered by subheading (CN) 9019 1010". (see attached image)

Application details (assumed to be correct): Fruit juice mixture with tea extract and fruit puree, packaged for retail sale (500 ml bottle). Alcohol: not included. Products/fats from products of headings 0401 to 0404: not included. Sucrose or invert sugar: included. Non-alcoholic beverage, other than those specified in UPOs 2202 1000 to 2202 9915 of the CN, containing sugar (sucrose or invert sugar), fruit or vegetable juice, diluted with water or carbonated.

Application details (assumed to be correct): Fruit and vegetable juice mixture with fruit puree, ginger juice and wheat germ oil, presented for retail sale (500 ml bottle with screw cap). Alcohol: not included. Products or fats from products of headings 0401 to 0404: not included. Sucrose or invert sugar: included. Non-alcoholic beverage, other than those specified in UOS codes 2202 1000 to 2202 9915 of the CN, containing sugar (sucrose or invert sugar), other.

The goods in question are wall-mounted furniture. The shelf consists of a shelf with a raised edge and two upturned sides; 586 mm wide x 246 mm deep. The goods have three recesses on each side for mounting to a wall bracket. The fact that the shelf can also be attached to the perforated grid of a "wall unit system" (not the subject of the binding tariff information decision) is irrelevant for classification purposes. It is not a functionally essential part of this wall unit system. The goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". See attached image.

Dog harness, photo attached, - made of approximately 1 cm wide woven fabric strips (nylon according to the application), - with a multi-layered, padded section of woven and knitted fabrics in the chest, neck, and shoulder areas, - with a padded knitted fabric section in the belly area, - continuously adjustable; with three plastic adjustment buckles, - with two plastic snap closures, - with a sewn-on D-ring made of base metal for attaching a leash, - clearly intended for outfitting dogs and thus classified as saddlery for animals. "Saddlery for all animals, made of all kinds of fabrics"

Dog harness, photo attached, - made of approximately 2 cm wide woven strips of textile fabric (nylon according to the application), - padded in the chest, neck, and shoulder areas; lined on the inside with a knitted textile fabric, - continuously adjustable; with a plastic adjustment buckle, - with a plastic snap closure and a press-button closure, - with a hand loop for holding, - with a sewn-on D-ring made of base metal for attaching a leash, - clearly intended for outfitting dogs and thus as saddlery for animals. "Saddlery for all animals, made of fabrics of all kinds"

Leash for dogs, see attached photo, - made from a band of woven textiles approximately 2 cm wide, - padded; covered on the underside with a knitted textile fabric, - sewn into a loop at one end, - with a carabiner hook made of base metal sewn onto the other end, - approximately 120 cm long and 2 cm wide. "Saddlery for all animals, made from all kinds of fabrics"

The goods described as a "marble side table" are a piece of furniture in the form of a table, composed of various materials. The product consists essentially of a funnel-shaped metal frame made of lacquered aluminum and a round marble tabletop measuring 35 x 35 x 45 cm (W x D x H). With regard to the supporting frame and its higher value, the metal determines the material character of the composite goods. The furniture is intended to be placed on the floor and is used for furnishing homes. The packaged goods are classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by TARIC subheading 9403 2080 20". Attachment: an illustration

Fastening straps, photo attached, - according to the application: -- as a five-piece set packaged in a polybag, -- each consisting of approximately 2.5 cm wide straps made of 100% polyester fabric (synthetic chemical fibers), -- with two so-called guying straps: --- with a length between 133 cm and 263 cm, --- length adjustable via a plastic buckle, --- each with both ends sewn together to form a loop and equipped with a carabiner hook made of apparently base metal, -- with two so-called strut attachments: --- with a length of 17 cm, --- each with both ends sewn together to form a loop; equipped with a D-ring made of apparently base metal at one end of the loop, -- with one so-called mast attachment: --- with a length of 20 cm, --- sewn together to form a loop at both ends and once in between; Equipped with a D-ring made of base metal at one loop end and at the middle loop, -- without any indication of handwork, -- manufactured by joining, -- the straps are intended to be connected together between the mast and two struts of a so-called cantilever parasol (not subject to the binding tariff information) and serve to provide stability in strong winds, -- particularly with regard to the size, the textile fabrics determine the essential character of the goods. "Other made-up goods (fastening straps), of textiles, of woven fabrics, not handmade"

The product is a piece of furniture in the form of a towel rack measuring 46 cm x 24 cm x 84 cm (L x W x H). It features three stainless steel crossbars arranged in a stepped configuration and a bamboo frame. The unassembled towel rack is intended for floor placement. As the product consists of two materials, the bamboo components determine its character in terms of function (providing stability) and size. The product is also available as a set of two. It is classified as "furniture of wood other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402, without a specific spatial connection." See attached illustration.

The goods consist essentially of a foldable frame made of base metal and a coated chipboard tabletop with a marble-effect finish. The goods have a total height of 110 cm, and the tabletop has a diameter of 60 cm. Depending on the item number, the goods are also available as a set of two. With regard to the supporting frame and the higher value of the product, the metal determines the material character of the assembled goods. The table is intended to be placed on the floor. It can be set up in a variety of ways, e.g., in banquet halls, multi-purpose halls, conference and seminar rooms, or as a dining table in restaurants. The goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". See attached image.

The products in question are a retail-ready set consisting of: - four unpadded chairs with metal frames and wooden seats (dimensions: 37 x 44 x 87 cm, W x D x H) and - a table with a metal frame and a wooden tabletop (dimensions: 110 x 68 x 75 cm, L x D x H). The table and chairs are made of black powder-coated metal and feature MDF tabletops and seats, respectively, with a water-repellent finish in beech, oak, or acacia wood look, depending on the version. The table is designed for dining (while seated on the matching chairs) and thus functions as a dining table. Since neither the chairs nor the table are the defining characteristics of the product set, it falls under the last-mentioned category of equally suitable items. With regard to the various materials used in the table, the material nature of the goods is determined in particular by the value and importance of the metal for its use as a load-bearing component. The assortment of goods packed in a cardboard box is to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (See attached image.)

The goods are a piece of furniture in the form of a table, composed of various materials, with dimensions of approximately 50 x 50 x 45 cm (W x L x H). The furniture consists of a rectangular glass top and a four-legged metal frame covered with a polyrattan weave. The product is available in black and beige. With regard to the supporting frame and its higher value, the metal determines the material character of the composite goods. The goods are classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". See attached image.

The goods in question are a garden furniture set presented as a retail package, consisting of six or eight chairs and a table. The chairs are approximately 65 x 60/55 x 111 cm (D x W x H), unpadded, reclining, foldable chairs with backrests, and consist of an aluminum frame with a fabric cover. The table, approximately 140 x 80 x 74 cm or 180 x 90 x 74 cm (L x W x H), consists primarily of a four-legged aluminum frame and a WPC tabletop. It is designed for dining (while seated on the matching chairs) and thus functions as a dining table. Since neither the table nor the chairs are the defining characteristics of the product set, the dining table set should be classified under the latter category, which is equally applicable. The values ​​of the tabletop material and the frame material are almost proportionally balanced; therefore, with regard to the supporting legs, the metal determines the material character of the assembled goods. According to the applicant, the table and seating furniture are presented together for retail sale. The goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (See attached image.)

The product described as a sun lounger is a composite item consisting of various components, including a lounger with adjustable back and footrests and precisely fitting cushions (approximately 7 cm thick). The lounger, measuring approximately 200 x 58 x 33 cm (L x W x H), has a metal frame completely covered with polyrattan (plastic). A side shelf (approximately 30 x 20 cm) folds out using a gas spring mechanism. The nature of the product is determined by its function as a composite item. In the case of the lounger, which is made of two different fabrics, the fabric's character is primarily determined by the metal frame, which serves as a stabilizing element. The product is available in two color combinations (black/cream and gray/anthracite) and is intended for outdoor use. The goods are classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". See attached image.

The product is a pool surround, essentially consisting of elements with an aluminum frame and a PE rattan weave (plastic), which can simultaneously be used as a cabinet (with double doors) for storing items such as towels, as a shelf, and as a seat. The surround is also equipped with a footrest with a wooden inlay. The back wall of the unit is formed by the whirlpool. Dimensions: inner diameter 203 cm, surround width: approx. 40 cm, overall height: 55 cm. The defining material, with regard to stability, is metal. The product qualifies as both seating furniture of heading 9401 and storage furniture of heading 9403 and should therefore be classified under the latter of the equally applicable headings. The goods are classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". See attached image.

This is a coat rack with a marble base and a frame made of lacquered steel tubing. The approximately 175 cm high, floor-standing coat rack features two five-pronged arms (slightly curved or swept) at the top for hanging jackets, coats, or hats. In the middle are additional hooks with round knobs for short jackets or bags. Further down, the coat rack also includes an umbrella stand. The furniture, made of various fabrics, is characterized by the metal as a stabilizing element (load-bearing component). The goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". Image: see attachment.

Strawberry fruit powder with maltodextrin. According to the application, the product is a fruit powder consisting of strawberry pulp and maltodextrin, obtained by spray drying. It is used in the production of ice cream. Glucose or starch (according to the application): more than 5% by weight; food preparation not elsewhere specified or included, not belonging to subheadings 2106 1020 to 2106 9059 of the Combined Nomenclature (CN), containing more than 5% by weight of glucose or starch; due to the predominant maltodextrin content, not a fruit preparation of heading 2008 of the CN.

The so-called undercut minimum volume gauge is a complex, approximately 220 mm long, nearly cylindrical steel product with a diameter of approximately 22 mm, manufactured according to a technical drawing. It has an inversely conical shape at the lower end. The essential component is the hollow, open-bottomed cylindrical steel body, which has four symmetrical longitudinal saw cuts, 122 mm long, along its underside, allowing the cylinder to expand towards the bottom. Inside is a steel pin that can be pressed down from the top of the product, causing the lower end to expand and form an undercut bore. Undercut bores are cylindrical bores with a conical undercut at the end and are used to accommodate undercut anchors (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision), which are primarily used in facade construction. The product under test serves to verify the required volume (diameter, depth, and undercut) of the undercut bore. The goods are classified as "instruments for measuring or checking geometrical quantities, not elsewhere specified or included in Chapter 90, other than those covered by subheadings (HS) 9031 10 to 9031 49". (see illustration in the annex)

So-called sample containers for laboratory equipment, essentially consisting of a specially shaped, slightly conical plastic device with a sediment cone at the bottom, volume graduations for 125 µl, 500 µl, and 1400 µl, and confidential dimensions. The sample container is used to transfer the sample to be analyzed into a laboratory instrument of the ARCHITECT family (not the subject of this binding tariff information decision), in which the chemical analysis is carried out. The container is specifically designed for this equipment and is only useful with it. The goods are classified as "accessories, identifiable as being primarily intended for use with instruments, apparatus, and appliances of subheadings (HS) 9027 10 to 9027 81." (See illustration in the annex.)

Lashing strap, photo attached, - according to the application: -- packaged in a blister card, -- measuring 25 mm (width) x 5 m (length), -- consisting of a band of color-woven polyester fabric (synthetic chemical fibers), -- folded into a loop at one end, sewn together, and fitted with a tensioning ratchet approximately 10.5 cm long (when closed) made of base metal and a sewn-in plastic film label; the other end is simply hot-cut, -- without any indication of handwork, - manufactured by joining components, - serves to secure loads; the strap itself secures the load; the tensioning device only performs an auxiliary function by tightening the strap, - with regard to its scope and importance in relation to its use, the textile fabrics determine the character of the lashing strap. "Other manufactured goods (lashing straps) made of textiles, of woven fabrics, not handmade"

Lashing strap (2-piece), photo see attachment, - according to the application: -- packaged in a blister pack with paper insert, -- consisting of two 25 mm wide straps of different lengths (4.8 m and 0.2 m) made of woven polyester fabric (synthetic chemical fibers), -- long strap: --- only hot-cut at one end, folded into a loop at the other end, sewn together and equipped with a sewn-in label made of plastic film and a hook made of base metal, which is apparently coated with plastic, -- short strap: --- sewn together into loops at both ends; one loop equipped with a tensioning device (ratchet) made of base metal, approximately 10.5 cm long when closed, and the other with a hook as described above, with another sewn-in label, -- no indication of handwork, - assembled by joining; - both parts together form a lashing strap, which serves to secure cargo; The securing of the load is achieved by the strap; the ratchet and hooks only serve an auxiliary function by tightening the strap. The product is a so-called flower stand measuring approximately 36.5 x 107.5 x 36.5 cm (W x H x D). It consists of three marble shelves at different heights and a frame made of lacquered metal. The product is a component approximately 41 x 40 x 20 mm (L x W x D) manufactured according to a technical drawing from a copper-zinc casting alloy. The product is a steel frame measuring approximately 63.5 x 54.5 x 32 cm (W x D x H), consisting essentially of four legs connected by crossbars and a pull-out drawer attached to the legs. Applicant's information: The goods are films made of PVC (plasticizer-free) and used for primary packaging in the food and pharmaceutical industries. Applicant's description: The goods in question are a polyethylene pool hose (length: 6 m, 10 m, or 14 m; diameter: 32 mm or 38 mm). The blue or black, flexible, corrugated hose has integrated quick-release couplings spaced 1 m apart (not attached or connected) and can therefore be cut to the desired length. The ends are also shaped but likewise not attached or connected. Hose clamps are included. The hose cannot withstand a pressure of 27.6 MPa or more. Findings: This is a different type of plastic hose, neither reinforced nor combined with other materials, without fittings, closures, or connectors. The hoses are merely decorative.

Details: Santa Claus Christmas tin made of tinplate. It contains a hollow chocolate Santa Claus figure, three chocolate pralines with milk cream filling, and three chocolate pralines with praline cream filling. Findings based on a sample: The tin is a two-part container made of magnetic sheet steel, which, when assembled, has the shape of a Santa Claus figure and is painted accordingly on the outside. One of the two tin parts has a stepped, circumferential rim. The bottom of the tin is flattened so that it can stand upright. The tin does not bear any contents information or detailed consumer information. Dimensions (H x W x D): approximately 200 x 85 x 50 mm. See attached image. The metal tin contains six chocolate pralines (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29286/26-2) and one hollow chocolate figure (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29286/26-3). This binding tariff information (BTI) decision relates exclusively to the metal can from the set. Finding: Such products, as "steel goods other than those specified in the aforementioned subheadings", belong to subheading 7326 90 98 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Applicant's description: A Santa Christmas tin made of tinplate. It contains a hollow chocolate Santa Claus figure, three chocolate pralines with a milk cream filling, and three chocolate pralines with a praline cream filling. Information regarding the composition is confidential. Findings on samples: Three approximately cuboid, bite-sized products made of milk chocolate (dimensions: approx. 3.5 x 2 x 1.5 cm) filled with a light beige, firm cream, similar to pralines; odor: chocolate; taste: sweet, of milk chocolate and milk cream. The pralines are individually wrapped in red metal foil (marked "milk cream"). Three approximately cuboid, bite-sized products made of milk chocolate (dimensions: approx. 3.5 x 2 x 1.5 cm) filled with a brown, firm cream, similar to pralines; odor: chocolate; taste: sweet, of milk chocolate and milk cream. The chocolates are individually wrapped in gold-colored metal foil (labeled "praline cream"). The chocolates, along with a hollow chocolate figure (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29286/26-3), are contained in a metal tin (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29286/26-1). This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the chocolate pralines in the assortment. Finding: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: Pralines, including filled ones: other

Applicant's details: A Santa Claus Christmas tin made of tinplate. It contains a hollow chocolate Santa Claus figure, three chocolate pralines with milk cream filling, and three chocolate pralines with praline cream filling. Confidential information is available regarding the composition. Findings on samples: Hollow milk chocolate figure in the shape of Santa Claus (height: approx. 7.5 cm); odor: chocolate; taste: sweet, milk chocolate. The hollow figure is wrapped in brightly printed metal foil. The hollow chocolate figure is contained, together with six pralines (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29286/26-2), in a metal tin (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29286/26-1). This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the hollow chocolate figure from the assortment. Finding: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: other: unfilled

According to the application details, product images, and submitted sample, these are versatile baskets for commercial use (catering, retail, etc.) for displaying food products. The rectangular products, available in various sizes and colors, consist of a metal wire frame serving only as reinforcement, which is completely woven with single-color, approximately 3 mm thick plastic monofilaments (wickerwork as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46). For customs tariff purposes, they are classified as "basketry goods, made directly from wickerwork materials, not from vegetable materials."

Human blood for diagnostic analysis. According to the applicant, the goods in question are samples of human blood used for diagnostic and analytical purposes in preparation for a hematopoietic stem cell transplant. The samples are used to carry out essential immunological and hematological tests to ensure compatibility between donor and recipient and the safety of the transplantation process. This includes, in particular, HLA (Human Leukocyte Antigen) typing, blood group determination, crossmatching to test compatibility, and screening for infectious diseases. The samples are provided in small volumes in special medical collection tubes (e.g., containing anticoagulants such as EDTA or heparin) and are refrigerated or transported at controlled temperatures to maintain cellular integrity for laboratory analysis. The goods are to be classified as human blood under subheading 3002 9010 of the Customs Tariff.

Applicant's description: Christmas tree ornament tins made of tinplate in three designs. They contain three chocolate pralines with a milk cream filling. Findings on a sample: Two-part tin made of magnetic sheet steel, which, when assembled, has the shape of a Santa Claus figure and is painted accordingly on the outside. There is a loop of textile material at the top. One of the two tin parts has a stepped, circumferential rim. The bottom of the tin is flattened so that it can stand upright. The tin does not bear any contents information or detailed consumer information. Dimensions (H x W x D): approximately 98 x 61 x 60 mm. See attached image. The metal tin contains three chocolate pralines (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29438/26-2). This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the metal tin from the set. Finding: Such products belong to subheading 7326 90 98 of the Combined Nomenclature as "steel goods other than those mentioned in the above subheadings".

Applicant's information: Christmas tree ornament tins made of tinplate in three designs. They contain three chocolate pralines with a milk cream filling. Findings on samples: Three approximately cuboid, bite-sized products made of milk chocolate (dimensions: approx. 3.5 x 2 x 1.5 cm) filled with a light beige, firm cream, in the style of pralines; odor: of chocolate; taste: sweet, of milk chocolate and milk cream. The pralines are individually wrapped in red metal foil (label: "milk cream"). The pralines are in a metal tin, which does not constitute packaging within the meaning of General Rule 5(b) (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-29438/26-1). This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the chocolate pralines in the assortment. Finding: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: Pralines, also filled: other

Applicant's information: PET vapor barrier with aluminum - PET aluminum foil. Confidential information is available regarding the foil's construction. Findings on a sample: A rectangular section of a multi-layered, reinforced foil was submitted. The foil has a blue side (PET foil) and a transparent side (PE foil). Furthermore, the flat product is reinforced on one side with a silver-gloss foil and a leaky, white fabric. Conclusion: The material is characterized by the presence of a reinforced foil made of other plastics, specifically additive polymers.

Details: Gold cup filled with chocolate pralines with praline cream filling, 85 g. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: Eight individually wrapped, oblong, brown chocolate pralines with a chocolatey odor (dimensions in cm: approx. 3.5 x 2 x 1.5) in gold-colored metal foil (printed with "Praline Cream"), filled with a brown, firm cream. This binding tariff information (BTI) decision refers exclusively to the chocolate pralines from the set with a plastic cup. Finding: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: Pralines, also filled: other.

The article illustrated by a sample is a so-called "gold goblet" made of molded plastics as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 1. Sewing machine mat, photo attached, - according to the application: -- packaged in a polybag, -- approximately rectangular (with rounded corners), measuring 50 cm x 33 cm, -- made of a needled and bonded, printed nonwoven fabric of synthetic fibers, - is not usually washed, particularly due to the material, and is characterized by its intended use as an interior furnishing product, therefore not a tablecloth of heading 6302, - made by sewing together, - among other things, not a carpet of heading 5705 due to its dimensions. Smock, adult size, photo attached, - according to the application: -- made of approx. 0.4 mm thick, single-color non-woven polypropylene (synthetic chemical fibers), -- extending over half the thigh (back length: approx. 114 cm), -- with a V-neck, -- with a tie made of the aforementioned non-woven fabrics, -- designed in a wrap style; with a continuous opening at the front that can be closed by overlapping both right to left and left to right using the tie; partially finished with a contrasting non-woven trim, -- with approx. 3/4-length sleeves, -- simply cut at the bottom edge and sleeve ends, -- non-sterile single-use product; Not intended as disposable clothing for wear during surgical procedures, - is a nonwoven fabric of heading 5603.
