Adult-sized briefs, photo attached, - according to the application: -- each packaged in a small polybag, -- in different sizes and colors; with contrasting overlock seams, -- made of approximately 0.3 mm thick, single-color nonwoven fabrics of synthetic fibers, -- designed in the style of a thong, -- without an opening or closure, -- fitted with an elastic band (so-called rubber band) at all edges, which also forms the side panels at the top, -- hemmed with overlock seams, - constitutes a nonwoven fabric of heading 5603. "Clothing (briefs) made of products of heading 5603"

Head covering, so-called paper boat, photo attached, - according to the application: - - made from paper cutouts glued together, - - folded at the top; with air holes at the top, - - adjustable at the edge, - - with dimensions (folded flat): approx. 28 cm (width) x 8.5 cm (height), - - in various colors, - - intended to be worn for hygienic purposes (e.g., in the food industry). "Other head covering, not a safety head covering, made of paper"

Cap, so-called non-woven cap with visor, photo see attachment, - according to the application details: - - manufactured by sewing together several pieces of textile products (non-woven fabric made of synthetic textiles), - - with an additional hair covering made of non-woven fabric in the neck area, - - narrowed at the edge with an elastic thread, - - with a sewn-on visor made of non-woven fabric, - - in different colors, - - for use as a protective cap to cover all the hair. "Head covering made from several pieces of textile products, cap with visor"

Cap, so-called non-woven cap with visor, photo see attachment, - according to the application details: - - manufactured by sewing together several pieces of textile products (non-woven fabric made of synthetic textiles), - - with an additional hair covering made of non-woven fabric in the neck area, - - narrowed at the edge with an elastic thread, - - with a sewn-on visor made of non-woven fabric, - - in different colors, - - for use as a protective cap to cover all the hair. "Head covering made from several pieces of textile products, cap with visor"

Details: Product name: "Christmas Elf" chocolate tablets; 10g premium milk chocolate tablets in a tiered display. Tiered display made of plastic, filled with premium milk chocolate tablets, 1050g. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings on a sample: Flat tablet with break lines (dimensions: approx. 5.5 x 3.5 cm) made of solid milk chocolate; odor: chocolate; taste: sweet, milk chocolate. The tablet is packaged in clear plastic film with a colorfully printed, winter-themed paper band (labeling (excerpt): "PRECIAL MILK CHOCOLATE 10g"). Findings: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other, in the form of tablets, bars, or sticks: unfilled: other

According to the application and the submitted sample, the item is a set of four Christmas decorations, approximately 9 cm in size, in the shape of children. The colorfully designed polyresin ornaments depict two boys in winter clothing (one with skis and one with a lantern) and two girls in winter dresses and jackets (one with a basket and one with skis). Each ornament has a metal eyelet and a red fabric loop for hanging. The ornaments are suitable for use as Christmas tree decorations and, according to the application, are intended for this purpose. The set is packaged in a cardboard box. For customs tariff purposes, this item is classified as a "Christmas festive article," not as a glass item.

Application details: Dried black soldier fly larvae with added vitamin E, not for human consumption. The product is intended as feed for fish, birds, and rodents and is packaged in 5 kg bags. Glucose/maltodextrin/starch as total glucose (as stated): less than 0.5% by weight. Preparations of the type used for feeding, other, including premixes, other, other.

Application details: Dried freshwater shrimp (Gammarus) with added vitamin E, not for human consumption. The product is intended as feed for fish, birds, and reptiles and is packaged in 5 kg bags. Glucose/maltodextrin/starch as total glucose (as stated): less than 0.5% by weight. Preparations of the type used for feeding, other, other, including premixes, other, other.

Other ceramic tableware, so-called cups, see attached photo, - in triplicate with regard to decoration, - glazed, beaker-like cups with handles, - with the dimensions: 8.7 cm (top diameter) x 10.6 cm (height), - ceramic products, fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - according to the results of scientific analysis, made of stoneware. "Other ceramic tableware (cups), made of stoneware"

A set consisting of other ceramic tableware, a so-called "tea-for-one" set (see attached photo), in the form of a 3-piece set in different colors, including: - Teapot: - - bulbous, glazed teapot with lid, - - dimensions: approx. 11 cm (width) x 10 cm (height), - Cup: - - round, glazed cup with handle, - - dimensions: approx. 11 cm (largest diameter) x 6 cm (height), - Saucer: - - round, smoothly glazed saucer, - - dimensions: approx. 17.9 cm (largest diameter) x 2.3 cm (height), - ceramic products, fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - according to the results of scientific analysis, made of stoneware. "Other ceramic tableware (teapot with cup and saucer), made of stoneware"

Other ceramic tableware, so-called teapot, photo see attachment, - bulbous teapot with handle and spout and a lid, - with the dimensions: 18.2 cm (diameter at the bottom) x 13 cm (height without lid), - ceramic product, fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - according to the results of scientific examination, made of stoneware. "Other ceramic tableware (teapot), made of stoneware"

These are screws made entirely of stainless steel, available in various dimensions, with a countersunk head featuring an internal hexagon socket (Torx, a registered trademark) and a self-tapping thread that does not extend to the head, with a pointed thread end and a cutting notch. The underside of the head is equipped with six milling ribs. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "other wood screws of stainless steel, with thread" under tariff code 7318 12 10 90 0.

Applicant's details: Easter World gift box; green or yellow gift box made of tinplate with color printing; contains four chocolate pralines with a milk cream filling. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings on a sample: Four individually wrapped, oblong, brown chocolate pralines with chocolate flavor (dimensions approx. 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm x 1.5 cm), filled with a white cream. The chocolate pralines are contained in a colorfully printed, egg-shaped metal tin with an Easter motif (not part of this binding tariff information, see DEBTI-30299/26-2). Labeling (foil): "Milk Cream". Finding: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa: other; Chocolate and chocolate products: Pralines, also filled: other. This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the chocolate pralines in the set with a metal tin.

Details: Easter World gift box; green or yellow gift box made of tinplate with color printing; contains four chocolate pralines with milk cream filling. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: It is a two-part box made of magnetic sheet steel, which, when assembled, has the shape of an Easter egg with a gift loop and is painted accordingly on the outside. The lower part of the box has a stepped, circumferential rim. The bottom of the box is flattened so that it can stand upright. The box does not bear any contents information or detailed consumer information. The box contains chocolate-containing articles (see DEBTI-30299/26-1). Dimensions (H x D): approximately 107 x 74 mm. Finding: Other goods made of iron or steel: other: other goods made of iron or steel: other. This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the metal box from the assortment containing chocolate pralines.

These are nearly round, flat steel products (not stainless steel) with a raised rim. The outer surfaces are partially wavy, and the underside is fitted with circular, non-slip plastic or rubber inserts. The goods are packaged in a plastic bag and a labeled cardboard box and are intended for household use, e.g., for serving and presenting drinks or food. Total length: approximately 50 cm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products fall under TARIC code 7323 9900 90 as "other household articles of steel (not stainless steel)." They do not fall under heading 8306 because the goods are intended for everyday use.

These are cast aluminum bowls in the shape of a stylized leaf. The products feature numerous perforations and indentations and an approximately oval depression in the center. They are used, for example, for storing food in the home. Dimensions (W x H x D): approximately 36 cm x 4 cm x 9 cm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products fall under TARIC code 7615 1010 90 as "other household articles of aluminum, cast".

Herbal medicinal product, tablets containing Ginkgo biloba extract. Samples of the product, packaged for retail sale in various sizes (30, 60, 80, and 120 tablets), were submitted. The packaging and package insert provide information on the distributor, composition, indication (herbal medicinal product for improving age-related cognitive decline and quality of life in mild dementia), and dosage recommendation (one film-coated tablet daily, unless otherwise prescribed by a doctor). Contents of the samples: Depending on the package size, 2, 3, 4, or 6 blisters, each containing 15 or 20 oblong, orange-brown tablets. Milk fat and milk protein*: not included Sucrose/invert sugar/isoglucose**: less than 5% by weight Starch/glucose***: less than 5% by weight * derived from list of ingredients ** determined in accordance with Regulation (EC) 900/2008 *** determined in accordance with Regulation (EC) 900/2008, Regulation (EU) 118/2010 Food preparation not elsewhere specified or included, not falling under any of the subheadings 2106 1020 to 2106 9059 of the CN, containing no milk fat, less than 5% by weight sucrose or isoglucose and less than 5% by weight glucose or starch; not a product of heading 3004 of the CN, as the product is not presented for therapeutic or prophylactic purposes within the meaning of that heading.

The goods described as a "bench" are floor-standing seating furniture with dimensions of approximately 120 cm x 43 cm x 41.5 cm (W x H x D). The bench essentially consists of a wooden frame and a wooden seat covered with jute fabric. The unassembled and unpackaged goods are to be classified as "Seating furniture (other than that of heading 9402), other than subheadings (HS) 9401 10 to 9401 59, with a wooden frame, not upholstered." (Image: see annex)

Description: Cardboard packaging in the form of multicolored printed rabbit heads in two different designs, containing two small chocolate eggs, a bite-sized chocolate bar, and a bag of gummy bears. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: A colorfully printed, hexagonal cardboard folding box (motif: rabbit head), closed at the top with a green textile ribbon. The cardboard folding box contains a cellophane bag filled with the following confectionery: - a brown chocolate bar filled with a beige cream. The bar is sealed in colorfully printed plastic film, printed with (excerpt): "choco & cream". - two hollow chocolate eggs, individually wrapped in colorfully printed metal foil. - A rectangular, colorfully printed, sealed plastic bag containing 14 gummy bears in different colors (red, green, yellow, and white), length: approx. 2.5 cm, width: approx. 1.4 cm. Findings: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other, in the form of bars, sticks, or tablets: filled.

The goods described as a "set of 2 side tables" are two nesting tables made of different materials; dimensions: 30 cm x 60 cm x 30 cm and 30 cm x 51 cm x 25 cm (W x H x D). Each table consists of a four-legged metal frame with a rectangular wooden top. The higher-quality tabletops are the primary material used in the tables. The tables are designed to be placed on the floor and are intended for use in living rooms. The packaged products are classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 and 9402, of wood, of a kind used in living and dining rooms." (See attached image)

The so-called side table is a metal piece of furniture in the form of a table; 28 cm x 51 cm (diameter x height). The product, which is designed to stand on the floor, has a round tabletop and a single leg. The packaged and unassembled goods are to be classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (Image: see annex)

Cylinder bearing, see attached illustration, - a pressed, cylindrical sintered part manufactured according to technical drawing, equipped with bores and receptacles; to enhance emergency running properties, the surfaces of the component pores are filled with oil; used for low-friction guidance and support of shafts or axles in various electric motors of motor vehicles. "Bearing shell, not for civil aircraft"

Part of a coupling, see attached illustration – a pressed sintered part made of low-alloy iron, manufactured according to a technical drawing and equipped with two bores, serves as a component of the coupling of a brushcutter for power transmission from an engine to a scythe blade. "Part of an iron coupling, not cast, not intended for civil aircraft."

The "Alu Gold Side Table" is a gold-colored metal piece of furniture in the form of a side table; 40 cm x 56 cm (diameter x height). The product, designed to stand on the floor, has a round tabletop and a single leg. The packaged and unassembled goods are to be classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (Image: see annex)

Coffee roasting system (see attached image) – essentially consisting of a roasting drum, agitator in the cooler, roasting fan, cooling fan, roasting cyclone (with chaff collection container), cooling screen with second manual outlet, cooling cyclone (with chaff collection container), handwheel for regulating the airflow, and surface burner, as well as a control panel connected via cable, – optionally available with smoke burner, catalyst, stoner, or compacting screw, – for roasting green coffee using hot air. "Apparatus for the treatment of substances by processes based on a change in temperature (roasting), not goods of subheadings (CN) 8419 1100 to 8419 8930 (Functional unit consisting of a coffee roasting system and a control panel with controls) – Coffee roasting system"

Coffee roasting system (see attached image) – essentially consisting of a roasting drum, agitator in the cooler, roasting fan, cooling fan, machine hopper, roasting cyclone (with chaff collection container and connection for manual quenching water addition), cooling screen with second manual outlet and protective cover, as well as a sensor to switch off the agitator when opened, cooling cyclone (with chaff collection container), aroma function with pneumatic flaps for regulating the airflow and surface burner, and a control panel connected via cable – optionally available with smoke burner, catalyst, stoner or compacting screw – for roasting green coffee using hot air. "Apparatus for the treatment of substances by processes based on a change in temperature (roasting), not goods of subheadings (CN) 8419 1100 to 8419 8930 (Functional unit consisting of coffee roasting system and control panel with controller) – Coffee roasting system"

Coffee drum roaster (see attached image) – essentially consisting of a roasting drum with drum drive and filling mechanism, cooling system and cooling screen, forced-air burner, agitator in the cooler, roasting cyclone (with chaff collection container), roasting air fan, and control unit with display; optionally available with smoke burner, catalyst, destoner, or compacting screw; for roasting green coffee using hot air. "Apparatus for the treatment of substances by processes based on a change in temperature (roasting), not goods of subheadings (CN) 8419 1100 to 8419 8930 – Coffee roasting system"

Floor pump (see illustrations in the appendix), - consisting of a pump cylinder made of base metal with a piston rod guided within the cylinder, including piston and handle, footrest, an air delivery hose fitted with a connector, and a pressure gauge, - for inflating various goods such as bicycle and car tires, balls, inflatable boats, and air mattresses - its defining primary function - and for measuring pressure, - together with accessories (three additional adapters) in a common sales package. The floor pump determines the character of the whole. "Hand-operated air pump, not a hand pump for bicycles (combination of air pump - defining primary function - and pressure gauge), in a product set presented for individual sale with accessories that do not define its character."

According to the applicant's information and the accompanying image of the goods, the so-called "Inflatable Santa Claus XXL" is a standing, inflatable Santa Claus figure measuring approximately 250 x 180 x 115 cm. The traditionally dressed, red and white Santa Claus consists of a polyester fabric outer shell and, for decorative purposes, is equipped with four LEDs inside and an electric, mains-powered pump for inflation. The characterful figure is supplied with four plastic ground stakes and four guy ropes for anchoring and serves as a decorative item for indoor and outdoor use in traditional Christmas celebrations. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as a "Christmas item, not made of glass".

Induction heating element (see attached image) - Multi-cooker consisting of three induction coils with covers on a mounting plate with control panel, assembled with a specifically shaped housing containing two fans and a printed circuit board equipped with temperature sensors and other active and passive components, without glass cover and mains cable connection, dimensions: 550 x 420 x 34.5 mm, - with a power output of 1,400 to 3,000 watts at a voltage of 220-240 volts, - for household use for preparing hot food. "Electric heating appliance for household use, other than that specified in subheadings (CN) 8516 5000 to 8516 6010, incomplete multi-cooker"

Component for a cooktop, so-called induction generator – consisting of a printed circuit board equipped with active and passive components, a heat sink, a fan, and electrical connection points in a specifically shaped, built-in plastic housing (dimensions: 402 x 202 x 32.8 mm) with mounting devices for two induction coils (not the subject of this information), – clearly intended exclusively for installation in a multi-cooktop for household use. "Part clearly intended exclusively for household electric heating appliances, not a product of TARIC codes 8516 9000 10 to 8516 9000 70"

The goods described as "nesting tables" consist of two metal furniture pieces in the form of side tables. The lacquered aluminum tables, measuring 41 cm x 41 cm x 42 cm and 36 cm x 36 cm x 38 cm (W x D x H), each have a round tabletop and a surrounding frame with a branch-like appearance. These floor-standing products are intended for use as furnishings in homes. The tables are offered as a set of two in silver. The goods are classified as "furniture other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, of metal, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (Image: see attachment)

Application details: Buckwheat hulls, residues from grain processing, for filling yoga cushions. Bran and other residues, also in pellet form, from sifting, milling or other processing of cereals or pulses, of other cereals, other, with a starch content of 28% by weight or less, provided that either 10% by weight or less of the product passes through a sieve with a mesh size of 0.2 mm or, if more than 10% by weight passes through the sieve, the ash content of the sieve, based on the dry matter, is 1.5% by weight or more.

Esters of acetic acid; geranyl acetate. According to the information provided, the product is a mixture of isomers of geranyl acetate and neryl acetate. A synonymous name is 3,7-dimethyl-2,6-octadien-1-ol acetate. The CAS number is 105-87-3. The purity is at least 98%. The product is a colorless to yellowish, oily liquid. The product is to be classified as another ester of acetic acid under subheading 2915 3900 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Intermediate gear, made of a cylindrical, stepped plastic body (Durethan), consisting of three consecutive gears, with the following dimensions: overall: diameter 90 mm, height 40 mm; outer gear: diameter 90 mm, height 10 mm, 69 teeth; middle gear: diameter 40 mm, height 18 mm, 16 teeth; inner gear: diameter 22 mm, height 12 mm, 8 teeth; central bore: diameter 10 mm. When installed in an electromechanical actuator, it is used to open and close flap systems by means of motion transmission. "Gear, separately supplied, not cast from iron or steel."

The goods are a table measuring 80 x 55 x 50-69 cm, consisting essentially of a foldable and height-adjustable metal frame with rubber feet and a wooden (MDF) tabletop with an aluminum edge. The table is intended to be placed on the floor and serves as a furnishing item, for example, on patios or while camping. With regard to the supporting frame and its higher value, the metal determines the material character of the composite goods. The goods are to be classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". See attached image.

First aid kit bag containing various bandages, plasters, dressings, compresses, and scissors. According to the application, the contents of the bag meet the requirements of DIN 13164. The first aid kit is sold together with a warning triangle, a high-visibility vest, and two respirators. The binding tariff information (vZTA) applies only to the first aid kit bag. See attached image. This is a first aid kit bag containing various bandages and dressings, which is to be classified under subheading 3006 5000 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Medical centrifuge system (see attached image) – consisting of a centrifuge with a variable separation chamber (40 ml to 180 ml) in a housing with control unit and pump rotor, touch display, an optical sensor for diverting the separated blood components into different compartments of the collection bag (collection bag, required tubing, syringes, and other consumables are not the subject of this binding tariff information decision), operating elements, USB port, and connections for tubing – according to the applicant, for intraoperative use as a tabletop device in operating rooms and thus directly at the treatment site, it serves to process blood by means of automated separation and concentration of platelet-poor and platelet-rich plasma as well as red blood cells from blood or bone marrow previously drawn by medical personnel using centrifugal force. "Centrifuge, other than milk skimmers and spin dryers, not of the type used in laboratories"

Protective cover, photo attached, - according to the application: -- packaged in a polybag, -- approximately cylindrical; with a diameter of 244 cm, -- made of approximately 0.1 mm thick, single-color fabric, laminated on both sides with a plastic film (not cellular plastic), consisting of strips with an apparent width of less than 5 mm, of synthetic spun fiber (polyethylene), -- open at the bottom, -- to be narrowed at the hemmed lower edge with a drawstring and cord stopper, -- serves as a cover to protect trampolines from rain, snow, and sun, - no indication of being handmade, - made by joining pieces together, - does not meet the conditions for classification as a tarpaulin under heading 6306, - the laminated fabric is sold by the meter under heading 5903. "Other made-up articles (protective covers) of textile materials, of woven materials, not handmade"

The product is an electric lighting fixture in the form of an LED string light, available in four versions. It consists of a ballast integrated into a Type F plug, a 3 m long power cord, and a 3.6 m long string of lights. The string light comprises ten clear, colorless plastic tubes (500 x 11 mm – L x d) that can be hung approximately 40 cm apart. Each tube contains 48 permanently installed LED light sources. The string light is available in warm white, cool white, blue, or multicolored versions. It is designed to be connected to the electrical mains and hung in various locations, both indoors and outdoors. The product is classified as an "electric luminaire, not elsewhere specified or included, not covered by subheadings (HS) 9405 11 to 9405 41, intended solely for use with LED light sources, not a spotlight, made of plastics." (See illustration in the annex.)

A set of goods consisting of artificial foliage, a string of lights, Christmas tree decorations, and decorative plastic items, a so-called Christmas garland including remote control, photo attached, no sample was submitted, classification is based on the application details, - presented for retail sale (garland, string of lights, and decorative items are separately packaged in a common outer box), - assembled to satisfy a specific need, - artificial foliage: - - in the form of a garland made of imitations of fir branches (artificial foliage), - - - made of twisted metal wires to which "fir needles" and "twig branches" are attached by spiral twisting; thus produced using floral tying techniques, - - - - the "pine needles" are formed by plastic sheets in various shades of green, which are cut in a fringed style, - - - - the "twig boughs" are formed by light brown plastic sheets, cut in a fringed style, - - - with a length of five meters, - - not a Christmas article of heading 9505, since the goods are not exclusively suitable for use during the Christmas season but are generally suitable as decorative articles, - String of lights (electric lighting fixture): - - consisting of 80 light-emitting diodes connected by cables, - - with a five-meter-long power cord with a mains plug for power supply, - - with a remote control with batteries, - - - for switching the string of lights on and off and for controlling eight lighting modes, - Decorative articles for Christmas trees (Christmas tree baubles): - - 36 small baubles made of metallized plastics with a hanging device in the shape of a crown, - Decorative articles made of plastic: - - 10 red bows made of plastic sheets with a gold-colored tie made of Plastic and wire, - - 10 replica snowflakes with a plastic body, flocked with textile materials, - the string of lights, the Christmas tree baubles and the decorative items are intended for attachment to the garland, - the artificial foliage determines the essential character of the assortment by its extent. "Artificial foliage, made of plastic"

The goods described as a "director's chair" are a foldable piece of outdoor seating furniture measuring approximately 59 x 54 x 86 cm (L x W x H). The furniture consists of a frame and struts made of eucalyptus wood and a stretched seat or upholstered backrest made of polyester. It is intended to be placed on the ground and is used to furnish gardens (or balconies). The chair is available in various colors depending on the model. The labeled goods are classified as "seating furniture other than that covered by heading 9402, not covered by subheadings 9401 10 to 9401 59, with a wooden frame, not upholstered." (Image: see attachment)

The goods described as a "director's chair" are a foldable piece of outdoor seating, measuring approximately 59 x 54 x 86 cm (L x W x H). The chair consists of a frame and various struts made of eucalyptus wood and a stretched seat and backrest made of polyester. It is designed to be placed on the ground and is intended for furnishing gardens (or balconies). The chair is available in different colors depending on the model. The labeled goods are classified as "seating furniture other than that covered by heading 9402, not covered by subheadings 9401 10 to 9401 59, with a wooden frame, not upholstered." (Image: see attachment)

LED candle with E14 base (see attached image) - electric light source in the form of a light-emitting diode lamp (LED lamp), with LEDs on a flame-shaped substrate (LED filament) and other electrical components for power supply and control on two circuit boards, with a candle-shaped, clear glass bulb and an E14 screw base for mounting in a lamp socket, - for use as a light source for easy insertion/replacement in light fixtures, - packaged in a printed retail carton. "Light-emitting diode light source (LED light source), light-emitting diode lamp (LED lamp)"

The goods are a connecting piece (not cast) made entirely of an aluminum alloy with aluminum predominant by weight (EN AW 6061), in cylindrical form, with four radially arranged threaded holes (M6) and a coaxial threaded stud (M10) on one side. It serves as a connecting element between an IV stand and the screw-in hooks for hanging IV bottles. See attached illustration. Classification under subheading 9018 9084 is not possible because the goods do not have any objective characteristics in their design that would identify them as a medical instrument normally used by physicians for the examination, treatment, or diagnosis of diseases. The IV stand and the bottle hooks themselves also do not constitute goods of heading 9018 due to their lack of a medical purpose (see Explanatory Notes to the Combined Nomenclature, heading 9018 (HS), paragraph 01.0). Such products are classified as "other aluminum products other than those specified in subheadings 7616 1000 to 7616 9910" under subheading 7616 9990 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Similar container, so-called carrying bag for yoga mats, photo see annex, - according to the application: - - with an outer surface made of textile materials, - - with a carrying handle and an adjustable shoulder strap, - - with a zipper running along the long side, - - - lined; equipped with an inset zippered pocket inside, - - with dimensions: approx. 68.5 cm (width) x 19 cm (height) x 15 cm (depth), - - intended for the transport and storage of a yoga mat, - without indication of being handmade, - not a bag for sports equipment, as it is not specifically designed to hold sports equipment. "Similar container, other than those mentioned in subheadings 4202 1110 to 4202 3900, with an outer surface made of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheading 4202 9291, not handmade"

The goods described as "Side table chain frame silver" are a piece of furniture in the form of a table, composed of various materials; dimensions: 31 cm x 31 cm x 51 cm (W x D x H). They consist of a round tabletop made of Indian marble and a circular frame made of chain links (non-flexible). The metal, as a load-bearing component and in terms of its higher value, determines the material character of the table. It is intended to be placed on the floor and is used for furnishing homes. The packaged goods are classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (see illustration in the annex)

The goods described as a "chain-frame side table" are a piece of furniture in the form of a table, composed of various materials; dimensions: 31 cm x 31 cm x 51 cm (W x D x H). It consists of a round tabletop made of Indian marble and a rounded, gold-colored frame made of chain links (non-flexible). The metal, as a load-bearing component and in terms of its higher value, determines the material character of the table. It is intended to be placed on the floor and is used for furnishing homes. The packaged goods are classified as "furniture of metal other than that covered by headings 9401 to 9402, not of a kind used in offices, not a bed, not covered by subheading (TARIC) 9403 2080 20". (see illustration in the annex)

Details: Transparent sanitary silicone; 1-component silicone-based sealant; for use in corner, movement, and connection joints in sanitary and kitchen areas, for window and glass sealing, for sealing seams of display cases and glass blocks, and for small-area bonding (e.g., window muntins); Packaging: 310 ml cartridge with screw-on dispensing nozzle. Findings: Based on its composition and intended use, the product is classified as a different type of putty (plastic putty).

Wheel bearing with integrated magnetic ABS sensor ring, - according to application/technical specifications. Drawing consisting of: - - rotating inner ring, - - non-rotating outer ring (for pressing into the wheel carrier), - - sealing system (prevents the ingress of dirt and the escape of lubricating grease), - - pulse or encoder ring rotating with the wheel speed (serves, in conjunction with a sensor - not subject to the binding tariff information - to determine the rotational speed), and - - two rows of angular contact balls, each with balls mounted in a cage, - - made essentially of base metal (bearing steel), - - with an outer diameter of 82 mm, an inner diameter of 45 mm and a width of 37 mm, - - with vehicle-specific mounting hardware, - used as a so-called first-generation wheel bearing in both driven and non-driven axles of passenger cars, - without indication of industrial assembly, - with vehicle-specific mounting hardware, - because of the pulse or encoder ring, not a rolling bearing of heading 8482, - since the goods are both If a part is recognizably suitable for both a non-driven axle of CN subheading 8708 5091 and a driven axle of CN subheading 8708 5099, and a principal use cannot be determined, it is to be assigned to the subheading that is last mentioned in the nomenclature of the equally relevant subheadings (8708 5091 / 8708 5099), provided that, based on its objective characteristics (including shape) and properties, it is recognizably intended mainly for motor vehicles of Chapter 87. "Parts for motor vehicles of heading 8703, not for industrial assembly, part of a driven axle (wheel bearing unit), not of drop-forged steel"

"Milling blades" – in the form of nearly star-shaped products made entirely of base metal (steel) with a central perforation and flattened teeth with carbide pins made of cermet (tungsten carbide and cobalt) – the working part – serve as the working part in an interchangeable milling tool (drum) for occasional use in milling machines – depending on the design, with different dimensions – for processing concrete, stone, and asphalt surfaces. See illustration in the appendix. Such products, classified as "parts of base metal for interchangeable tools for use in machine tools, not for metalworking, with a working part of cermet," fall under tariff code 8207 7090 00 0.

Description: Figurine "Frog", gray, seated in a yoga position; made of magnesia (weatherproof); for decoration. Product characteristics: Gray, seated frog figurine (dimensions (H x W x D): approx. 37 x 17 x 38 cm); made of a hard, magnesia-cement-like material, interspersed with loose fibers. Findings: Product made of asbestos cement, cellulose cement, or similar materials, but not containing asbestos.

These are nearly rectangular steel products with an oval perforation and four additional circular holes with internal threads. The products are formed into a nearly right-angled attachment and are used for mounting a microswitch in an electric motor. Dimensions (length x width): approximately 35 x 20 mm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "steel goods other than those specified in the aforementioned code number" under tariff code 7326 9098 90 0.

Signal converter, in the form of a product package consisting of instructions, cable, power supply, and a combined unit comprising a preamplifier and audio interface (main function), which defines the nature of the package with regard to its use. The product essentially consists of a printed circuit board populated with an AD/DA signal converter, preamplifier, and other active and passive components, housed in a 60.5 x 240 x 169.4 mm enclosure with controls and USB, digital, and analog audio interfaces. It is used to connect microphones, headphones, and instruments to a computer via the USB interface and for pre-amplification. The device is of the type primarily used in automatic data processing systems, connectable to the central processing unit, and capable of delivering data in a format usable by the system. The components of the package are packaged together for individual sale. The goods are classified as "unit for automatic data processing machines, other than those covered by subheadings (HS) 8471 50 to 8471 70".

LCD/OLED module combination – consisting of a 14.9" touch-sensitive LCD panel (resolution: 2720 x 720 pixels) with LED backlighting, control circuits, CAN transceiver, and other components, and a 12.25" touch-sensitive OLED panel (resolution: 1668 x 1592 pixels) with control circuits, CAN transceiver, and other components, in a common mounting housing with an LVDS/CAN interface, a CAN connector, and two power supply connectors – intended for use as both an LCD and an OLED flat panel display module after installation in motor vehicles. "Flat panel display module, also containing touch-sensitive screens, with driver or control circuits, made of organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), combination of an OLED flat panel display module and an LCD flat panel display module, without a characteristic main activity."

Glass mirror, so-called bicycle mirror, photo see annex, - goods composed of various components, - according to the application, consisting of: - - a rearview mirror made of glass: - - - mirror surface with a diameter of approx. 8 cm, - - - set in a plastic housing, - - - with a light-reflecting insert (diameter: approx. 2 cm) on the back of the housing, - - a flexible articulated arm: - - - made of plastic, - - - with a clamping device at the end for attaching the mirror to the handlebars of a bicycle, - the glass mirror, due to its importance in relation to the use, determines the essential character of the composite goods, - not classified as accessories for bicycles under heading 8714, as the wording of heading 7009 (rearview mirror) is the more precise description of the goods. Glass mirror, photo attached, - goods composed of various components, - according to the application, consisting of: - - a glass rearview mirror: - - - mirror surface with a diameter of approximately 8.5 cm, - - - set in a plastic housing, - - an articulated arm: - - - made of base metal, - - - with a clamping device at the end for attaching the mirror to the handlebars of a bicycle, - the glass mirror, due to its importance in relation to the intended use, determines the essential character of the composite goods, - not classified as bicycle accessories under heading 8714, as the wording of heading 7009 (rearview mirror) is the more precise description of the goods. "Glass mirror, framed, rearview mirror for vehicles, other than those specified in TARIC codes 7009 1000 30 to 7009 1000 60"

Glass mirrors, so-called mirror set of two, photo see annex, - goods composed of various components, - according to the application, consisting of: - - a rearview mirror made of glass: - - - mirror surface with dimensions of approx. 10 cm x 6.5 cm, - - - set in a plastic housing, - - - with a light-reflecting insert on the back of the housing (size: approx. 7 cm x 2 cm), - - an articulated arm: - - - made of base metal, - - - with a clamping device at the end for attaching the mirror to the handlebars of a bicycle, - the glass mirrors, due to their importance in relation to the use, determine the essential character of the composite goods, - not classified as accessories for bicycles under heading 8714, as the wording of heading 7009 (rearview mirror) is the more precise description of the goods. "Glass mirror, framed, rearview mirror for vehicles, other than those mentioned in TARIC codes 7009 1000 30 to 7009 1000 60"

Heterocyclic compound with only oxygen as a heteroatom; Tetrahydro-4-methyl-2-(2-methylprop-1-enyl)pyran. The product is the chemically homogeneous compound Tetrahydro-4-methyl-2-(2-methylprop-1-enyl)pyran. The CAS number is 16409-43-1. The purity is at least 99%. The product is a colorless to yellowish liquid and is used as a fragrance. The product is to be classified as another heterocyclic compound with only oxygen as a heteroatom under subheading 2932 9900 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Description: Thread guide; made of titanium dioxide; produced by pressing and mechanical shaping (green working); for further processing by firing and subsequent use in textile machines. Product characteristics: Molded part made of a white, easily scratched, non-ceramic-fired material with titanium dioxide as its main component. Findings: Articles of stone or other mineral substances, not elsewhere specified or included. Composite article in which, within the meaning of General Rule 3(b), the mineral components are considered to be the essential character.

"Special socket wrench insert" - interchangeable socket wrench insert, made entirely of aluminum, in the form of a cylindrical part on the drive side, which is fitted with a 3/4" square drive and a multi-stepped, internally toothed part on the opposite side - length: approximately 87 mm - for tightening or loosening wheel nuts with a central locking system of the Porsche 911 brand - packaged in a cardboard box with a printed sticker. See attached image. Classification under TARIC code 3926 9097 90 is not applicable, as the goods are a socket wrench insert and therefore a tool made entirely of aluminum. Such products, as "interchangeable socket wrench inserts with a working part made of base metal," fall under TARIC code 8204 2000 00.

Three-piece set consisting of a mug, a pair of socks and a sleep mask, photo see annex, - packed in a printed cardboard box, - the goods do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to carry out a particular activity; they therefore do not constitute a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b) and must therefore be classified separately, - Mug: - glazed, white, mug-shaped cup with handle; decorated on the outside with owl, star and letter motifs as well as lettering, - dimensions: 8.0 cm (diameter) x 9.5 cm (height), - ceramic product, fired after shaping, containing clay mineral material, - according to the result of the scientific examination, it is a ceramic product that has neither the characteristics of ordinary clay, nor of earthenware, stoneware or porcelain; the cup is therefore to be regarded as other ceramic goods. "Other ceramic tableware (cup), made of ceramics other than porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware or fine earthenware"

Three-piece set consisting of a mug, a pair of socks, and a sleep mask (see attached photo), packaged in a printed cardboard box. The goods do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to perform a particular activity; they therefore do not constitute a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b) and must be classified separately. Socks: with a foot length of approximately 21 cm, made of approximately 3 mm thick, solid-color plush knit fabric from synthetic fibers (as stated in the application), approximately tubular, knitted to fit and finished at the toe by sewing, with a shaped heel, printed with a non-slip material on the sole, tapered at the top, decorated with an embroidered owl face, covering the ankle but not reaching to the middle of the calf. "Knitted socks made of synthetic fibers"

Three-piece set consisting of a mug, a pair of socks, and a sleep mask (see attached photo), packaged in a printed cardboard box. The goods do not serve to satisfy a specific need or to perform a particular activity; they therefore do not constitute a set of goods within the meaning of General Rule 3(b) and must be classified separately. The sleep mask is approximately oval in shape, with a V-shaped cutout for the nose, and has maximum dimensions of approximately 20 cm x 9 cm. It has an outer layer of solid-colored plush fabric padded with a precisely fitting piece of warp-knitted foam, decorated with an embroidered owl face and joined in the middle. The inner layer is made of solid-colored fabric (satin) and padded with a piece of the aforementioned material. It is fastened to the head with a tubular band, approximately 1.2 cm wide, sewn together from the aforementioned materials. Made of fabric gathered by an elastic band, all textile products consist of 100% polyester (synthetic fibers) according to the application, made by sewing, without any indication of handwork, and, in particular with regard to the external appearance, knitted fabrics predominate, while woven fabrics predominate in terms of quantity; thus, neither of the two fabric types gives the goods their essential character; they are therefore to be assigned to the last-mentioned of the equally applicable subheadings (CN; 6307 9010 and 6307 9098) in the nomenclature. "Other made-up articles (sleep mask) of textile materials, of woven fabrics, not handmade"

Fully automated sample preparation system (see attached image) – essentially consisting of a common base platform with an xyz robot arm, an SPE system, an EVAporation system, a GPC system, an HPLC direct injection system, an XANA system, and a Thermelute system – for fully automated sample preparation by receiving, purifying, and gently concentrating crude samples for subsequent analysis in an instrument (not the subject of this binding tariff information). "Machine with its own function, not elsewhere specified or included in Chapter 84, not a commodity. TARIC codes 8479 1000 00 to 8479 8997 60 – Fully automated sample preparation system"

Ceramic goods for technical purposes, photo see attachment, no product sample was submitted, classification is based on the application details - according to the application: - - uncoated, cylindrical honeycomb bodies, - - in different sizes, - - consisting essentially of magnesium oxide, aluminum oxide and silicon oxide, - - ceramic-fired material after shaping (the ratios 2 : 3 : 5 of the aforementioned oxides to each other correspond approximately to a cordierite ceramic material), - - not refractory (resistance to temperatures up to 1,400° C), - - with a Mohs hardness of less than 9, - - with a total volume of less than 65 l, - - with at least one continuous or one-sided closed channel per square centimeter in cross-section, - - suitable for use as a support for catalysts. "Ceramic articles for technical purposes, not of porcelain, with a Mohs hardness of less than 9, carriers for catalysts, of porous cordierite or mullite ceramic materials, with a total volume not exceeding 65 l, having at least one continuous or one-sided closed channel per square centimeter in cross-section"

Label dispenser (see attached image) – consisting of a basic frame with winder/unwinder, drive unit, and dispensing tongue – available in right- and left-hand versions and adaptable to different label widths, depending on the model – for labeling products or packaging. "Machines for labeling bottles, cans, boxes, bags, or other containers – label dispensers"

Rubberwood bowl (see attached image) - round, upward-opening bowl made of rubberwood (according to the applicant; Hevea brasiliensis), lacquered, height approx. 8 cm, diameter at the bottom approx. 8 cm, at the top approx. 18 cm, - for use at the table or in the kitchen, - packaged in a cardboard box. "Woodenware for use at the table or in the kitchen, not of bamboo, not of tropical wood, not of tropical wood within the meaning of Additional Note 2 to Chapter 44"

Bed tray (see attached image) - rectangular tray with a surrounding frame featuring two carrying handles, a surface made of coated fiberboard, and two foldable H-shaped feet, made of pine (according to the applicant), measuring approximately 50 x 30 x 24.5 cm, - packaged in foil with a printed cardboard insert, - for use at the table or in the kitchen. "Wooden goods for use at the table or in the kitchen, not made of bamboo, not made of tropical wood; tray"

"Cheek brackets" These are U-shaped brackets made of round material from an aluminum alloy (EN AW 6061) with aluminum being the predominant material by weight. They have two parallel legs, bent at right angles at the ends, and each leg is provided with a transverse hole. The products serve as fastening elements for mounting bicycle couplings to luggage carriers (neither of which are part of this binding tariff information). The aforementioned bicycle couplings are bicycle accessories. The cheek brackets are parts for the couplings (accessories) that are not covered by the wording of heading 8714. The products must therefore be classified according to their own (material) composition. See the annexes for illustrations. Such products, as "other aluminum goods not covered by TARIC codes 7616 1000 10 to 7616 9990 91", belong to TARIC code 7616 9990 99.

The product illustrated by the applicant's information and the submitted illustration is a ring-shaped support ring made of polytetrafluoroethylene, a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The product is flattened on both the top and bottom surfaces and is universally used as a sealing or spacer ring in a wide variety of applications. Classification as a recognizable part of goods in Section XVI or Section XVII is not possible due to its neutral shape and universal application. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "other plastic goods, other than those covered by code numbers 3926 1000 00 0 to 3926 9097 77 0".

"Electromechanical locking drive unit" Combined machine, essentially consisting of: - a single-phase DC motor (characteristic main activity), with a rated power of 12 W, a rated speed of 10,000 rpm, a torque of 30 mNm, for a voltage of 15 VDC; - a gear transmission with external gear mounted on the motor shaft; - in a common housing with a connecting cable and plug; - dimensions (W x H x D): approximately 52.7 x 124.9 x 45.3 mm; - for converting electrical into mechanical energy for use as a drive motor on a kitchen appliance for lid locking. Such products are classified as "electric motors with a power of 37.5 W or less, DC motors not included in subheadings (CN) 8501 1010 to 8501 1093, not included in TARIC code 8501 1099". 10 to 8501 1099 79 referred to" to TARIC code 8501 1099 90.

Other ceramic tableware, so-called ceramic cup, see attached photo, - white, glazed, cup-shaped cup with handle, - dimensions: 8.3 cm (diameter) x 9.7 cm (height), - ceramic product; fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - according to the results of scientific analysis, it is earthenware. "Other ceramic tableware (cup), made of earthenware"

Porcelain tableware, so-called ceramic mugs with lids, see attached photo, - in the form of a composite item made of various materials, consisting of: - - a glazed mug without a handle; double-walled, - - - with a height of approximately 13.7 cm and a diameter (at the top) of approximately 9.2 cm, - - - with a capacity of approximately 270 ml, - - - ceramic product, fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - - - according to the application, made of porcelain, - - a precisely fitting lid with a drinking slot made of plastic, - the porcelain mug, due to its size and importance in relation to its use, determines the essential character of the composite item. "Tableware (mug), made of porcelain"

Porcelain tableware, so-called milk jugs, photo attached, - glazed, white, round jugs with handles, - according to the application, in two different sizes, - ceramic products, fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - - according to the results of the scientific analysis, it is porcelain. "Tableware (milk jugs), made of porcelain"

Other ceramic tableware, so-called MIKE ceramic cups, see attached photo, - half-glazed, cylindrical cups with brown base and handle, - in various colors, - with the dimensions: 8.8 cm (largest diameter) x 9 cm (height), - ceramic products; fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - - according to the scientific analysis, made of earthenware. "Other ceramic tableware (cups), made of earthenware"

Ceramic tableware, so-called beer stein/stand stein, photo attached, - in the form of a white, glazed, cylindrical stein with a handle, - with a diameter (at the top) of approx. 8.3 cm and a height (without lid) of approx. 18.4 cm, - decorated with one gold-colored ring at the top rim and two gold-colored rings at the bottom rim, - ceramic product, fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - according to the results of scientific analysis, the ceramic is stoneware. "Other ceramic tableware (beer stein), made of stoneware"

Other ceramic household item (spice mill), see attached photo, - dimensions: approx. 13 cm (height) x 7 cm (diameter), - composed of various materials; consisting of: - - an open-topped container made of clear glass, - - - tapering towards the top, fitted with a screw thread, - - a round plastic holder for the grinding mechanism, - - - with a clear plastic cover, - - - partially with a base metal facing, - - - screwed onto the glass container, - - a grinding mechanism with a short grinding rod and a spring made of base metal, - - a two-part white grinding mechanism (working part) integrated into the plastic holder, - - - ceramic product, fired after prior shaping, - - - according to the application, consisting of alumina ceramic (ceramic other than porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware or fine earths), - the ceramic grinding mechanism, in particular due to its importance in relation to use, determines the essential character of the goods, - serves as a household article for table or kitchen use, - not goods of heading 8210, since the working parts (grinding mechanisms) are not made of the materials listed in Note 1 to The substances mentioned in Chapter 82 do not qualify for classification under Chapter 84, as spice mills with ceramic grinding mechanisms are exempt from Chapter 84 as appliances made of ceramic materials. "Other ceramic household article (spice mill), article for table or kitchen use, made of ceramics other than porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware, fine earthenware"

Low shoes, size 25, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with uppers made of textile materials, - a reinforcing piece made of textile materials is attached to the upper, - with an elastic band and a hook-and-loop fastener over the instep, decorated with a heart-shaped pendant made of base metal, - decorated with a company logo on the hook-and-loop fastener strap, - padded in the heel area (inside) and equipped with a pull tab. "Shoes with outsoles made of plastic and uppers made of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6404 1100 to 6404 1910"

According to the application and the submitted product information, the goods described as "Coventry Classic / Diamant Design" are plastic trellises as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39 (HDPE) in various designs. The frameless products, each measuring approximately 180 x 120 x 0.5 cm (H x W x D) and available in various colors, are fully equipped with diagonal mesh windows measuring 7 x 7 cm or 2.7 x 2.7 cm and have a wood-look surface. The trellises serve as plant supports for, for example, potted and balcony plants (not the subject of this ruling). For customs tariff purposes, they are classified as "other goods made of plastics, other than those specified in code numbers 3926 1000 00 0 to 3926 9097 77 0".

Heeled sandals, size 37, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with a toeless upper made of plastic (textile fabric with an outer layer of plastic visible to the naked eye; forming the majority of the outer surface; therefore not goods of heading 6404), - reinforcing pieces of textile fabric are attached to the upper, - with a heel strap, - decorated with rhinestones across the instep, - not covering the ankle, - with a baroque heel, - with a maximum height of the heel and sole of approximately 7.5 cm. "Footwear, other than that specified in heading 6401, with outsoles and uppers made of plastic, other than those specified in subheadings (CN) 6402 1210 to 6402 9910, the vamp being open, with a heel and sole with a maximum height of more than 3 cm"

These are approximately rectangular, flat products (signs) made of base metal, bearing the word "WELCOME" and stylized butterfly motifs. They are equipped with a base metal wire at the top for hanging, for example, on a wall or door. The goods are available in various colors and serve as directional signs. Sandals, size 37, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with a toeless upper made of straps (not joined to the sole by pegs) of plastic (textile fabric with an outer layer of plastic visible to the naked eye; forming the majority of the outer surface) and textile fabrics, - with a heel strap, - with a pull tab made of textile fabrics at the heel, - with a company logo on the front strap, - not covering the ankle, - with a maximum heel and sole height of approximately 2.6 cm. "Footwear, other than that specified in heading 6401, with outsoles and uppers made of plastic, other than those specified in subheadings (CN) 6402 1210 to 6402 9910, the upper of which is made of straps, other than that specified in subheading (CN) 6402 9931"

Ceramic tableware, so-called teacup, see attached photo, - glazed, cup-shaped, conical cup with irregular lines, without a handle, - dimensions: approx. 9.4 cm (diameter at the top) x 5.4 cm (height), - ceramic product; fired after shaping; containing clay minerals, - according to the results of scientific analysis, it is stoneware. "Ceramic tableware (cup), made of stoneware"

According to the application, the item is a star-shaped decorative object measuring approximately 30 cm long x 30 cm high x 5 cm deep. The product consists of a basic framework of wooden slats, which is wrapped with flexible grapevine branches (wickerwork as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46) using a wickerwork technique. A textile hanging loop is attached to the top. The wickerwork, in terms of its extent and importance to the decorative effect, defines the character of this handmade product. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "Other goods, produced directly from plant-based wickerwork materials other than bamboo or rattan, other than straw bottle sleeves, handcrafted".

Other ceramic tableware, so-called herbal teacup, photo see attachment, - in the form of a composite ware, consisting of: - - a multicolored, glazed, bulbous cup with handle and lid, - - - in the dimensions: 9.6 cm (largest diameter) x 9.5 cm (height), - - - ceramic product, fired after shaping, containing clay mineral material, - - - according to the results of the scientific examination, it is neither porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware nor fine earthenware; the cup is to be considered other ceramic ware, - - a precisely fitting, removable tea strainer with a handle made of base metal, - especially in terms of its importance with regard to use, the cup made of other ceramic gives the composite ware its essential character. "Other ceramic tableware (cup), made of ceramic other than porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware or fine earthenware"

Porcelain tableware, see attached photo, - glazed, white, conical cup with handle, decorated inside and out with a floral pattern, - with three small 2 cm high feet on the base, - dimensions: approx. 11.2 cm (diameter at the top) x 7.5 cm (height), - ceramic product, fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - according to scientific analysis, made of porcelain, - in two different colors. "Tableware (cup), made of porcelain"

Ceramic tableware, so-called teapot with strainer, photo attached, - in the form of a composite item, consisting of: - - a glazed teapot with handle and spout, - - - with a height of approx. 11.5 cm and a diameter (at the top) of approx. 8.7 cm, - - - ceramic product, fired after shaping, containing clay minerals, - - - according to the results of the scientific analysis, it is stoneware, and - - a lid made of base metal, as well as - - a precisely fitting, removable tea strainer made of base metal, - the ceramic teapot, in particular due to its size and importance with regard to use, determines the essential character of the composite item. "Ceramic tableware (teapot), made of stoneware"

Sandals, size 37, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with a toeless upper made of straps/bands (not joined to the sole by pegs) of plastic, - with a heel strap, with a buckle closure on the side, - decorated with rhinestones in the instep area, - not covering the ankle, - with a maximum heel and sole height of approximately 1.8 cm. "Footwear, other than that specified in heading 6401, with outsoles and uppers made of plastic, other than those specified in subheadings (CN) 6402 1210 to 6402 9910, the upper of which is made of straps, other than that specified in subheading (CN) 6402 9931"

Loudspeaker (see attached image) – consisting of two loudspeakers and an audio frequency amplifier in a single enclosure (dimensions: 206 x 140 x 136 mm) with audio inputs, – with a rated power of 40 W, – for converting electrical audio frequency impulses into sound vibrations, – together with accessories (wall bracket) in a common retail package. The loudspeaker determines the character of the whole. "Two or more loudspeakers in a common enclosure (multiple loudspeakers), in a product set presented for individual sale with non-character-defining accessories."

Recombinant antigens in solution. These products are biotechnologically (recombinantly) produced antigens (proteins) of human, microbial, or viral origin, expressed in suitable host cells and purified. The antigens are present in aqueous, frozen solutions. The antigens are usually traded in quantities of 1 mg, 5 mg, or 10 mg per package. The antigens are used for the manufacture of diagnostic immunological tests. The goods are to be classified as vaccine-like products under subheading 3002 4900 of the Combined Nomenclature. They are not immunological products within the meaning of Note 2 to Chapter 30 of the CN.

The product in question is a driveshaft, also known as a "profile tube for driveshafts," as illustrated in the attachment. It is a combined unit consisting essentially of two couplings mounted on either side of a driveshaft. The driveshaft, available in various designs, comprises an inner profile tube and an outer profile tube that are inserted into one another. Lengths vary between 0.5 m and 3 m. The product's primary function is to transmit rotational forces between a tractor and a coupled trailer. "Driveshafts, not for civil aircraft"

Sandals, size 37, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with a toeless upper made of textile materials (forming the majority of the outer surface) and plastic (textile with a plastic outer layer visible to the naked eye), - a plastic reinforcement is attached to the upper, - with a heel strap and a buckle closure on the side, - decorated with a company logo made of base metal on the instep. "Footwear with outsoles of plastic and uppers of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6404 1100 to 6404 1910"

Low shoes, size 37, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with uppers made of textile materials, - reinforcing parts made of textile materials are attached to the upper, - with lace closure, partly with eyelets made of base metal, with a tassel threaded onto the laces and with beads made of plastic, - marked with company logos on the sides, on the eyelets and on the tongue. "Shoes with outsoles made of plastic and uppers made of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6404 1100 to 6404 1910"

Fan tunnel (see attached illustration), - made from a product of galvanized sheet steel manufactured according to a technical drawing, in an approximately rectangular shape with one bent long side and with various cutouts on the opposite long side as well as a cable cutout, - clearly intended exclusively for installation in an audio frequency amplifier. "Part clearly intended exclusively or principally for audio frequency amplifiers"

According to the application and the submitted product information, the product is a set of goods packaged for retail sale (cardboard box), consisting of: - a thermally insulated, specifically shaped drainage system (so-called gully) made of polyurethane, a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39, -- with a foamed-in connection sleeve of approximately 495 x 495 mm made of polyvinyl chloride, -- integrated into an insulating body of approximately 1000 x 500 x 120 mm (L x W x H) made of polyurethane or mineral wool (depending on the model), - a flexible vapor barrier panel made of plastic, - stainless steel pipes with a total length of 2 to 4 m, - stainless steel connectors, retaining clamps, and pipe clamps, - various assembly and fastening materials, - paper assembly instructions. The disassembled product serves as a component in the construction of flat roofs for the flow-through drainage of roof surfaces and is incorporated into a flat roof structure for this purpose. Particularly with regard to its quantity and significance in relation to its use, the plastic determines the nature of the goods. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as a "construction material made of plastics, not elsewhere specified or included, not covered by subheadings (CN) 3925 1000 to 3925 9020".

The so-called "MÜLO" bin enclosures are almost cuboid, unassembled boxes without a base. Made of powder-coated sheet steel, the boxes consist essentially of a frame, a back panel, two side panels, four hinged lids, and four wood-look doors, each equipped with a locking mechanism. Numerous ventilation slots ensure air circulation. Dimensions (assembled): approximately 280 cm x 77.5 cm x 130.5 cm. The boxes are intended for permanent outdoor installation and serve as shelters for four bins (not the subject of this binding tariff information). They are packaged in four cartons. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "other steel structures, consisting entirely or mainly of sheet metal (not composite panels)" under tariff code 7308 9059 90 0.

This is a so-called "Saint-Tropez" carport in kit form, essentially consisting of a basic structure with a rectangular, slightly curved aluminum roof frame, six aluminum posts, steel mounting screws, and a polycarbonate roof covering. The product, designed for permanent ground mounting, serves to protect cars from the elements such as rain, snow, hail, and sunlight. It is packaged together with ground anchor kits in three boxes for individual sale. Dimensions (assembled): approximately 503 cm x 328 cm x 211 cm. - Applicant's information - The carport, in terms of its significance for use and scope, defines the character of the product as a whole. While the carport is composed of various materials, the basic structure made of aluminum and steel is the defining characteristic with regard to its use. Aluminum predominates over steel by weight. See attached illustration. Such products are classified as "other than aluminum constructions (as specified in code numbers 7610 1000 00 0 to 7610 9090 91 0), goods contained in a packaged kit which includes the parts required to assemble a finished product, where no further finishing is required for these parts ('kit of finished products')" under code number 7610 9090 92 0 of the Customs Tariff.

Tracking label (see attached image) – consisting of a Bluetooth chip with memory and temperature sensor, an RFID chip with antenna, a capacitor, and a lithium-manganese button cell battery, all housed in a self-adhesive label measuring 27.00 x 88.00 x 2.34 mm – for receiving, converting, and transmitting data using the Bluetooth standard (for real-time tracking of mobile assets) – its primary function – as well as for radio frequency identification via UHF in radio frequency identification systems and for temperature monitoring – supplied on rolls of 500 labels. “Apparatus for communication in a wired or wireless network, not a base station, device for receiving, converting, and transmitting sounds, images, or other data, combination of communication apparatus – its primary function – semiconductor recording medium, and temperature sensor.”

"Noise barrier element with integrated PV element" is a product composed of various components, consisting of: - a so-called noise barrier element, made of an aluminum frame with tongue and groove joints and integrated EPDM seals for sound absorption - and a solar panel (photovoltaic DC generator) with a maximum output of 600 Wp, mounted on one side, with a screwed-on aluminum cover profile and insulation wool filling. The noise barrier element determines the character of the product, which is composed of various components, with regard to its value and size. Since no single material can be identified as conferring a characteristic on the noise barrier element, it is classified under the last of the equally applicable headings (here, heading 7610). See attached illustration. Such products belong to subheading 7610 9090 of the Combined Nomenclature as "other structural components made of aluminum".
Description: Mica; Mineral. Product characteristics: Light, fine, shiny powder (muscovite, mineral substance), packaged in a sample container. Findings: Mica powder.

Two-piece set consisting of a shoulder bag and a bottle carrier, so-called toiletry bag, see attached photo, - Shoulder bag (similar container): - - with a textile exterior, - - with a detachable, adjustable shoulder strap with shoulder pad, - - with a zipper running along the top edge on three sides, - - - padded and lined; equipped with an open slip pocket inside, - - with dimensions: approx. 26 cm (width) x 31 cm (height) x 18 cm (depth), - - without any indication of being handmade, - Bottle carrier (similar container): - - with a textile exterior, - - with two carrying handles, - - open at the top; without a closure, - - - unlined; Divided internally by partitions into six equally sized compartments for holding bottles, - - with dimensions: approx. 24 cm (width) x 20 cm (height) x 16 cm (depth), - - without indication of handwork, - - placed in the shoulder bag. According to the application, the item is a star-shaped decorative object measuring approximately 11.5 cm long x 11.5 cm wide x 8 cm deep. The item consists of a metal wire frame wrapped with flexible rattan branches (wickerwork as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46) using a woven technique. A textile hanging loop is attached to the top. The wickerwork, in terms of its extent and importance to the decorative effect, defines the character of this handmade item. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "Other goods, produced directly from plant-based wickerwork, of rattan, handcrafted."

Moringa extract. White powder, purified extract of the seeds of Moringa oleifera, intended for use in the food industry. Starch/Glucose*: 50 to less than 75% by weight. Sucrose/Invert sugar/Isoglucose**: less than 5% by weight. Milk fat, milk protein: not included according to the recipe. *: Application information: Food preparation, not elsewhere specified or included, containing 5% or more by weight of glucose or starch, not containing milk fat, with a sucrose (including invert sugar calculated as sucrose) or isoglucose (calculated as sucrose) content of less than 60% by weight.

According to the application and the submitted product information, the product in question is a hygiene pad consisting of: - a waterproof polypropylene underside, - an absorbent layer applied to it, consisting of a mixture of cellulose (fluff pulp), polyethylene, and a so-called superabsorbent polymer (SAP) made of plastics as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39, and - a top layer made of a polypropylene nonwoven fabric. The rectangular product, available in various dimensions, is intended for single use and serves as a pad for patients in nursing and hospital settings. With regard to its use, the absorbent layer made of cellulose fibers, polyethylene, and superabsorbent polymer (SAP) determines the character of the composite product in relation to the other materials. However, with regard to its use, the SAP, as a highly absorbent storage medium for liquids, determines the essential character of the absorbent layer and thus of the patient pad. Classification as "hygienic sanitary pads (pads) and tampons, diapers, diaper inserts and similar articles of any material" within the meaning of heading 9619 is not applicable, as the patient pad is not a personal care product. The goods, packaged as a set of 10 or individually in a polybag, are classified for customs tariff purposes as "hygiene and toilet articles of plastics; not covered by TARIC codes 3924 1000 11 to 3924 9000 10".

According to the application details and the submitted product sample, the product is a hygiene pad (so-called incontinence pad) consisting of: - a base layer made of polyethylene film, - an absorbent layer applied to this film, consisting of a mixture of cellulose (fluff pulp) and a so-called superabsorbent polymer (SAP) made of plastics as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39, and - a top layer made of nonwoven polypropylene. The product, measuring approximately 60 x 90 cm, is intended for single use and serves as an incontinence pad. With regard to its use, the absorbent layer made of cellulose fibers and superabsorbent polymer (SAP) determines the character of the composite product in relation to the other materials. However, with regard to its use, the SAP, as a particularly absorbent storage medium for liquids, determines the essential character of the absorbent layer and thus of the incontinence pad. Classification as "hygienic sanitary pads (pads) and tampons, diapers, diaper inserts and similar articles of any material" within the meaning of heading 9619 is not applicable, as the incontinence pad is not a personal care product. The goods, packaged as a set of 30 in a polybag, are classified for customs tariff purposes as "hygiene and toilet articles of plastics; not covered by TARIC codes 3924 1000 11 to 3924 9000 10".

Applicant's description: Goods consisting of a tape dispenser and two rolls of polypropylene tape with a maximum roll width of 19 mm, with a plastic-based adhesive. The tape dispenser consists of two interlocking plastic halves and a serrated tear-off edge made of base metal. The mini-dispenser, together with the two tape rolls, is packaged in a plastic bag in retail packaging. No sample was submitted. Classification: Sheets, plates, films, foils, tapes, strips and other flat products, self-adhesive, made of plastics, also in rolls; in rolls with a width of 20 cm or less; other; other; other

Findings on a sample: Flat tablet with break lines (dimensions: approx. 5.5 x 3.5 cm) made of milk chocolate; odor: chocolate; taste: sweet, milk chocolate. Findings: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other, in the form of tablets, bars, or sticks: unfilled: other

Description: Metal gift box filled with chocolate pralines with milk cream filling and filled and unfilled milk chocolates, 105g. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: Four individually wrapped, oblong, brown chocolate pralines with a chocolatey aroma (dimensions in cm: approx. 3.5 x 2 x 1.5), filled with a light beige, firm cream, and four brown milk chocolate eggs (height: approx. 3 cm, diameter: approx. 1.5 cm), filled with a brown cream containing crunchy elements, wrapped in green aluminum foil with white dots. The filled chocolate products are contained together with hollow chocolate products (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-34824/26-3) in a bucket-shaped container with a handle and lid (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-34824/26-2), to the handle of which a cardboard tag is attached, labelled (excerpt: "Confectionery"). This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the filled chocolate products contained in the bucket-shaped container and hollow chocolate products. Finding: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: Pralines, also filled: other.

These are steel tins, shaped like buckets with a snap-on lid and handle. The products are completely covered on the outside with a colored coating and Easter motifs, as well as a brand name (but not with detailed information or consumer information about the contents). Such products, classified as "steel goods other than those specified in the preceding subheadings," fall under subheading 7326 9098 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Details: Metal gift box filled with chocolate pralines with milk cream filling and filled and unfilled milk chocolates, 105g. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Cabin air filter (see attached image) - consisting of a cuboid, lamellar-folded paper filter surface, firmly glued into a rectangular plastic frame, with dimensions (L x W x H) of approximately 570 x 140 x 57 mm, - after installation in a mounting frame for filtering dust, pollen, and fine dust from the air entering the vehicle interior, - for installation in the heating/air conditioning and ventilation systems of agricultural and forestry machinery. "Apparatus for filtering gases, not an air intake filter for internal combustion piston engines, other than those covered by code numbers 8421 3200 10 0 to 8421 3915 00 0, apparatus for filtering or cleaning air, incomplete"

Embroidery, photo attached, - as strips, worked in the form of a series of diamonds, with a width of approximately 8 cm, - with a base of nonwoven fabrics made of textile materials and strips of plastic; both made of polyester according to the application, - embroidered with yarns made predominantly of synthetic chemical fibers (polyester according to the application) and additionally with decorative yarns made of jute according to the application, - with a value exceeding EUR 17.50 per kg of net weight according to the application, - not caustic embroidery or embroidery with a cut-out base, - without any indication of handwork, - presents itself as embroidery, and therefore, among other things, not a product of Chapter 55. "Embroidery in the form of strips, other than caustic embroidery and embroidery with a cut-out base, made of chemical fibers, with a value exceeding EUR 17.50 per kg of net weight, not handwork"
