Embroidery, photo attached, - as a strip, approximately 9.5 cm wide, - with a ground fabric of cotton and flax (linen) as stated in the application; the application's statements of 50% cotton and 50% linen can be considered correct, - embroidered with decorative yarns of cotton as stated in the application, therefore not goods of heading 5808, - with a value exceeding EUR 17.50 per kg net weight as stated in the application, - partially backed on the reverse with a thin layer of what appears to be nonwoven fabric of spun cotton, - finished with true selvedges on the long sides, - not caustic embroidery or embroidery with a cut-out ground, - without any indication of being handmade. The articles illustrated in the data sheets are so-called port locks in the form of plug-in inserts, made of plastics as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The articles, measuring approximately 18.5 x 13.8 x 10.8 mm, are almost completely closed on the front (except for a special recess for a plugging tool) and have an almost rectangular cutout on the top. They are intended for use, for example, in cable sockets of PCs, multimedia devices, or junction boxes and are flush with the outer end of the socket. The inserts serve to protect the device, for example, from unauthorized use or the unintentional insertion of connecting cables. Classification as a lock or fastener of base metal under heading 8301 is precluded due to the material composition and the absence of a locking mechanism. The products are packaged in sets of 10 together with a key-shaped removal tool and are classified under customs tariff law as "other plastic goods not covered by subheadings (CN) 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".

Ready-made ribbon, photo attached, - sold by the meter, approximately 3 cm wide, - made of two layers, each layer consisting of: -- a knitted fabric of man-made fibers (viscose according to the application) and synthetic fibers (polyester according to the application) of heading 6003; the application's statements of 99% viscose and 1% polyester can be considered correct, - finished by sewing along one long side, therefore not a product of heading 5808. "Other made-up articles (decorative ribbon), of textile materials, knitted"

Applicant's information: Mixture of cocoa-containing and non-cocoa-containing sugar sprinkles. Confidential information regarding the composition is available. Packaging: 30 kg paper bags. A product sample was not submitted. Finding: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other preparations in blocks, bars or sticks weighing more than 2 kg or in liquid, paste, powder, granule or similar form, in containers or immediate packings with a content exceeding 2 kg: other: other

Slippers, size 37, see attached photo, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with an upper made of textile materials (net-like fabric of monofilaments covered with knitted yarns; forming the majority of the outer surface) and plastic (textile with an outer layer of plastic visible to the naked eye), - a reinforcing piece (edge ​​binding) made of plastic is attached to the upper, - with a plastic strap over the instep. "Footwear with outsoles of plastic and uppers of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6404 1100 to 6404 1910"

The goods, illustrated by a data sheet with a picture, are a toy in the form of a spinning top. The top consists of a round wooden base decorated with multicolored plastic rhinestones and equipped with a rounded spinning rod on the underside. There is no indication that it is handmade. The goods are intended for recreational use. The wood, particularly in terms of its size, defines the character of the product. For customs tariff purposes, such products are classified as "toys other than those covered by subheadings (CN) 9503 0010 to 9503 0095, not handmade from wood".

According to the application details and the submitted sample, the so-called "camera adapter" is a mount made of character-giving plastics within the meaning of Note 1 to 39. The product, measuring approximately 4 x 2 x 2 cm, has a 1/4-inch threaded stud made of base metal with a plastic star knob on the top and two centrally perforated mounting discs on the underside. The adapter is used to attach digital cameras, compact cameras, and accessories to action camera mounts and is packaged in a printed folding box. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "other goods made of plastic, not covered by CN subheadings 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".

According to the application details and the submitted sample, the product is a cuboid, open-topped storage container made of colorless-transparent acrylic (plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39). The product, measuring approximately 20 x 6.5 x 16 cm, has two holes on the back for attaching suction cups for temporary wall mounting or, optionally, for attaching an angled acrylic mounting plate (included in the delivery) for hanging on, for example, drawer fronts or cabinet doors. Such goods are objectively intended for storing objects of all kinds (cutlery, brushes, or other utensils), for example, in the kitchen or bathroom. Classification as furniture under Chapter 94 is not possible, as the product is not placed on the floor and is not covered by the exceptions listed in Note 2, paragraph 2, to Chapter 94. The so-called "cutlery holder" is packaged in a sales container, unassembled together with the mounting accessories and assembly instructions, and is classified under customs tariff law as "other goods made of plastics, other than those specified in code numbers 3926 1000 00 0 to 3926 9097 77 0" according to its material composition.

Low shoes, size 42, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application; without a wooden insole, - with an upper (closed vamp) made of leather (forming the largest part of the outer surface), textiles and plastic (textile with a plastic outer layer visible to the naked eye), - with a dial closure, - with company logos on the sides and on the dial, - without metal protection in the toe cap, - not covering the ankle, - with an insole length of approx. 28 cm, - with a pull tab in the heel area, - recognizable as men's shoes; Therefore, not goods of subheading (CN) 6403 9993. "Footshoes with plastic soles and leather uppers, other than those specified in subheadings (CN) 6403 1200 to 6403 9950, with an insole length exceeding 24 cm, for men, other than those specified in TARIC code 6403 9996 10"

Low shoes, size 33, see attached photo, - with rubber/plastic outsoles, - with upper (closed vamp) made of plastic (textile fabric with an outer layer of plastic visible to the naked eye, forming the majority of the outer surface; therefore not goods of heading 6404) and textile fabrics, - reinforcing parts made of plastic are attached to the upper, - with lace closure, - with company logos on the sides, in the area of ​​the heel and on the tongue, - not covering the ankle, - without metal protection in the toe cap, - with an insole length of approx. 22.5 cm, - does not meet the conditions for classification as sports footwear. "Footwear, other than that specified in heading 6401, with outsoles of rubber/plastic and uppers of plastic, other than those specified in subheadings (CN) 6402 1210 to 6402 9950, with an insole length of less than 24 cm"

According to the application and the submitted sample, the so-called "Decorative Shelf Sitter Angel" is a stylized angel figure in two color versions, consisting of a conical torso with an attached head, hands, and feet made of a foamed plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The decorative item has a painted face and is equipped with movable arms and legs, as well as a "dress" and a hat made of textiles. The item has permanently attached textile wings on its back and a hanging loop on its top. Due to the objective nature and design of the item (designed as a shelf sitter, with a flattened body and excessively long legs), classification as a festive item or Christmas tree ornament under heading 9505 is not possible. Furthermore, it is not a doll as defined in heading 9503 (as an angel, it is not a human representation). Particularly with regard to its significance in terms of use, the plastic is considered to be a character-giving element. Such products are classified under customs tariff law as "other goods made of plastic, statuettes and other ornamental articles".

These are steel wire rods in various dimensions, with a round cross-section that remains constant along their entire length (maximum cross-sectional dimension: 6 mm or 8 mm), tapered at one end like a shepherd's crook. The products are intended to be inserted into the ground and serve as plant stakes or climbing supports for plants, as well as for hanging. Length: approximately 120, 150, or 180 cm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products fall under the heading 7326 2000 90 0 as "other goods made of steel wire". Classification under heading 8306 is not possible due to their use as plant stakes/climbing supports or hanging devices.

According to the applicant's information and the accompanying illustration, the product is made of wickerwork. Available in various sizes, it consists of a framework wrapped with whitewashed, flexible grapevine branches (wickerwork as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46) using a wickerwork technique. The product is attached to a wooden stake for use as a decorative stake and serves to adorn containers and flowerbeds. The wickerwork, in terms of its extent and significance for the decorative effect, defines the character of this handcrafted product. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "Other wickerwork, made directly from plant materials other than bamboo or rattan, other than straw bottle sleeves, handcrafted".

According to the applicant's information and the accompanying illustration, the product is made of woven materials. Available in various sizes, it consists of a heart-shaped frame wrapped with whitewashed, flexible grapevine branches (woven material as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46) using a woven technique. The product is attached to a wooden stake for use as a decorative stake and is intended for decorating containers and flowerbeds. The woven materials, in terms of their extent and significance for the decorative effect, define the character of this handcrafted product. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "Other woven goods, made directly from plant materials other than bamboo or rattan, other than straw bottle sleeves, handcrafted."

Description: Slabs of burnt lime and silica (silicic acid) for thermal insulation purposes in the refractory industry; in various sizes and thicknesses. Product characteristics: Section (dimensions (L x W x H): approx. 10 x 10 x 2.4 cm) of a white, soft, crumbly, fibrous slab. Classification: Mixtures and articles of mineral substances for thermal, cold, or sound insulation purposes, excluding articles of headings 6811 and 6812 or of Chapter 69, other than those specified in subheadings 6806 10 to 6806 20.

Low shoes, size 38, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with uppers made of textile materials, - the uppers are reinforced with plastic (textile with a visible outer layer of plastic) and textile materials, additionally reinforced with plastic, - with an elastic cord across the instep in the form of a lace-up closure, - with company logos on the sides and tongue. "Shoes with outsoles of plastic and uppers made of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6404 1100 to 6404 1910"

According to the applicant's information and the submitted samples, the products are unprinted cardboard folding boxes (sample packaging), each containing twenty tobacco sticks approximately 4.8 cm long. The sticks have the following structure (from the burning end to the mouthpiece): a slightly moist strand of cut, brown material, apparently tobacco foil (reconstituted tobacco); a non-woven, tube-like filter element; a section of accordion-folded paper; a non-woven filter piece; and are wrapped in white cigarette paper printed with two bronze-colored stripes and a brand name. The sticks, available in three different flavors, are intended to be heated in a special electric vaporizer, with the resulting vapor being inhaled (non-combustion inhalation). For customs tariff purposes, such goods are to be classified as "products for non-combustion inhalation containing tobacco or reconstituted tobacco."

Low shoes, size 42, photo see attachment, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with uppers made of textile materials (forming the majority of the outer surface) and plastic (textile with an outer layer of plastic visible to the naked eye), - reinforcing parts made of plastic and textile materials are attached to the upper, - with an elastic cord over the instep, - with a pull tab at the heel, - with company logos on the sides, the pull tab and the tongue. "Shoes with outsoles of plastic and uppers made of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6404 1100 to 6404 1910"

Molybdenum disulfide (MoS₂) The product is a very fine, black powder of molybdenum disulfide (CAS No. 1317-33-5) with a purity of 97% according to the safety data sheet, obtained from an ore through conventional processing methods such as crushing, grinding, and flotation. The product is used as a lubricant. It is to be classified as other molybdenum ore under subheading 2613 9000 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Chili seasoning sauce in a brightly printed folding carton containing a glass bottle with a black screw cap, labeled all around. The label includes information about the distributor, product name, volume (60 ml), ingredients, and nutritional values. Contents: Reddish-brown, cloudy liquid containing small, solid particles; flavor: spicy, salty, slightly sour, and intensely hot. Other prepared seasoning sauce, not containing any of the subheadings 2103 1000 to 2103 9030 of the CN, tomatoes, or added monosodium glutamate.

According to the application details and the submitted product information, the item is an ornamental object made of acrylic, a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The product consists of nine stylized diamond and butterfly replicas of varying sizes and colors, arranged on a rod approximately 45 cm long and made of base metal. The goods are intended as decorative elements in flowerbeds, tubs, or balcony boxes (not the subject of this ruling). Given their significance in terms of use and scope, the plastics determine the nature of the composite product. Such goods are classified under customs tariff regulations as "other products of plastics; statuettes and other ornamental articles".

According to the application details and the accompanying illustration, the product is a rectangular woven material made from dried reed stems (wickerwork as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46), arranged parallel to one another and bound together in a mat-like form using binding material (thin metal wires). The product, measuring approximately 50 x 100 cm (height x length), is primarily intended for use as frost protection for plant containers and pots. For customs tariff purposes, it is classified as "wickerwork, joined parallel to one another in a sheet-like form, even if this gives it the character of finished goods (e.g., mats, straw mats, latticework), made from plant materials other than bamboo or rattan, and not from wickerwork or similar articles made from wickerwork."

According to the application details and the available illustrations, the goods are rectangular woven products, each consisting of dried straw (wickerwork as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46), arranged in parallel bundles and bound together in mat form with binding material (textile yarns). The goods, manufactured in two sizes, are primarily intended for use as frost protection for planters and pots. For customs tariff purposes, they are classified as "wickerwork, joined together in a sheet form, even if this gives it the character of finished goods (e.g., mats, straw mats, latticework), made from plant materials other than bamboo or rattan, and not from wickerwork or similar articles made from wickerwork."

According to the applicant's information and the available illustrations, the product is a rectangular woven material made from dried heather shoots (wickerwork within the meaning of Note 1 to Chapter 46), arranged parallel to one another and bound together in mat form with binding material (thin metal wires). The product illustrated by a sample is a board game for 2-4 players, consisting of: a stylized cardboard drawer (box) measuring approximately 9.2 x 7 x 2.5 cm; 15 stylized cardboard socks, printed with one color (red, turquoise, purple, orange, multicolored) on the front and a uniform print on the back; and four cardboard goblins, each with differently colored hair (red, turquoise, purple, orange) and an opening mouth. The board game is packaged in a printed cardboard box along with English instructions. At the start of the game, the socks are placed face down in the drawer. A player takes a sock from the drawer. If the color of the sock matches the goblin's hair, the player places the sock in the goblin's mouth. If the color does not match the goblin's hair, the sock is placed face down on the table. The next players can now take turns taking a sock from the drawer or the table. The player who first places three socks of the same color into the goblin's mouth wins the game. Such products are classified under customs tariff headings as "board games, not covered by subheadings (CN) 9504 2000 to 9504 9010".

The product illustrated by a sample is a board game for 2-5 players, consisting of: a plastic board with a spinner featuring an axolotl (named "Alan") in a car; and 24 approximately square (6.5 x 6.5 cm) cardboard cards, each with a task printed on the front and a uniform back. The board game is packaged in a printed cardboard box along with English instructions. At the start of the game, the cards are shuffled and placed face down in a pile on the table. "Alan" is turned over, and the player to whom "Alan" points receives him. Then, the player in possession of "Alan" turns over a card and passes "Alan" to the corresponding player according to the task. The player in possession of "Alan" who draws the winning card wins the game. Such products are classified under customs tariff law as "board games, not covered by subheadings (CN) 9504 2000 to 9504 9010".

The product illustrated by a sample is a board game consisting of: - 30 approximately rectangular (approx. 6.2 x 4.1 cm) cardboard question cards, each printed with a question on the front and the correct answer in the form of colors on the back; - 14 approximately rectangular (approx. 6.2 x 4.1 cm) cardboard color cards, each printed with a color (black, white, red, blue, green, yellow, orange) on the front and a number (1 or 2) on the back; - two stylized cardboard paintbrushes that serve as holders for the aforementioned color cards. The board game is packaged in a printed cardboard box along with English-language instructions. At the start of the game, the players divide into two groups. Each group receives a set of color cards and a holder, and the question cards are laid face up. Both groups now answer the question on the question card by guessing the correct color combination and placing the corresponding color cards on the table. The group that uncovers the correct color cards receives the question card. If both groups are correct, the next question card is played. The first group to collect five question cards wins the game. Such products are classified under customs tariff headings as "board games, not covered by subheadings (CN) 9504 2000 to 9504 9010".

Information: Self-emulsifying oil-in-water emulsifier; recommended for use in oil-based cleansing products and, due to its high water-binding capacity, for skincare applications; not packaged for retail sale. According to the applicant's information, the supplementary application details, and the submitted dimensional drawings and illustrations, the product is a so-called "interior trim panel" made of molded plastic, as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39, for a motor vehicle. Classification under heading 8708 is not possible, as body fittings made of plastics are classified as parts with general uses under Section XVII. "Necklace with luminous pendant" These are necklaces consisting essentially of an approximately 84 cm long cord made of textile materials and a pendant (approximately 5 cm long) in the form of a transparent, cylindrical rod made of plastic and a two-part, screw-together "setting" made of base metal, attached to it by means of a triangular eyelet made of base metal. The rod is equipped with a light-emitting diode (LED) powered by button cell batteries. The LED is switched on and off by tightening or loosening the two parts of the "setting." The products are packaged in a plastic bag. See attached image. Such products are classified as "other fancy jewelry" under subheading 7117 9000 of the Combined Nomenclature.

"Illuminated Star Pendant" This is a type of necklace, essentially consisting of an approximately 80 cm long cord made of textile materials and a pendant in the shape of a stylized star (also available in the shape of a stylized heart or cross) made of plastic, attached to it by means of a triangular eyelet made of base metal. The star is equipped with battery-operated LEDs and connected to a cylindrical housing with a screw cap (mainly made of base metal), into which replaceable button cells are inserted. The LEDs are switched on and off by turning the screw cap. The products are packaged in a plastic bag. - Applicant's information - See attached image. The plastic pendant, in contrast to the textile material and base metal, gives the product its distinctive character with regard to its use as an ornamental element of the product, which is composed of various materials and components. Such products are classified as "other fancy jewelry (other than that specified in subheadings 7117 1100 to 7117 1900)" under subheading 7117 9000 of the Combined Nomenclature.

"Necklace with luminous pendant:" These are necklaces approximately 62 cm long, consisting essentially of a flat woven fabric band and a flat, square, rectangular, or circular pendant made of plastic. A housing containing replaceable button cell batteries and an on/off switch is attached to each end. Pressing the on/off switch conducts current through the wires, causing a light-emitting diode (LED) located above the pendant to flash (fast flashing, slow flashing) or to glow (continuous light). The products are packaged in a plastic bag. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "other fancy jewelry (other than that specified in subheadings 7117 1100 to 7117 1900)" under subheading 7117 9000 of the Combined Nomenclature.

A precisely fitting plastic housing with an integrated magnet is inserted into the oval upper part. The hinged products are attached to magnetic surfaces. - Applicant's information - The steel hook, in particular with regard to its significance for use, determines the nature of the goods, which are composed of various materials and components. See attached illustration. Such products, classified as "goods of base metal similar to coat hooks," fall under tariff code 8302 5000 00 0.

These are nearly hollow cylindrical steel products with a double-stepped exterior and an external thread (M30) in the middle section. A U-shaped recess is located on the side of the wall. The interior of the product features further, slight steps. A circumferential groove is located above the thread. The product is used for attaching, guiding, and positioning a sensor on an axle housing. Length: 62 mm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "steel goods similar to screws and bolts, with threads" under tariff code 7318 1900 90 0.

Other ceramic tableware, so-called ceramic cups, see attached photo, - glazed, beaker-shaped cups with handles, decorated with various city motifs, - dimensions: 10.1 cm (diameter) x 9.0 cm (height), - ceramic products; fired after shaping; containing clay mineral material, - according to the results of the scientific examination, the ceramic is neither porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware or fine earthenware; the cups are therefore to be considered tableware made of other ceramics. "Other ceramic tableware (cups), made of ceramics other than porcelain, ordinary clay, stoneware, earthenware or fine earthenware"

These are so-called cold-water pipe clamps, each consisting of two approximately U-shaped steel clamping jaws (one with a welded-on, internally threaded steel hex nut), each with two perforated, approximately right-angled outlets, and connected by two steel screws. The clamping jaw with the welded-on hex nut is bonded internally to a so-called pipe support, which consists of two semi-circular, nearly U-shaped insulating shells made of cellular plastic. These are held together by an externally applied aluminum foil adhesive tape to form a hinged hollow cylinder. The products are used to secure pipes whose temperature is below room temperature to walls or ceilings. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "steel goods other than those specified in the aforementioned code numbers" under tariff code 7326 90 98 90 0.

This is a so-called louvered wall in the form of a kit, essentially consisting of a rectangular, two-part aluminum frame with two support legs and movable aluminum louvers mounted parallel to each other within the frame. The product is attached as a side panel to flat-roofed pergolas (not subject to the binding tariff information) that are permanently fixed to the ground, and serves as a privacy screen or windbreak. It is packaged in a cardboard box. Dimensions (assembled - width x height): approximately 90 cm x 231 cm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products, classified as "other than those specified in TARIC codes 7610 1000 00 to 7610 9090 91) aluminum construction parts, goods contained in a packaged kit which includes the parts required to assemble a finished product, where no further finishing is required for these parts ('kit of finished products')", fall under TARIC code 7610 9090 92.

Boots, size 19, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, without a wooden main sole, - with a leather upper, - a plastic reinforcement piece (textile fabric with a plastic outer layer visible to the naked eye) is attached to the upper, - with two Velcro fasteners over the instep, - with company logos on the sides and on the upper Velcro strap, - with a pull tab at the heel, - without metal protection in the toe cap, - covering the ankle but not the calf, - with an insole length of approximately 13 cm. Boots, size 19, photo see attachment, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, without a wooden main sole, - with an upper made of leather (forming the largest part of the outer surface) and textiles, - the upper is reinforced with plastic (textile with a plastic outer layer visible to the naked eye) and leather, - with two Velcro fasteners over the instep, - with company logos on the sides and on the upper Velcro strap, - with a pull tab at the heel, - without metal protection in the toe cap, - covering the ankle but not the calf, - with an insole length of approximately 13 cm. Boots, size 19, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, without a wooden insole, - with a leather upper, - with two Velcro fasteners across the instep, - with an embossed company logo on the upper Velcro flap, - with a pull tab at the heel, - without metal protection in the toe cap, - covering the ankle but not the calf, - with an insole length of approximately 12 cm. These are gold- or silver-colored oval flower vases with a similarly oval cutout in the center made of base metal (cast aluminum according to the applicant). The vase is used for holding flowers and for decorating living spaces and the like. See attached image. Such products, classified as "decorative articles of base metal, neither silver-plated, gold-plated, nor platinum-plated," fall under TARIC code 8306 2900 00.

These are rectangular steel frames, available in two different sizes, without a base or lid. Dimensions (L x W x H): 100 cm x 100 cm x 70 cm and 200 cm x 100 cm x 70 cm. - Applicant's details - See attached image. Such products are classified as "steel goods other than those specified in the preceding TARIC codes" under TARIC code 7326 9098 90.

Low shoes, size 37, photo see attachment, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with uppers made of textile materials, - the uppers have large areas of plastic reinforcement (textile with a plastic outer layer visible to the naked eye), additionally reinforced with plastic, - with lace closure, partly with eyelets made of base metal, - with a pull tab at the tongue and heel. "Shoes with plastic outsoles and textile uppers, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6404 1100 to 6404 1910"

Sandals, size 31, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with a toeless upper made of plastic (textile fabric with an outer layer of plastic visible to the naked eye; forming the majority of the outer surface) and textile fabrics, - extensively decorated on the forefoot with rhinestones and with a sewn-on, stylized flower. - with a heel strap with a buckle closure on the side, - not covering the ankle, - with a maximum heel and sole height of approximately 1.8 cm. "Footwear, other than that specified in heading 6401, with outsoles and uppers made of plastic, other than those specified in subheadings (CN) 6402 1210 to 6402 9910, the vamp being open, other than that specified in subheading (CN) 6402 9931"

These are rectangular grids made of galvanized steel wire (cross-sectional dimension: approximately 0.5 mm), whose wire strands are welded together at the intersections to form square meshes. The products are supplied in rolls and are versatile in their application, for example, in the garden as protection against voles or moles. Length: 210 cm; width: 110 cm; mesh size: approximately 6 x 6 mm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "other grids and netting of steel wire, welded at the intersections, galvanized" under TARIC code 7314 3100 00.

Training shoes, size 43, photo attached, - with outsoles made of rubber according to the application, - with uppers made of textiles, - the uppers have large reinforcement areas made of textiles, additionally reinforced with plastic, - with lace closure, - with a company logo on the side and heel, - with a pull tab at the heel, - their shape, cut, appearance, and material clearly indicate that they are designed for a specific sport (handball). "Shoes (training shoes) with rubber outsoles and uppers made of textiles"

This is a carabiner made of aluminum (not cast). The carabiner is approximately oblong with a larger and a smaller end bend and has a double screw closure. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Classification under heading 8308 is not possible because such products are not covered by the wording of that heading. These products belong to subheading 7616 9990 of the Combined Nomenclature as "other articles of aluminum, other than those specified in subheadings 7616 1000 to 7616 9910".

This is a nearly oval, steel carabiner with a screw lock. - Applicant's information - Such goods, as "goods of steel other than those specified in the aforementioned subheadings," fall under subheading 7326 90 98 of the Combined Nomenclature. They do not fall under heading 8308, as carabiners for all purposes are not included in that heading.

Lab coat bottle holder (see attached image) – consisting of a spring-loaded retractable mechanism in a round plastic housing (ABS plastic) with a metal frame (zinc alloy with nickel plating), a fastening clip, a retractable nylon cord with a transparent PVC film and snap fasteners, and a metal fastening clip – for flexible handling and keeping the bottle attached to the cord readily available (not the subject of this information). "Mechanical device with its own function, not elsewhere specified or included in Chapter 84, not a product of TARIC codes 8479 1000 00 to 8479 8997 60 – Lab coat bottle holder"

This is a carabiner made of aluminum (not cast). The carabiner is approximately oblong with a larger and a smaller end bend and has a double screw closure. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Classification under heading 8308 is not possible because such products are not covered by the wording of that heading. These products belong to subheading 7616 9990 of the Combined Nomenclature as "other articles of aluminum, other than those specified in subheadings 7616 1000 to 7616 9910".

These are steel carabiners that widen towards one end and have a movable "arm" on one long side that opens inwards and closes the hook in its resting position. The goods are equipped with a so-called "twist lock" closure. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products, as "goods of steel other than those specified in the aforementioned subheadings," belong to subheading 7326 9098 of the Combined Nomenclature. They do not belong to heading 8308, as carabiners for all purposes, as described in the Explanatory Notes to heading 7326, paragraphs 02.0 and 03.1, are classified under heading 7326.

These are products made entirely of base metal in the form of a hook, with one end formed into an eyelet. The hook widens towards one end and has an inward-opening locking bar on one long side. The goods are intended for use with safety ropes. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "hooks and eyes of base metal, for other made-up articles" under subheading 8308 1000 of the Combined Nomenclature.

USB/Bluetooth conference speaker (see attached image), - consisting of a speaker, four microphones, Bluetooth module, audio signal electronics, audio frequency amplifier, and battery in a round housing (dimensions: diameter 132.5 mm x height 35 mm) with control buttons, LED status indicators, and USB port, - for converting electrical audio frequency impulses into sound vibrations - characteristic main activity - and for wired or wireless reception of audio data, including hands-free operation without dialing capability, - together with accessories (Bluetooth adapter, travel case, safety information, and warranty) in a common sales package. The conference speaker determines the character of the whole. "Single speaker in a housing (combination of single speaker - characteristic main activity - and apparatus for communication in a wired or wireless network, in a product set with non-characteristic accessories, in packaging for individual sale)"

These are rectangular roasting or baking racks (length x width: 345 mm x 474 mm) made of steel wire (stainless steel), consisting of an outer frame with two longitudinal bars and numerous transverse bars arranged parallel to and at regular intervals. - Applicant's information - The products are suitable as inserts for various ovens. See attached image. Such products are classified as "other household articles of stainless steel" under TARIC code 7323 9300 90.

These are carabiners made of aluminium, featuring a movable "arm" on one long side that opens inwards and closes the hook in its resting position. The short sides of the goods are asymmetrically rounded. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products belong to subheading 7616 9990 of the Combined Nomenclature as "other articles of aluminium, other than those specified in subheadings 7616 1000 to 7616 9910". They do not fall under heading 8308, as carabiners (of aluminium) for all uses, as defined in the Explanatory Notes to heading 7616, paragraph 07.0, in conjunction with the Explanatory Notes to heading 7326, paragraphs 02.0 and 03.1, belong to heading 7616.

According to the application and the submitted product sample, the product described as a "liquid-absorbing pad" is a multi-layered sheet product measuring approximately 29 x 54.5 cm with the following layer structure: 1. Outer layer (blue underside) made of polyethylene plastic film, 2. Absorbent layer (middle layer) made of a mixture of cellulose fibers and super absorbent polymer (SAP), a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39 (predominant by weight), with an outer layer of paper nonwoven fabric, 3. Outer layer (face side) made of nonwoven fabric. The layers are bonded together by pressing and embossing (so-called calendering) in such a way that the product has a dot-like perforation pattern (so-called pixel structure). When placed in packaging (not the subject of this inquiry) for fresh food products, the product serves to absorb and bind liquids leaking from food. The nature of the goods, which are composed of various materials, is determined in particular with regard to their quantity, value, and significance for use by the plastics industry (SAP). For customs tariff purposes, they are classified as "other goods made of plastics, other than those covered by subheadings (CN) 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".

These are products made entirely of base metal with an approximately rectangular outline, featuring two elongated, approximately rectangular perforations in the center. The corners of the goods are rounded. The products are attached to so-called safety harnesses (not the subject of this binding tariff information) and serve as sliders. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products, classified as "articles of base metal similar to eyelets and buckles, made up for other goods," fall under subheading 8308 9000 of the Combined Nomenclature. They do not fall under subheading 8308 1000, as the goods are not covered by the wording of that subheading.

These are products made entirely of base metal with an approximately rectangular outline, featuring two elongated, approximately rectangular perforations of different sizes in the center. The corners of the goods are rounded. The products are attached to so-called safety harnesses (not the subject of this binding tariff information) and serve as sliders. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products, classified as "articles of base metal similar to eyelets and buckles, made up for other goods," fall under subheading 8308 9000 of the Combined Nomenclature. These are products made entirely of base metal with an approximately rectangular outline, featuring two elongated, approximately rectangular perforations in the center. The products are attached to so-called harness straps (not the subject of this binding tariff information) and serve as friction buckles. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products, classified as "Buckles of base metal, for other made-up articles," fall under subheading 8308 9000 of the Combined Nomenclature. They do not fall under subheading 8308 1000, as the goods are not covered by the wording of that subheading.

These are slightly angled products, made entirely of base metal, with an approximately D-shaped outline and a continuous bar at one end. The products are attached to so-called fall arrest harnesses (not the subject of this binding tariff information). - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products, classified as "articles of base metal similar to eyelets and buckles, made up for other purposes," fall under subheading 8308 9000 of the Combined Nomenclature. They do not fall under subheading 8308 1000, as the goods are not covered by the wording of that subheading.

These are elongated products (eyelets) made entirely of base metal, with parallel long sides and semicircular broad sides. The products are used for harnesses (not the subject of this binding tariff information). - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "eyelets of base metal, for other made-up articles" under subheading 8308 1000 of the Combined Nomenclature.

These are products made entirely of steel, consisting of a rectangular frame enclosing a grid and a folding support attached to the frame, allowing the goods to be stood upright. The products are intended for use as so-called sifting sieves, for example, for soil, compost, or sand. Dimensions: approximately 100 cm x 60 cm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "steel goods other than those specified in the preceding codes" under tariff heading 7326 9098 90 0. They are not classified under subheading CN 7326 2000 because they are not made of steel wire.

The product illustrated by a sample is a combination of a toy set and other goods. The toy set consists of: a plastic figure approximately 6.3 cm tall (representing a girl), which is placed on a round plastic base; an unassembled, foldable, double-sided printed backdrop (rooms, e.g., bedroom, living room) made of cardboard, which is inserted into a plastic frame with a base; the aforementioned figure can then be placed in the rooms; one room (bedroom) is additionally equipped with a hinged "window"; it is intended for children's play; and other goods in the form of two sheets of paper with stickers and a two-dimensional, single-sided printed cardboard item (stylized dog), which can also be inserted into the aforementioned base. The combination essentially has the character of a toy and is packaged together with instructions in a cardboard box for individual sale. Such products are classified under customs tariff law as "toys presented in a set".

Boots, size 37, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with uppers made of plastic (textile fabric with an outer layer of plastic visible to the naked eye; therefore not goods of heading 6404), - a reinforcing piece made of plastic is attached to the upper, - with a lacing device with protruding eyelets made of plastic almost all the way around and with an elastic cord with cord stopper at the top edge, - with company logos at the top of the shaft and in the area of ​​the heel, - covering the ankle, - without metal protection in the toecap, - lined with plush knit fabric. "Footwear, other than those mentioned in heading 6401, with outsoles and uppers made of plastic, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6402 1210 to 6402 2000, covering the ankle, other than those mentioned in subheading (CN) 6402 9110"

Low shoes, size 37, photo attached, - made in the style of boat shoes, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application; without a wooden insole, - with an upper (open vamp; with square cutouts) made of leather, - a leather reinforcement piece is attached to the upper, - with lace closure made of leather straps with eyelets of base metal; each end of the straps is decorated with two threaded wooden beads, - decorated with a leather strap threaded through eyelets of base metal, with two threaded decorative elements of base metal on the side, - with a sewn-in label bearing the company logo on the side, - without metal protection in the toe cap, - not covering the ankle, - with a maximum heel and sole height of approximately 2.8 cm, - with an insole length of approximately 24.7 cm, - recognizable as women's shoes. Sandal, size 37, photo see attachment, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with a toeless upper made of textile materials (elastic braided bands; forming the majority of the outer surface) and plastic (textile with an outer layer of plastic visible to the naked eye), - with heel strap, - with two Velcro fasteners over the instep. "Footwear with outsoles of plastic and uppers of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6404 1100 to 6404 1910"

These are stainless steel bowls with lids, available in three different sizes, each with a circular base, a wall that widens towards the top, and a rim that curves outwards. A recessed groove is formed on the inside of the rim to serve as a support for the lid. The precisely fitting lids are slightly domed and feature a central circular indentation and a handle. These items are used in households, for example, for preparing, serving, or storing food. Diameters: approximately 18, 22, and 26 cm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "other household articles of stainless steel" under subheading 7323 9300 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Ballerina flats, size UK 4.5, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with a low-cut upper made of textile materials (forming the largest part of the outer surface) and leather, - leather reinforcements are attached to the upper, - with an elastic Velcro closure across the instep. "Shoes with outsoles of plastic and uppers made of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6404 1100 to 6404 1910"

The products in question are unfinished wooden jigsaw puzzles in various shapes: - circular with nine pieces (approx. 10 cm diameter when assembled), - heart-shaped with 13 pieces (approx. 9.5 cm maximum diameter when assembled), - rectangular with 16 pieces (approx. 10 cm edge length when assembled). The pieces are unpainted, approximately 2 mm thick, and toothed to allow them to be assembled into the correct image. There is no indication that they are handmade. The puzzles are packaged in pairs of the same shape in a polybag with a printed cardboard product hanger. At the time of import, the puzzle pieces are connected by several thin break points. The product is therefore unfinished, requiring the individual puzzle pieces to be broken off for completion. Since the essential characteristics of a jigsaw puzzle are present, the product in question must be classified as a finished product. Such products are classified under customs tariff law as "puzzles, made of wood, not handmade".

These are specifically shaped products manufactured according to technical drawings from a nickel-chromium alloy with nickel being the predominant component by weight (Inconel 625 – according to the applicant). The disc-shaped products have several through holes and a groove on the outer surface. Produced by turning, these products are used to manufacture glass-to-metal inlets for the insulated passage of electrical conductors through a hermetically sealed housing. Such products are classified as "other nickel goods (than those specified in code 7508 1000 00 0)" under tariff heading 7508 9000 00 0.

Slippers, size 37, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with uppers made of textile materials (with cutouts on the sides), - the uppers are reinforced over a large area with plastic (textile material with a plastic outer layer visible to the naked eye) and textile material, - with an elastic cord and cord stopper across the instep, - with a company logo in the instep area, - with a pull tab at the heel and instep. "Shoes with outsoles of plastic and uppers made of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6404 1100 to 6404 1910"

Leisure shoes, size 37, photo attached, - with outsoles made of plastic according to the application, - with uppers made of textile materials (forming the majority of the outer surface) and plastic (textile with a plastic outer layer visible to the naked eye), - reinforcing plastic parts are attached to the upper, - with an elastic cord with cord stopper over the instep, - with a heel strap with an elastic textile insert, - with cutouts on the sides, - with a company logo in the forefoot area, - with a pull tab at the heel. "Shoes with outsoles of plastic and uppers of textile materials, other than those mentioned in subheadings (CN) 6404 1100 to 6404 1910"

Cleaning pad, photo attached, - according to the application: -- mounted on a cardboard card and packaged in a polybag, -- approximately rectangular, measuring approximately 9 cm x 5.4 cm; with rounded corners -- made of a printed knitted fabric of textile materials, coated on the underside with silicone [plastic (not cellular plastic)] in a manner perceptible to the naked eye, -- the knitted fabric is intended for use in cleaning displays, the plastic serves as an adhesive surface, - goods sold by the meter of heading 5903, - cut other than square or rectangular, thus finished. - does not constitute a cleaning cloth, particularly due to the adhesive surface. "Other finished goods (cleaning pad), of textile materials, of knitted fabrics"

This is an unassembled product consisting of five specifically shaped steel sheet sections, intended to be assembled into an optional top (accessory) for a particular gas stove (not the subject of this binding tariff information), thus serving as a support for a griddle (not the subject of this binding tariff information). The product is packaged with instructions and two sachets of moisture-absorbing silica gel (minor items) in a custom-fit carrying case for continuous use, all within a printed retail carton. Also included are two specifically shaped steel sheet sections (minor items of negligible value), intended as a spare pair for the aforementioned gas stove, which are wrapped in paper. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such goods fall under subheading 7326 90 98 of the Combined Nomenclature as "steel goods other than those specified in the aforementioned subheadings".

OLED module (see attached image) – consisting of a 7.18" OLED panel (resolution: 1080 x 520 pixels) with a touch-sensitive surface (touchscreen), microcontroller, deserializer, driver chip, and other components in a housing for installation in a motor vehicle with an LVDS interface and a power supply connection – intended for use as a flat panel display module after installation in motor vehicles. "Flat panel display module, also containing touch-sensitive screens, with driver or control circuits, not made of liquid crystals, made of organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs)"

"Mango cutter" is a product composed of various components, consisting of: - a hand tool in the form of a plastic frame with a circular interior and two side handles, designed for free-arm use, and a specifically shaped, oval cutting insert made of base metal (working part) incorporated inside the frame; - and an oval plastic holder with a small wall on each side and a point in the middle for securing a mango; - dimensions: approximately 18.7 x 13.5 x 5.0 cm; - used for cutting and pitting a mango; - presented on a printed cardboard backing; - the hand tool, in particular with regard to its importance for use, determines the character of the composite product. See illustration in the annex. Such products are classified as "Hand tools (household tools), not elsewhere specified or included, with a working part of base metal" under subheading 8205 5100 of the Combined Nomenclature (CN).

These are specifically shaped hollow products made of a nickel-chromium alloy with a predominant nickel content by weight (Inconel 625 – according to the applicant). The approximately cylindrical products, manufactured by turning, have a stepped flange on the outside. They are used to produce glass-to-metal inlets for the insulated passage of electrical conductors through a hermetically sealed housing. Such products are classified as "other nickel products (than those specified in code 7508 1000 00 0)" under tariff heading 7508 9000 00 0.

"Shaped parts" made of a gold alloy: The goods are flat shaped parts made of a gold-tin alloy (80% gold, 20% tin) in various sizes and shapes, specifically: round rings and discs, rectangular rings with rounded and angular corners, and square plates. The goods are used in soldering processes in the electronics sector. - Applicant's information - Such products are classified as "gold as semi-finished products (other than those specified in code numbers 7108 1100 00 0 to 7308 1380 00 1)" under tariff code 7308 1380 00 9.

Cat scratching post, photo see attachment, - according to the application: -- composite goods, each packaged in a cardboard box with a printed cardboard insert; arriving unassembled, with assembly material, -- consisting of a scratching post and a pet bed, -- scratching post: --- with a height of 116 cm, --- with a rectangular (approx. 55 cm x 40 cm) base plate, an L-shaped (max. approx. 48 cm x 30 cm) and a round lying platform (diameter: approx. 33 cm) with a raised, approx. 9 cm high edge; all made of wood fiberboard and (except for the underside) covered with solid-color plush fabric, --- with two square lying trays (Length: approx. 30 cm), a "tunnel" [Length: approx. 25 cm, Diameter (inside): approx. 20.5 cm] and a round lying platform (Diameter: approx. 30 cm), all made of the above-mentioned material. Wood and completely covered with the aforementioned plush fabrics or with various fabrics, --- the round lying surfaces are additionally padded with wadding, --- on the undersides of the smaller, round lying platform and one of the lying hollows, each with a "mouse" attached to an elastic cord, consisting essentially of plush fabric and featuring a plastic body filled with pebbles, --- with five cardboard columns (U: approx. 25 cm, H: 1 x 55 cm, 3 x 45 cm, 1 x 24 cm), which are wrapped on their outer surfaces with sisal ropes (spun yarns with a titer of apparently more than 20,000 dtex), --- with two cardboard columns (U: approx. 22 cm, H: 1 x 15 cm and 1 x 20 cm), which are wrapped on their outer surfaces with the aforementioned fabrics. are covered in plush knit fabric, - assembled by joining components, - particularly with regard to use, the ropes and the knitted fabrics, in contrast to the wood and cardboard, determine the character of the goods; in terms of size, the knitted fabrics predominate over the ropes and thus give the cat tree its essential character, - according to the application: -- Pet bed: --- in the form of a round "basket" (D: approx. 37 cm), --- with an elastically narrowed fastening strip, approx. 6 cm wide; made of the aforementioned plush knit fabrics; --- padded with wadding in the areas of the approx. 10 cm high rim and the lying surface, -- serves as a resting place for and activity of cats, - in terms of size, the cat tree gives the assembled goods their essential character, "Other made-up goods (cat tree), of textiles, of knitted fabrics"

Cat scratching post, photo attached, - according to the application (all dimensions are approximate): -- assembled goods consisting of a scratching post, a pet bed and four cushions; packed in a cardboard box; arriving unassembled, with assembly materials, -- scratching post: --- with a total height of 134 cm, --- with an oval base plate (57 cm x 46 cm) made of wood; covered except for the underside with solid-color plush fabric, --- with two lying platforms (kidney-shaped: 45 cm x max. 25 cm; round, D: 40 cm) made of wood; completely covered with the aforementioned plush fabric; on the underside of each platform with a "ball" made of the aforementioned plush fabric and filled with pebbles, attached to a cord, --- with a cylindrical scratching barrel (D: 38 cm, H: 100 cm) made of wood with three caves (with two entrances and one passage) and a "roof terrace"; On the outside with a scratching surface made of sisal fabric, on the inside of the "roof terrace", on the lying surfaces and at the edges with the aforementioned plush knits, and on the inner walls with knits made of textiles, --- with two "columns" (H: 60 cm, U: 34.5 cm) made of cardboard; According to the applicant and the submitted samples, the product in question is a so-called "creepy girl" in two different versions. The approximately 90 cm tall products each depict a child's skeleton (without a lower body or legs; therefore not a doll of heading 9503) with a skull and hands made of plastic and arms made of foam-covered wire, dressed in a black cloak made of textiles. When the sensor is activated, the creepy figure emits light and sound effects, which are intended to frighten or surprise the viewer. For customs tariff purposes, this is classified as "Other entertainment articles, including magic and novelty articles."

The items illustrated by the photographs are so-called plastic blind rivets as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The article illustrated by the data sheets is a silicone sealing sleeve, a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. According to the applicant's statements and the submitted sample, the product is a decorative item in the shape of a stylized Christmas tree. The approximately 1-meter-high product consists of white, honeycomb-patterned paper pieces glued together, which, when unfolded, form the three-dimensional shape and are secured with small Velcro dots. To enhance the decorative effect, an LED string of lights with an electrical cord, timer function, and mains plug is hung inside the Christmas tree and attached with Velcro dots. Classification as a lighting fixture within the meaning of heading 9405 is not possible, as the string of lights merely enhances the decorative effect of the honeycomb structure. The character of the composite product is determined by its size and decorative effect, as well as by the honeycomb structure. Such products, manufactured in the style of classic "honeycomb garlands/honeycomb products," serve as decorative items for celebrations, decorating rooms and/or tables. Due to its neutral design, it is not a Christmas article of subheading (HS) 9505 10. The goods are packaged in a cardboard box. According to customs tariff regulations, they are classified as "festival items, other than Christmas items".

According to the application details and the submitted sample, the product in question is a so-called screen protector in the form of a transparent plastic film as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39 (PET). The film is applied to the display of a tablet PC (not the subject of this ruling) and is intended to protect against breakage, scratches, and reflections. For customs tariff purposes, such goods are classified as "other plastic goods; not covered by subheadings (CN) 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".
