The product is deep-frozen and is to be prepared by boiling in a pot. No sample was submitted. The product was illustrated by photographs. Findings: Meat, offal, blood or insects, otherwise prepared or preserved: of poultry of heading 0105: of chickens: other: other

These are mesh panels of varying heights made from hot-dip galvanized steel wire (maximum cross-sectional dimension: approximately 8 mm), welded together at the intersections. The mesh size is 50 mm x 200 mm (100 cm²). These so-called double-wire mesh panels serve as fence elements for constructing enclosures. - Applicant's information - See attached illustration. Such products, classified as "other mesh panels of steel wire, welded at the intersections, with a mesh size of 100 cm² or more, of wire with a maximum cross-sectional dimension of 3 mm or more," fall under TARIC code 7314 20 90 00.

Signal converter (see attached image) – consisting of a printed circuit board containing an analog-to-digital converter, microcontroller, and other electronic components, housed in a mounting enclosure with 4 or 12 USB ports for USB plugs connected to temperature sensors (not the subject of this information), – after installation in a wired thermal validation system for converting measurement signals into digital data. "Electrical device with an independent function, not elsewhere specified or included in Chapter 85, not covered by subheadings (CN) 8543 1000 to 8543 7060."

According to the application details and the submitted sample, the product is a plastic closure lid as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The transparent product, with a diameter of approximately 8.2 cm, has a black, sliding drinking spout (also made of plastic) that allows the drinking opening to be opened and closed, as well as a silicone seal. The lid serves as a closure for a thermal mug (not the subject of this ruling). Such goods are classified under customs tariff headings as "Lids, of plastics; other than bottle caps and bottle caps".

Tracking device in card format (see attached image) – consisting of a printed circuit board equipped with a Bluetooth and NFC radio module and other electronic components, housed in a credit card-sized plastic casing (dimensions: 82 × 50 × 2.5 mm) with accumulator, LED status indicator, on/off switch, and speaker – for receiving, converting, and transmitting sounds or other data using the Bluetooth standard and via NFC – the defining characteristic – as well as for generating signal tones – together with accessories (carrying strap and operating instructions) in a common retail package. The tracking device determines the nature of the goods as a set. "Apparatus for communication in a wired or wireless network, not a base station, device for receiving, converting, and transmitting sounds, images, or other data (combination of communication apparatus – defining characteristic – and electrical audible signaling device), in a set of goods presented for retail sale with non-defining accessories."

These are three key rings, each consisting of an iron wire key ring with a carabiner hook attached via a swivel joint. Each carabiner is made of a zinc alloy with zinc being the predominant metal by weight. A plastic charm in the shape of a stylized, reflective figure (rabbit, dinosaur, or rocket) is attached via an iron eyelet. The products are each mounted on a cardboard card. - Applicant's information - The base metals determine the character of the key rings, which are composed of various materials, in terms of their importance for the intended use. Among the base metals, zinc predominates over iron by weight. See attached illustration. Such products are classified as "other goods made of zinc (than those covered by code 7907 0000 10 0)" under tariff code 7907 0000 90 0.

Food preparation; food supplement containing magnesium citrate, in tablet form, in bulk. The submitted data sheets contain information on the distributor, composition, and intended use (food supplement). According to the application, it does not contain starch (including starch degradation products), sucrose (including invert sugar), isoglucose, or milk fat. It is not a food preparation elsewhere specified or included, not a subheading of 2106 1020 to 2106 9059 of the Combined Nomenclature (CN), and does not contain starch or glucose, sucrose or isoglucose, or milk fat. It is not a product of heading 3004 of the CN, as the preparation does not contain a substantially increased amount of magnesium.

These are solid, cylindrical steel products with a smooth shank and blunt end, a flat round head, and a step below the head. The shank end has four metric internal threads (M16), while the head has two opposing, continuous metric internal threads (M12) and six additional unthreaded holes. These products are used for the movable connection of the front and rear frames of a wheel loader (not the subject of this binding tariff information). Overall length: approximately 216.5 mm; shank diameter: approximately 75 mm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "other steel goods similar to screws and nuts, with threads" under tariff heading 7318 1900 90 0. They are not covered by UPos. (HS) 7318 29, as they have threads.

Applicant's details: Designation: WH Sticker Snowflakes 21x14cm PET various assortments (here: design with snowmen, snowflakes, and fir trees) Material: PET Assortment: Single (available in 2 designs) Findings on a sample: Two different polybags in retail packaging (printing present) were submitted. Only the sheet with the stylized snowmen with stars, snowflakes, and fir trees with stars (only five copies present) is considered here. The self-adhesive, flat products are made of plastic and are affixed to a protective film sheet. Conclusion: These are other self-adhesive flat products made of plastic.

These are products made entirely of galvanized steel, consisting of a sheet metal section angled at 90° with two legs of different lengths and rounded ends. The longer leg has two diagonally arranged holes. The shorter leg has a central hole through which a screw with a pointed thread end is passed. These products, designed with specific features for their intended use, are used to attach woven fence panels to fence posts. Dimensions: approximately 35 mm x 30 mm x 40 mm. - Applicant's details - See attached image. Such products are classified as "other structural steel components" under TA-RIC code 7308 9098 90.

Multi-speaker (see attached image) – consisting of two speakers, an audio frequency amplifier, a wireless transmitter and receiver module, and speech filter and surround sound function, all housed in a single unit with a carrying handle (dimensions: 240 x 104 x 60 mm) and rotary controls, operating buttons, status indicators, a rechargeable battery, a headphone jack, and a USB-C charging port. Its primary function is to convert electrical audio frequency impulses into sound waves, to process sound by filtering out and reducing background noise (noise suppression), and to wirelessly receive audio signals in the frequency range of 2.402 GHz to 2.480 GHz. The unit is packaged in a single retail container with accessories (base station (charging cradle with wireless module), optical audio cable, 3.5 mm audio cable, HDMI cable, USB charging cable, power adapter, and user manual). The Bluetooth speaker is the defining feature of the entire system. "Combination of multiple loudspeakers - characteristic main activity -, sound processing device and apparatus for communication in a wireless network, in a product set in packaging for individual sale with non-character-defining accessories"

Multi-speaker (see attached image) – consisting of two speakers, audio frequency amplifier, speech filter function, wireless transmitter and receiver module in a single housing with carrying handle (dimensions: 208 x 104 x 60 mm) and rotary control, operating elements, status indicators, rechargeable battery, headphone jack and USB-C charging port, – for converting electrical audio frequency impulses into sound waves – its defining characteristic – for sound processing by filtering out and reducing background noise (noise suppression) and for wirelessly receiving audio signals in the frequency range of 2.402 GHz – 2.480 GHz, – in a single retail package with accessories (base station (charging cradle with wireless module), optical audio cable, 3.5 mm audio cable, HDMI cable, USB charging cable, power adapter, user manual). The Bluetooth speaker defines the overall character of the system. "Combination of multiple loudspeakers - characteristic main function -, sound processing device and apparatus for communication in a wireless network, in a product set in packaging for individual sale with non-character-defining accessories"

Water diffuser (see attached image) – consisting of a populated printed circuit board, a battery, and a piezoelectric element in an approximately cylindrical housing (dimensions: approx. 3.6 x 3.6 x 10 cm) with a screw-on water tank, on/off switch, and USB charging port – for evaporating water using vibrations to humidify the ambient air – together with an accessory (charging cable) in a single retail package. The water diffuser determines the character of the whole. "Mechanical device with its own function, not elsewhere specified or included in Chapter 84, not a product of code numbers 8479 1000 00 0 to 8479 8997 60 0, in a set of goods put up for retail sale with an accessory that does not determine the character of the product."

Compound seasoning; smoked salt for fish. Colorless foil pouch with a colorfully printed label. The label includes information on the distributor, intended use (seasoning mix for fish before smoking), quantity (700 g), dilution (70 g to 1 l of water), ingredients, and nutritional values. Contents: Heterogeneous mixture of salt and herbs. Compound seasoning, not classified under subheadings 2103 1000 to 2103 9030 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Air conditioner (see attached image) – consisting of a motorized fan, refrigerant circuit, water tank, louvers, an air inlet and outlet with two filters and controls, a Wi-Fi module, and a power plug, housed in a cuboid casing with casters and connected to a remote control, – weighing 22 kg and with a cooling capacity of 2600 watts, – factory pre-filled with R290 (propane) refrigerant, – for air conditioning indoor spaces by changing the air temperature (cooling) and humidity, – supplied in a single retail package with an exhaust hose and window vent kit (included). The air conditioner determines the overall character of the product. "Air conditioner, consisting of a motor-driven fan and devices for changing the temperature and humidity of the air, not goods of code numbers 8415 1010 10 0 to 8415 8200 91 0, in a set of goods in packaging for retail sale with non-essential accessories, in a functional unit with remote control - air conditioner"

Air conditioner (see attached image) - consisting of a nearly cuboid housing with mounted casters, refrigeration unit, compressor, fan, timer, control panel, LED display, air outlet and air inlet with air filter, adjustable louvers, condensate drain and power plug, connected to a remote control, - with an air circulation rate of 380 m³/h and a cooling capacity of 2.05 kW, - factory pre-filled with refrigerant R290 (propane), - weighing 18.9 kg, - for household use for dehumidifying and cooling room air using the principle of cold evaporation and for mechanically filtering and purifying the room air, - in a single retail package with a 1.5 m exhaust hose and a window exhaust kit (included). The air conditioner determines the overall character of the unit. "Electromechanical household appliance with built-in electric motor, not a vacuum cleaner of heading 8508, weighing less than 20 kg, not a product of code number 8509 4000 00 0, in a functional unit with remote control, in a set of goods put up for retail sale with non-essential accessories"

Radio receiver with internet radio (see attached image) – comprising a radio receiver for DAB+/FM reception, CD player with laser pickup system, audio decoder, audio frequency amplifier, Ethernet and USB controller, WLAN and Bluetooth module, speaker, clock with alarm function and power supply, all integrated into a housing with display, controls, Ethernet and USB ports, antenna connections, audio and power connections, with included DAB/FM and WLAN antennas – for radio reception in the DAB+/FM range, for playing back audio from compact discs, USB storage media and audio files of various formats from the internet or a local network (audio streaming), and for displaying the time with alarm function – its primary function – for wirelessly receiving audio data via Bluetooth, and for powering external devices (USB charging function) – together with accessories (remote control, batteries, cables, product documentation) in a single retail package. The radio receiver is the defining characteristic of the entire product. "Radio receiver, not of a type covered by subheadings (CN) 8527 12 00 to 8527 29 00, combined with a sound reproduction apparatus and a clock (radio receiver with sound reproduction apparatus and clock, not yet assembled with antennas - characteristic main activity - in combination with apparatus for communication in a wireless network, assembled with a non-characteristic power supply, in a set of goods put up for retail sale with non-characteristic accessories)"

Bus adapter (see attached image) – consisting of a printed circuit board populated with a transceiver and other components in a housing (dimensions: 117 x 74 x 50 mm) with status LEDs, one PROFINET and one backplane interface, and a power supply connection – for receiving, converting, and transmitting signals within a wired fieldbus system (PROFINET). "Device for communication in a wired network, not a base station, device for receiving, converting, and transmitting sounds, images, or other data."

Nonlinear temperature-dependent resistor/thermistor (see attached image), in a specifically shaped package with electrical connection cable, for a power rating of less than 20 W. "Electrical resistor, other than carbon mass or carbon film resistor, for a power rating of 20 W or less - thermistor"

Nonlinear temperature-dependent resistor/thermistor (see attached image), in a specifically shaped package with electrical connection cable, for a power rating of less than 20 W. "Electrical resistor, other than carbon mass or carbon film resistor, for a power rating of 20 W or less - thermistor"

Nonlinear temperature-dependent resistor/thermistor (see attached image), in a specifically shaped package with electrical connection, for a power rating of less than 20 W. "Electrical resistor, not a heating resistor, fixed resistor other than carbon mass or carbon film resistor, for a power rating of 20 W or less - thermistor"

Product assortment, so-called Cush Core, photo see attachment - consisting of a puncture protection insert, a valve with knurled screw and two sticker sheets, so-called puncture protection tire insert, - packaged for individual sale (cardboard box), - assembled to satisfy a specific need, - puncture protection insert/tire insert: - - tire-shaped product, - - made of polyolefin foam (plastic) according to the supplementary application information, - - with a width of approx. 7 cm, - - is mounted on a bicycle between the wheel and tire, - - protects the tires from punctures, - - according to the supplementary application information for wheel sizes of 27.5", 28" and 29", - - recognizably intended mainly for bicycles of Chapter 87 based on its objective characteristics (including shape, dimensions) and properties, - valve with knurled screw (total length approx. 6 cm), - two sticker sheets (goods of low value), - the tire insert is intended, in particular with regard to its use the essential character of the goods as a set. "Accessories (puncture protection insert) for bicycles of headings 8711 and 8712"

Nonlinear temperature-dependent resistor/thermistor (see attached image), in a specifically shaped package with electrical connection, for a power rating of less than 20 W. "Electrical resistor, not a heating resistor, fixed resistor other than carbon mass or carbon film resistor, for a power rating of 20 W or less - thermistor"

Non-linear temperature-dependent resistor/thermistor (see attached image), in a specifically shaped package with electrical connection, for a power rating of less than 20 W. "Electrical resistor, not a heating resistor, other than a carbon mass or carbon film resistor, for a power rating of 20 W or less - thermistor"

Potentiometer (see attached image), with electrical wiper contact and carbon resistive track in a specifically shaped housing with an electrical connection via three wires, for a power rating of less than 20 watts. "Electrical resistor, not a heating resistor, not a fixed resistor, not a wire-wound variable resistor, other variable resistor for a power rating of 20 W or less - potentiometer"

Heating unit (see attached image) – essentially consisting of a specifically shaped housing with a heating unit, level sensor, pressure sensor, and power supply module – for tempering (heating) urea solution in a vehicle exhaust system – for installation in the exhaust aftertreatment system of vehicles. "Device for treating substances by processes based on a change in temperature, not a product of subheadings (CN) 8419 1100 - 8419 8930 – Heating unit"

Assembled guideway wiper for machine tools (see illustration in the annex) - a specifically manufactured, geometrically asymmetrical product consisting of a profiled wiper lip made of FPM (fluoroelastomer) and a firmly bonded carrier profile (solid, material-bonded connection) made of steel, - designed exclusively for installation (assembly) in metal-cutting machine tools of headings 8456 to 8461, - serves to remove dust, chips and cooling lubricants from the moving machine guides and as a protective device for the machine tools. "Part identifiable as being intended solely or principally for use with machines of headings 8456 to 8461, not a product of TARIC codes 8466 9340 00 to 8466 9350 00 - Assembled guideway wiper for machine tools"

Nonlinear temperature-dependent resistor/thermistor (see attached image), in a specifically shaped package with electrical connection, for a power rating of less than 20 W. "Electrical resistor, other than carbon mass or carbon film resistor, for a power rating of 20 W or less - thermistor"

Preparation based on odorants; strawberry flavoring. The product in question is a colorless liquid with an intense strawberry odor. The sample is in a 100 ml plastic screw-top bottle with a printed label. The flavoring, which is reportedly natural, is used in small doses for the production of fruit gums. Confidential information, including details of the composition, is available. The product is to be classified as another preparation based on odorants, of a kind used in the food industry, under subheading 3302 1090 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Filter cover (see attached image) – made from a perforated steel sheet element with attached handle, manufactured specifically according to factory drawings, with dimensions: 298 x 293 x 5 mm, – for use as a surface filter in hood-type and undercounter dishwashers. "Part clearly intended exclusively for dishwashers – filter cover"

Filter box (see attached illustration), - consisting of an approximately cuboid, two-part housing with a round opening on the top, containing a permanently bonded, zigzag-folded filter element in the form of a coated PTFE membrane, with dimensions (L x W x H) of approximately 136 x 107 x 18 mm, - for installation in a hygiene and disinfection machine, for filtering and purifying air. "Apparatus for filtering and purifying gases (air), not goods of subheadings 8421 3100 to 8421 3915"

These are roughly triangular bowls made of cast aluminum, featuring a curved rim and grooved interior. The underside has a non-slip felt lining. They are designed for holding and serving food (e.g., fruit or bread) and are packaged in a cardboard box. Dimensions (W x L x H): approximately 24 cm x 30 cm x 10 cm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. The nature of these products, which consist of various materials, is determined by the aluminum content due to its size and importance for their use. Such products fall under TARIC code 7615 1010 90 as "other household articles of cast aluminum." They do not fall under heading 8306, as the practical value of the products outweighs their decorative value.

According to the applicant's information and the submitted product sample, the product is a woven item in the form of a door wreath (approximately 22 cm in diameter). The wreath consists of thin, natural twigs or twig sections (according to the application, pine wood = weaving material as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46), which are twisted together using a braiding technique and held in shape with metal wires. A jute cord is attached to the top for hanging. The front of the wreath is not entirely decorated ("essentially only in the lower area") with artificial plant parts made of plastic and textiles (representing stems/twigs with leaves), a textile bow, and colorfully designed, speckled polystyrene eggs (representing natural eggs). Additionally, a detailed, seated rabbit figure, approximately 9 cm tall (made from a plastic body whose exterior is completely covered with wood shavings), is glued to the center of the underside. The character of the wreath, which according to the application is handmade, is determined by the weaving materials, as the applied decorative elements do not completely cover the wreath. Classification under heading 9505 is not possible, since imitations of natural bird eggs are not considered decorative articles for Easter under customs tariff law. Under customs tariff law, it is classified as "other goods, made directly from vegetable weaving materials; made from materials other than rattan and bamboo, not bottle sleeves, handmade".

According to the applicant and the submitted product sample, the product is a woven item in the form of a door wreath (approximately 23 cm in diameter). The wreath consists of thin, natural twigs or twig sections (according to the application, pine wood = weaving material as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 46), which are twisted together using a braiding technique and held in shape with metal wires. A jute cord is attached to the top for hanging. The front of the wreath is not entirely decorated ("essentially only in the lower area") with artificial plant parts made of plastic and textiles (representing stems/twigs with leaves and blossoms) as well as with colored, speckled polystyrene eggs (representing natural eggs). Additionally, an untreated plywood cutout in the shape of a rabbit's head with erect ears is glued into the center of the underside of the wreath. The character of the wreath, which according to the application is handmade, is determined by the weaving materials, as the applied decorative elements do not completely cover the wreath. Classification under heading 9505 is not possible, since imitations of natural bird eggs are not considered decorative articles for Easter under customs tariff law. Under customs tariff law, it is classified as "other goods, made directly from vegetable weaving materials; made from materials other than rattan and bamboo, not bottle sleeves, handmade".

Pump housing (see attached image) – consisting of a cuboid housing with a round recess and four holes with mounting elements – for use as a pump housing for a metering pump (impeller pump) for dishwashers. "Part identifiable as being solely or principally intended for liquid pumping."

"Installation spindle with depth stop" - a rod-like product made entirely of tool steel (1.2767) with a total length of approximately 105 mm - - at one end, approximately one-third of the way through, is externally threaded in various diameters (from M2 to M6) and pitches (from 0.4 to 1) with a blunt thread end, with a screwed-on, adjustable, multi-part depth stop - - at the other end, initially cylindrical and formed into an external hexagon in the upper area - due to the external hexagon, for occasional use in electric, battery-powered or pneumatic installation tools as well as mechanical hand tools - serves to install/insert wire thread inserts with fine or standard threads into threaded bores. See attached illustration. Such products are classified as "interchangeable tools for use in mechanical or non-mechanical hand tools or machine tools, with a working part of base metal, other than those specified in subheadings 8207 1300 to 8207 9078, for metalworking" under subheading 8207 9091 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Details: A musical figure made of polyester with an electronic music module that can be played at the push of a button. It contains a chocolate bar and five chocolate pralines with a milk cream filling. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: Five individually wrapped, oblong, brown chocolate pralines with a chocolate-like odor (dimensions in cm: approx. 3.5 x 2 x 1.5), each wrapped in red composite foil (printed with "milk cream"), filled with a light beige, firm cream. The five chocolate pralines, along with a chocolate bar (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40865/26-3), are contained in a plastic bag, which is tied with a red ribbon to a musical figure (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40865/26-2) with a cardboard label (diameter approx. 6.5 cm). Labeling (excerpt): "Merry Christmas". This binding tariff information (vZTA) decision relates exclusively to the chocolate pralines from the set containing a musical figure and a chocolate bar. Finding: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: Pralines, including filled ones: other.

Doll – depicting a bearded man – approximately 31 cm tall – sewn together from various fabrics – with a plastic skeleton; the arms and head are filled with soft material; the torso consists of a plastic casing with a motor and sound module; the battery compartments are located in the feet; dressed in jeans with leg pockets, a red hoodie, and black and white shoes; with black plastic eyes, a white beard with a mustache and mouth; the doll wears a red baseball cap and black plastic sunglasses; on its right hand, it has an on/off switch; when the switch is pressed, the doll moves to Christmas hip-hop music; intended for playful entertainment. The doll holds a clear bag, attached to it with a ribbon, containing five chocolate pralines and a chocolate bar. This binding tariff information (BTI) decision relates exclusively to the musical figure (Santa Claus) from the set with chocolate pralines (see DEBTI-40865/26-1) and a chocolate bar (see DEBTI-40865/26-3). For customs tariff purposes, the goods are classified as a "doll representing a human being".

Details: A musical figure made of polyester with an electronic music module that can be played at the push of a button. It contains a chocolate bar and five chocolate pralines with a milk cream filling. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: A brown chocolate bar (dimensions approx. 12 x 3 x 1 cm) made of solid milk chocolate with break lines, sealed in colorfully printed plastic film (print (excerpt): "choco snack Fine Milk Chocolate 35 g"). The chocolate bar, together with the chocolate pralines (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40865/26-1), is in a plastic bag, which is tied with a red ribbon to a musical figure (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40865/26-2) with a cardboard label (diameter approx. 6.5 cm). Label (excerpt): "Merry Christmas". This vZTA decision relates exclusively to the chocolate bar from the assortment with a musical figure and chocolate pralines. Finding: Chocolate and other cocoa-containing food preparations: other, in the form of tablets, bars or sticks: unfilled: other

Details: A plush toy made of polyester and a cardboard bag. The cardboard bag contains, in addition to the plush toy, four chocolate pralines with a milk cream filling, two chocolate bars, and a pack of gummy candies. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: Four individually wrapped, oblong, brown chocolate pralines (dimensions in cm: approx. 3.5 x 2 x 1.5) with a chocolate-like odor, each wrapped in red composite foil (printed with "milk cream"), filled with a light beige cream. The chocolate pralines are packaged together with a plush toy (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40868/26-2), a pack of gummy candies (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40868/26-3), and two chocolate bars (not part of this binding tariff information decision, see DEBTI-40868/26-4) in a cardboard folding box printed with a Christmas motif (dimensions in cm: approx. 27 x 14 x 9) with a handle and a cutout for the plush toy's head. Labeling (excerpt): "Merry Christmas". This binding tariff information decision relates exclusively to the chocolate pralines included in the package with the plush toy, two chocolate bars, and a pack of gummy candies. Finding: Chocolate and other food preparations containing cocoa: other: Chocolate and chocolate products: Pralines, also filled: other.

Doll depicting a seated Santa Claus, approximately 20 cm tall, sewn together from various textiles and completely filled with soft material, with embroidered eyes and mouth as well as a plastic nose, with a white plush beard, a red body with a black belt with a printed gold buckle, black gloves with white trim, black shoes, and a red pointed hat with white trim and a pom-pom. Due to the material, the doll has movable limbs and is intended for playful entertainment. The doll is packaged in a cardboard bag for individual sale together with four chocolate pralines, two chocolate bars, and a pack of gummy candies. This binding tariff information (vZTA) decision relates exclusively to the plush doll from the set with chocolate pralines (DEBTI-40868/26-1), two chocolate bars (DEBTI-40868/26-4), and a pack of gummy candies (DEBTI-40868/26-3). Under customs tariff law, the goods are classified as "doll representing a human being".

Confectionery; Gummy candies. The goods in question are gummy candies sold as part of a set containing a plush toy and chocolates. The gummy candies are packaged in 50g plastic bags. This binding tariff information (BTI) decision relates exclusively to the pack of gummy candies included in the set with chocolate pralines (DEBTI-40868/26-1), a plush toy (DEBTI-40868/26-2), and two chocolate bars (DEBTI-40868/26-4). The goods are to be classified under subheading 1704 9065 of the Combined Nomenclature as non-cocoa confectionery, other, other, other, gummy candies and jelly products, including fruit pastes in the form of confectionery.

Description: A plush toy made of polyester and a cardboard bag. The cardboard bag contains the plush toy, four chocolate pralines with milk cream filling, two chocolate bars, and a pack of gummy candies. Confidential information was provided regarding the composition. Findings based on a sample: Two brown milk chocolate bars (dimensions approx. 5 x 2.5 x 1.3 cm) filled with a light beige, airy cream, individually sealed in colorfully printed plastic film with the imprint (excerpt) "choco&cream 17 g". The chocolate bars are packaged together with a plush toy (not part of this Binding Tariff Information decision, see DEBTI-40868/26-2), a pack of gummy candies (not part of this Binding Tariff Information decision, see DEBTI-40868/26-3), and chocolate pralines (not part of this Binding Tariff Information decision, see DEBTI-40868/26-1) in a cardboard folding box printed with a Christmas motif (dimensions in cm: approx. 27 x 14 x 9) with a handle and a cutout for the plush toy's head. Labeling (excerpt): "Merry Christmas". This Binding Tariff Information decision relates exclusively to the chocolate bars from the set with the plush toy, chocolate pralines, and pack of gummy candies. The sample presented here is a product set designed for retail sale, consisting of: - a gymnastic ball -- with a diameter of approximately 20 cm (circumference approximately 63 cm) and a weight of 300 g -- made of plastic, according to the application, of PVC -- inflatable, equipped with a valve -- intended for physical exercise (e.g., aerobics, Pilates, yoga, gymnastics) - a hand-operated air pump (approximately 21 cm long) with an approximately 3 cm long inflation needle -- according to the application, presented together in a folding box made of kraft paper for retail sale. In view of its size and importance for its intended use, the gymnastic ball determines the character of the product set. The goods are classified under customs tariff law as "Equipment for general physical exercise, not elsewhere specified or included in Chapter 95, not covered by subheadings (HS) 9506 11 to 9506 51, inflatable ball".

Preparation based on odorants; peach flavoring. The goods in question are a colorless liquid with an intense peach odor. The flavoring, which is reportedly natural, is used in small doses for the production of fruit gums and consists of flavoring preparations and natural flavoring substances. The flavoring is sold in 25 kg containers. Confidential information, including details of its composition, is available. The sample was submitted in a 100 ml plastic screw-top bottle. The goods are to be classified as other preparations based on odorants, of a type used in the food industry, under subheading 3302 1090 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Preparation based on odorants; raspberry flavoring. The sample in question is a red liquid with an intense raspberry odor. The flavoring, which is reportedly natural, is used in small doses for the production of fruit gums and consists of flavoring preparations and natural flavoring substances. The flavoring is sold in 25 kg containers; confidential information, including details of its composition, is available. The product is to be classified as "other preparation based on odorants, of a kind used in the food industry" under subheading 3302 1090 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Polyurethane tire, photo attached, - according to the application: - - black tire with herringbone tread pattern made of so-called polyurethane soft integral foam (plastic), - - with a size of 24" x 1" and for a rim width of 19 mm and a weight of 0.53 kg, - is mounted directly onto the rear wheel (so-called rear wheel rim) of a wheelchair, - due to its design (including material), clearly intended primarily for use on wheelchairs for disabled persons. "Part for wheelchairs of heading 8713 (polyurethane tire)"

Rear silencer assembly, so-called silencer, drawing see annex, - vehicle-specific, manufactured according to technical drawing, - essentially consisting of according to the application: - - a flat silencer (muffler) made of base metal, - - two inlet and two outlet pipes and two exhaust flap control units, - - not for industrial assembly, - is installed in the exhaust system of passenger cars, - serves for noise reduction and sound design, - recognizably intended mainly for motor vehicles of Chapter 87 due to its objective characteristics (including shape) and properties. "Part for motor vehicles of heading 8703 (silencer), other than those specified in subheadings 8708 10 to 8708 91, not for industrial assembly"

Rear silencer assembly, so-called silencer, drawing see annex, - vehicle-specific, manufactured according to technical drawing, - essentially consisting of according to the application: - - a flat silencer (muffler) made of base metal, - - two inlet and two outlet pipes and two exhaust flap control units, - - not for industrial assembly, - is installed in the exhaust system of passenger cars, - serves for noise reduction and sound design, - recognizably intended mainly for motor vehicles of Chapter 87 due to its objective characteristics (including shape) and properties. "Part for motor vehicles of heading 8703 (silencer), other than those specified in subheadings 8708 10 to 8708 91, not for industrial assembly"

Rear silencer assembly, so-called silencer, drawing see annex, - manufactured specifically for the vehicle, - according to the application: - - essentially consisting of: - - - a flat silencer (muffler) made of base metal, - - - two inlet pipes, four outlet pipes, two bypass pipes, as well as two exhaust flap control units and brackets, - - not for industrial assembly, - is installed in the exhaust system of passenger cars, - serves for noise reduction and sound design, - recognizably intended mainly for motor vehicles of Chapter 87 due to its objective characteristics (including shape) and properties. "Part for motor vehicles of heading 8703 (silencer), other than that specified in subheadings 8708 10 to 8708 91, not for industrial assembly"

The article illustrated by a sample is a cable box made of polystyrene, a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39, with a removable bamboo lid. The item, measuring approximately 32.3 x 13 x 14.4 cm, features openings on its narrow sides for cable routing. It serves, among other things, to house multiple socket outlets, protecting them from dust, for example. The nature of the composite product is determined by the plastic container in terms of its significance in relation to its use and its size. Such products are classified under customs tariff headings as "other plastic goods, other than those covered by codes 3926 1000 00 0 to 3926 9097 77 0".

Housing of a ball screw drive, see attached illustration, - shape-specific profile manufactured according to technical drawing from an aluminum alloy - provided with mounting holes at regular intervals - with a total length of 5600 mm - after further mechanical processing and cutting to length, recognizable as a housing of a ball screw drive (so-called compact module; not the subject of this VZTA) intended as a "part, recognizable solely or principally for a ball or roller screw, not of cast iron or steel"

Applicant's information: Crude sunflower oil with a high linoleic acid content. Production: Pressing and extraction. Use: Suitable for use as food. Botanical origin: Heliantus annuus L. Findings on a sample: Yellow, slightly cloudy, oily liquid; odor: characteristic of sunflower oil. Indication: Sunflower oil, safflower oil, and cottonseed oil, as well as their fractions, including refined but not chemically modified: Sunflower oil and safflower oil, as well as their fractions: crude oils: other: sunflower oil

According to the applicant, the product is a grey tire made of foamed polyurethane, a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The 195 x 58 mm versatile product (Shore hardness 50) has an embossed tread pattern and is intended for direct mounting on a rim (not subject to the binding tariff information). Such products are classified under customs tariff law as "other plastic products other than those covered by subheadings (CN) 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".

Transport cart, so-called firewood trolley, photos attached, - three-sided enclosed cart with loading platform, - according to the application: - - made of galvanized and powder-coated sheet steel and steel tubing, - - with external dimensions (W x D x H) of approx. 43 cm x 56 cm x 116 cm, - - with a storage compartment, a step at the rear and a U-shaped push/pull bar, - - with two side wheels made of plastic, - for transporting firewood or kindling, - is pushed or pulled by hand and serves for the transport of goods. "Other non-self-propelled vehicle (transport cart)"

Inflatable boat, so-called paddle boat, photo see attachment, - essentially consisting according to the application - - an inflatable boat body made of three-layer PVS with three separate air chambers, - - four insertable floor panels made of aluminum, - - two removable bench seats, - - a stern bracket for attaching an outboard motor, - - in two different sizes (3.20 m length with 50.7 kg empty weight and 3.80 m length with 64.6 kg empty weight), - with non-essential accessories, - - including two paddles, a foot pump, a transport bag and a repair kit, - optionally propelled by the paddles or by an outboard motor (not the subject of this binding tariff information), - can be used for recreational and sporting purposes on lakes, rivers and coastal waters. "Other recreational or sports boats, inflatable boats, designed to be fitted with a motor, with an unladen weight (net weight) without motor of 100 kg or less"

The products illustrated by the images and descriptions are toy vehicles, specifically foldable scooters, with dimensions of approximately 88 x 37 x 96–108 cm (unfolded, L x W x H), consisting of a steel footboard and a height-adjustable T-handlebar with rubber grips, with two plastic wheels, equipped with a rear brake, for a maximum user weight of 100 kg, propelled by pushing off with the foot, available in four different colors, intended for playful transportation, and supplied with a textile carrying strap and two Allen wrenches for toy maintenance, packaged together with instructions in a cardboard box. The scooter, in terms of its size and importance for use, determines the nature of the goods supplied. Such products are classified under customs tariff regulations as "scooters".

The article illustrated by a product sample is a white, so-called kidney-shaped container made of molded plastic as defined in Note 1(1) to Chapter 39 (according to the application, made of PET). The slightly curved container has a capacity of 700 ml and is intended for single use. According to the applicant, it is suitable for clinical, nursing, and medical practice applications. Packaged in polybags of 100 units, the product is classified under customs tariff regulations as "other plastic goods, other than those specified in subheadings (CN) 3926 1000 to 3926 9060".

Wired headphones (see attached image), consisting of two speakers (receivers) in housings with ear cushions, connected by an adjustable headband, with a 1.80-meter-long, permanently attached cable with a 3.5 mm stereo jack connector, for converting electrical audio frequency signals into sound waves. "Headphones"

The product illustrated by the images and descriptions is a toy set consisting of: - a highly stylized, all-terrain vehicle, - made of plastic, - approximately 19 cm long, - with four wheels, a driver's cab, and a specifically shaped rear end with a recess for a cannon; - a toy gun, - made of plastic, - representing a stylized handgun, - with a pistol grip, a disproportionately large muzzle, and a trigger on top, - intended to be played with separately and held in the hand as well as mounted on the rear of the aforementioned vehicle; - a ball made of plastic, - designed to fit the muzzle of the aforementioned gun and intended as a projectile for it, - representing an independently usable toy ball; - an animal, - representing a highly stylized dog (bulldog), - made of plastic. Thus, unfilled, - - dressed with a helmet and a backpack, - serves as playful entertainment for children, - packaged in a brightly printed display box. Such products are classified under customs tariff regulations as "toys, presented as an assortment".

LED rear light (see attached image) – consisting of an LED in a plastic housing (dimensions: 60 x 35 x 25 mm) with battery compartment and control unit, not yet assembled with a mounting device for attaching to a bicycle, – for use as a lighting and signaling device for bicycles, – together with accessories (batteries and instructions) in a common retail packaging. The LED rear light determines the character of the whole. "Electric lighting and signaling device, not a product of heading 8539, of a type used for bicycles, not yet assembled with a mounting bracket, in a set of goods put up for retail sale with accessories that do not determine the character of the product."

These are bells with a steel soundbox (approximately 50 mm in diameter), which is the defining characteristic. This soundbox consists of two hemispherical bell caps screwed together. A simple mechanism inside the soundbox, comprising base metal discs and plastic gears, produces a sound when the associated plastic lever is actuated. A steel mounting bracket is attached below the soundbox, allowing the product to be mounted on, for example, bicycle handlebars. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products, classified as "bells, non-electric, of base metals," fall under TARIC code 8306 1000 00.

The article illustrated in the images is an empty ink cartridge (ink tank) for an inkjet printer, made of molded plastics as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. This specially designed, so-called empty cartridge has different fill volumes (approximately 31 ml, 45 ml, 55 ml, 62 ml, 70 ml, 120 ml, 220 ml, and 380 ml) and is equipped with an electronic chip that allows the printer to recognize the ink cartridge. It does not have a printhead. Classification as a "part for machinery of heading 8443" is not possible due to the lack of a printhead. Such products are classified under customs tariff headings as "other goods of plastics, other than those specified in code numbers 3926 1000 00 0 to 3926 9097 77 0".

Ceramic ware for technical purposes, so-called sliding ring, photo see attachment, - in the form of a white, ring-shaped product, - according to the application: - - with an outer diameter of approx. 38 mm, an inner diameter of approx. 25.7 mm and a height of approx. 8 mm, - - with a lapped and polished surface, - - fired after prior shaping, - - made of Rubalit A1999.7, - - with a Mohs hardness of 9 or more, - used in pump motors of commercial dishwashers, - not refractory ware, as this is not required for its intended use. "Ceramic ware for technical purposes (sliding ring), not made of porcelain, with a Mohs hardness of 9 or more"

Other confectionery without cocoa content; sugar sprinkles. The goods are elongated sprinkles of sugar in various colors. They are used, for example, to decorate baked goods. The goods are to be classified as other confectionery without cocoa content, dragees, under subheading 1704 9061 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Drive modules, so-called drive unit for electric wheelchairs, photo see attachment, - in the form of two specially designed drive units, - according to the application: - - essentially consisting of: - - - an electric motor (24 volts, 200 watts), - - - a bevel gear (6 km/h with a gear ratio of 33:1), - - - an output shaft with mounting flange, - - - a magnetic brake, which is flanged to the commutator side of the electric motor; The drive is electrically released during operation and safely brakes the drive, and thus the electric wheelchair, when stationary or in the event of a sudden voltage drop. It includes a brake lever (swivel lever) for mechanical release for push mode with signaling in the control unit and prevention of the electric drive function when the brake is mechanically released, a connecting cable and plug for connection to the wheelchair control unit, and is specifically designed for the typical speed of electric wheelchairs. These components are mounted in pairs (left and right) on wheelchairs and, due to their design and dimensions, are clearly intended exclusively for wheelchairs for disabled persons of heading 8713. "Parts for wheelchairs of heading 8713 (drive modules)"

Electric table grill (see attached image) – consisting of an electric heating element in a housing (dimensions: 440 x 75 x 290 mm) with a die-cast aluminum grilling surface, removable grease tray, thermostat, status indicator, and a power cord, – with a power output of 1,800 W, – intended for household use for grilling food. "Electric heating appliance for household use, not a product of subheadings (CN) 8516 5000 to 8516 6050, grilling and roasting appliance"

Beverage refrigerator (see attached image) - in the form of a freestanding display refrigerator with compressor technology, glass door, fans, controls, LED interior lighting and shelves, - with a usable capacity of approx. 63 liters and an adjustable temperature range of approx. 3°C to 18°C, - filled with isobutane refrigerant (R600a), - for cooling and displaying beverages. "Refrigerator, refrigerated display case for storing and displaying goods, not a product of TARIC codes 8418 5011 10 to 8418 5019 10 - Beverage refrigerator"

The article illustrated in the images is a cylindrical container with a screw cap made of plastic, as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The product, intended for holding printer ink (diameter approx. 3.6 cm, height approx. 13.5 cm), has a capacity of 80 ml or 100 ml and is equipped with a specifically manufactured cap featuring a pierceable membrane. For customs tariff purposes, such products are classified as "other plastic goods, other than those covered by code numbers 3926 1000 00 0 to 3926 9097 77 0".

Waffle iron (see attached image) – consisting of an electric heating system (power: 1,000 W) with a two-part baking surface (waffle plate) in a hinged housing (dimensions: 205 x 305 x 155 mm) with filling opening, LED display, touch controls, indicator lights and a power cord, – for household use for baking waffles, – together with an accessory (measuring aid) in a single retail package. The waffle iron is the defining characteristic of the product. "Electric heating appliance for household use, not a product of TARIC codes 8516 5000 00 to 8516 7970 10, in a set of goods put up for retail sale with an accessory that is not the defining characteristic."

Citrus press (see attached illustration) - consisting of a pressing cone driven by an electric motor (power: 160 W) in a base metal housing (dimensions: 184 x 302 x 227 mm) with a press hood mounted on a lever, sieve, spout with drip stop, suction feet on the underside, and a power cord, - for household use for juicing citrus fruits. "Electromechanical household appliance with built-in electric motor, not a vacuum cleaner of heading 8508, fruit press"

According to the applicant, the product is intended for use as a cat snack (pet food). It consists of freeze-dried chicken breast meat cut into approximately cube-shaped pieces, without any other additives. The product is labelled as a supplementary feed for cats and packaged for individual sale in cylindrical, so-called maxi-tubes (container with a colorfully printed label and plastic lid; contents 200g). Since the production and transport of the product do not comply with food hygiene standards, the product is not suitable for human consumption. Under customs tariff regulations, it is classified as "goods of animal origin, not elsewhere specified or included, unsuitable for human consumption, not covered by TARIC codes 0511 1000 00 to 0511 9985 20".

"Hand impact wrench set with bits, 5-piece." Product assortment in retail packaging, consisting of: - an unassembled impact wrench (essential component), comprising: - a cylindrical handle made of base metal, with a recessed internal hexagon socket made of base metal at the lower end; - a replaceable screwdriver bit made of base metal; - three additional bits made of base metal (slotted and Phillips bits) in various sizes; - for loosening stuck screws; by striking the end of the handle with a hammer, the impact wrench is set into partial rotation, thus simultaneously rotating the bit and driving it into the screw head; - all packaged together in a metal box specially designed for the above-mentioned products and suitable for continuous use. See attached illustration. Such products fall under TARIC code 8205 4000 00 as "Hand tools (screwdrivers) not elsewhere specified or included, with working part of base metal".

"Electric actuators" Combined machines, essentially consisting of: - a brushed, DC linear electric motor with a helical rotor including a control rod, with a power output of approximately 13.6 W (main function); - a controller, a sensor, and an electrical connector (interface for vehicle diagnostic system); - all housed together in a cylindrical casing with type-dependent dimensions; - for controlling a so-called boost pressure valve in the exhaust gas turbocharger system of a gasoline engine. See illustration in the annex. These products are classified as "electric motors with a power output of 37.5 W or less, not included in code numbers 8501 1010 0 to 8501 1093 90 0, DC motors not included in code numbers 8501 1099 10 0 to 8501 1099 79 0" and are therefore subject to tariff code 8501 1099 90 0.

These are T-shaped products made of stainless steel, in the form of a hexagonal plate machined into a cylindrical sleeve in the center. The products have a continuous metric internal thread (size M8). The sleeve has a circumferential groove on the outside into which a sealing ring made of plastic or rubber is inserted. The goods are used for fastening clamps to mounting rails. They are packaged in sets of 25 in a transparent, labeled plastic bag. Overall height: 13 mm. - Applicant's information - The character of the products, which are composed of various materials, is determined by the steel component due to its size and its significance for the intended use. See attached illustration. Such products are classified as "steel goods similar to nuts, with threads" under subheading 7318 1900 of the Combined Nomenclature.

These are T-shaped products made of galvanized steel, in the form of a hexagonal plate machined into a cylindrical sleeve in the center. The products have a continuous metric internal thread (size M6). The sleeve is encased in a specifically shaped sleeve made of plastic or rubber, which has a knurled outer surface. The goods are used to fasten clamps to mounting rails. The sleeve ensures a precise fit and alignment of the so-called support rail nuts. The nuts are packaged in sets of 50 in a transparent, labeled plastic bag. Overall height: 14.5 mm. - Applicant's information - The character of the products, which are composed of various materials, is determined by the steel component due to its size and its significance for the intended use. See attached illustration. Such products, classified as "steel goods similar to nuts, with threads," fall under subheading 7318 1900 of the Combined Nomenclature.

According to the applicant's information and the submitted sample, the so-called severed body parts are replicas of three human fingers, an eyeball, and an ear. The products, intended for spooky decoration, are made of plastics as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39 and are packaged in a polybag with a cardboard header. Classification as festive (Halloween) articles under heading 9505 is not possible due to the neutral design and lack of festive significance. For customs tariff purposes, they are classified as "other goods made of plastics, statuettes and other ornamental articles."

Scissor lift pallet truck (see attached image) - with manually operated tiller with handle and lowering lever, hydraulic lifting pump, forked load platform (length: 1800 mm) with steerable twin wheels and fork rollers, - with a maximum fork lift of 715 mm and a maximum load capacity of 1000 kg, - for lifting, lowering, and transporting goods typically on pallets. "Cart equipped with lifting device for conveying and handling, not self-propelled, not a manual pallet truck - scissor lift pallet truck"

Scissor lift pallet truck (see attached image) - with manually operated tiller with handle and lowering lever, lifting motor, automatic side stabilizers, fork-shaped load platform (length: 1170 mm) with steerable twin wheels and fork rollers, a 12 V/65 Ah battery and integrated charger, - with a maximum fork lift of 715 mm and a maximum load capacity of 1000 kg, - for lifting, lowering and transporting goods typically on pallets. "Hand truck equipped with lifting device for conveying and handling, not a product of TARIC codes 8427 1010 10 to 8427 9000 30 - Scissor lift pallet truck"

"Injector sockets, 4-piece set," consisting of four socket wrench inserts made of base metal (chromium vanadium steel), each with a ½" square drive at one end and a hexagonal drive with a wide recess on the side at the other end, in different sizes (25, 27, 29, 30 mm) depending on the version, for disassembling the electrical unit of injectors, housed together in a specially designed and durable plastic case suitable for continuous use and fitted with a printed cardboard sleeve. See attached illustration. Classification under heading 8205 is not possible because the goods are already covered by the wording of heading 8204. Such products, as "interchangeable socket wrench inserts with a working part of base metal," fall under TARIC code 8204 2000 00.

Genmaicha-Matcha, green tea with 50% roasted rice, cut for tea bags. Mixture of finely crushed green leaves, light brown particles, and a small amount of green powder; hay-like, grassy aroma, typical of green tea; when steeped with hot water, it produces a green tea beverage with a roasted grain flavor. Milk fat, milk protein: not included. Starch/glucose (determined according to Regulation (EU) 118/2010): 25% to less than 50% by weight. Sucrose/invert sugar/isoglucose (determined according to Regulation (EU) 900/2008): less than 5% by weight. The amount of roasted rice and the resulting flavor modification go beyond mere flavoring; this is a tea preparation, not a flavored tea of ​​heading 0902 of the CN. Preparation based on tea leaves containing 5% or more glucose or starch, with a sucrose content (including invert sugar calculated as sucrose) or isoglucose content (calculated as sucrose) of less than 70%, without the addition of cane or beet sugar.

According to the applicant and the submitted product sample, the product is a set consisting of 12 transparent, closed plastic rods (approx. 200 mm long, approx. 5 mm in diameter) filled with a colored liquid (in various colors) and 12 clear plastic connectors. The rods can be bent and inserted into the connectors to form bracelets or necklaces and worn as jewelry. Bending the rods causes the substances inside to mix, triggering a chemical reaction that produces colored light. The products are packaged in a printed cardboard box and are intended for fun and entertainment at parties, concerts, and other festive events. Such products are classified as "entertainment articles" under code number 9505 9000 00 0.

"Deco Vase Bottle L" These are slender vases made of base metal (aluminum) with a high neck that tapers to a round opening (diameter: approximately 4.5 cm) at the top. The products are intended for decorating living spaces or similar areas. Dimensions: Height: 100 cm; Diameter of vase neck: 3.5 cm; Width at center of vase: 13 cm - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "other decorative articles of base metal, neither silver-plated nor gold-plated nor platinum-plated" under TARIC code 8306 2900 00.

Stainless steel profile. The product is an L-shaped profile made of stainless steel (1.4301 / AISI 304). The profile has a height of 4.5 mm, 6 mm, 8 mm, 9 mm, 10 mm, 12 mm, 15 mm, 17.5 mm, 20 mm, 25 mm, or 30 mm. The profile has a length of 2500 mm. The product has a brushed or high-gloss polished surface and a regular punched pattern. The product is used as a tile trim. Based on its material composition, the product is classified under TARIC code 7222 4090 90 as bar stock and profiles, stainless steel, profiles, other.

Aldehyde; o-Phthalaldehyde. According to the submitted data sheet, the product is the chemically homogeneous compound o-phthalaldehyde with a purity of at least 99%. One abbreviation is OPA. The CAS number is 643-79-8. The product is a yellow, crystalline powder and is used in papermaking. It is to be classified as a miscellaneous aldehyde under subheading 2912 29 of the Combined Nomenclature.

These are steel products (so-called steel frames) with an approximately cuboid frame and numerous, specifically arranged braces running vertically, diagonally, or horizontally within the frame of the side panels, base, and top. The underside of the base has feet and recesses at various points. These non-stackable goods serve as transport devices for the temporary accommodation of air conditioning units during transport. Overall length: approximately 320 cm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products, classified as "steel goods other than those specified in the preceding TARIC codes," fall under TARIC code 7326 9098 90.

Bicycle rear light (see attached image) - consisting of a printed circuit board equipped with a light-emitting diode and other electrical components in a plastic housing (dimensions: 115 x 50 x 55 mm) with two batteries, a red and white transparent cover (reflector) and transparent lenses on the front, and a mounting device on the back for attaching it to a bicycle mudguard - for use as a rear light and parking light for bicycles. "Electrical lighting and signaling device of a type used for bicycles, not goods of heading 8539"

Multimedia center for motor vehicles with connection option for mobile computers (see attached image) - consisting of a touch-sensitive 9-inch color liquid crystal display (screen diagonal: 22.9 cm), audio/video decoder, amplifier, equalizer, microphone, radio tuner with RDS decoder, DAB+ dual tuner, GPS receiver, WLAN and Bluetooth module in a housing for installation in a motor vehicle with front-mounted controls, rear HDMI input, two USB ports, micro SD card slot, and several antenna and system connections, - for displaying signals from various signal sources after connecting a reversing camera, mobile computers (via HDMI) or other video sources, for image and sound playback from storage media, for receiving radio signals including additional information (RDS), for satellite-based radio navigation, and for receiving, converting and transmitting radio signals, among other things. For hands-free operation with mobile phones, - for direct connection to and use with an automatic data processing machine of heading 8471, - together with accessories (cable, GPS antenna, hands-free microphone, connecting cable, adapter, mounting material, instruction manual, remote controls) in a common sales package. The multimedia center determines the character of the whole. "Monitors, without built-in television receiver, other monitor, for direct connection to and use with an automatic data processing machine of heading 8471, with a liquid crystal display (LCD) screen, combined with navigation equipment, radio receiver, video equipment and communication equipment - without a character-defining component -, in a set of goods put up for retail sale with non-character-defining accessories"

The article illustrated by a sample is a so-called 2-in-1 sponge made of expanded polyether, a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39. The approximately 15 x 6 x 4.3 cm, semi-cylindrical product has a ribbed surface on its rounded top and features both a soft and a firmer end. The sponge is intended for household cleaning and is packaged in pairs in a cardboard box. Such products are classified under customs tariff regulations as "other household or domestic articles of plastics, other than those specified in TARIC codes 3924 9000 10".

Pallet truck (see attached image) - with manually operated, swiveling tiller with integrated lowering lever in the handle and automatic lowering mechanism, hydraulic lifting pump, steerable twin wheels, and a 2000 mm long fork-shaped load platform, - with a maximum fork lift of 200 mm and a maximum load capacity of 2000 kg, - not shipped from Thailand, - for lifting, lowering, and transporting goods typically on pallets. "Hand truck equipped with lifting device for conveying and handling, not a product of TARIC codes 8427 1010 10 to 8427 9000 11 - Pallet truck"

These are rectangular flat steel products with rounded corners and two circular perforations (diameter: 50 mm) on each of their long sides. The products serve as so-called roadway plates or floor slabs. Dimensions: 5000 x 1800 x 13.4 mm. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "steel goods other than those specified in the preceding subheadings" under subheading 7326 9098 of the Combined Nomenclature.

Hand truck, so-called electric stair climbing hand truck, photo attached, - in the form of goods composed of various components, consisting of: - a non-self-propelled vehicle in the form of a hand truck, - - as per application, - - - with a height of approx. 1610 mm, a width of approx. 530 mm and a depth of 570 mm, - - - with a dead weight of 30 kg, - - - with a safety bar with a plastic handle, - - - with a maximum load capacity of 170 kg, - - with two wheels, - - with a loading shovel at the front, - an electromechanical climbing aid on the rear of the hand truck with: - - according to the data sheet, an electric motor (48V/400W) and battery (48V/10Ah), - - a lifting/lowering device equipped with small rollers (so-called climbing arms), - with non-essential accessories, - serves only for the electric lifting and lowering of goods over stairs, but cannot be used as a self-propelled device. - for pushing or pulling by hand, - in view of its significance for use, size and appearance, the hand truck determines the character of the goods composed of various components, - not classified under heading 8428, since goods of section XVII are excluded from section XVI. "Non-self-propelled vehicle (hand truck)"

These are circular products made of stainless steel, with a central, circular hole and a specifically shaped, circumferential rim with an almost triangular cross-section. The goods are available in various sizes and serve as washers for countersunk screws. - Applicant's information - See attached image. Such products are classified as "other washers made of stainless steel" under tariff code 7318 2200 91 0.

Pet toys, photo see attachment, - twenty-three pieces as a set of goods, packaged together in a cardboard box printed with a reference to cat toys according to the application, for individual sale and assembled to satisfy a specific need (entertainment of pets), - made of knitted textile materials (twelve pieces): -- eleven pieces: in the form of various figures (1 "gingerbread man", 2 "pillows", 2 "fish", 1 "mouse", 1 "shell", 1 "star", 1 "candy", 1 "candy cane", 1 "stocking", lying flat with max. dimensions of up to approx. 9.5 cm (L), 6 cm (W) and 3 cm (H); made of various plain and printed velvet knitted fabrics; the "mouse" is also provided with two "ears" and a "tail" made of apparently non-woven fabrics, -- one piece: in the form of a "fishing rod": made of an approx. 30 cm long wooden stick with a knotted, approx. 47 cm long cord and a star made of knitted velvet (approx. 7 cm in diameter) as above; the knitted fabrics determine the essential character of the "fishing rod" particularly with regard to its external appearance; all the above-mentioned figures and the "fishing rod" star are filled with wadding and, according to the application, a small quantity of catnip; assembled by joining them together; made of ropes of textile materials (eight pieces): six pieces: in different shapes [2 balls, 1 "mouse", 1 "carrot", 1 cylinder, 1 disc with maximum dimensions of up to approx. 8.5 cm (L), 5 cm (W) and 7 cm (H): each with a hollow plastic body filled with a small quantity of small "rattle stones" and wrapped on the outside with various glued-on yarns of apparently jute and paper yarns of heading 5308; the mouse is also equipped with two "ears" made of eye- apparently made of nonwoven fabric, -- two pieces: as "bows" (L: approx. 28 cm) made of round braids of heading 5607, approx. 1 cm thick, which are wrapped with various yarns except for the fringed ends, - of wood (five pieces): made of dried tendril sections (Ø approx. 0.5 cm, L: approx. 8 cm) of apparently matatabi climbing plants, - of catnip (two pieces): in the form of a ball (Ø approx. 4.5 cm) and a "fish" (approx. 6.5 cm x 3.2 cm x 1 cm), made of dried parts of the catnip plant, apparently pressed and bonded with a binding agent, - clearly intended for animals due to their nature and presentation, therefore not goods of heading 9503, - not goods of heading 9505 due to their intrinsic value, - particularly with regard to the size and quantity Knitted goods made from textile materials predominate and give the product range its essential character. "Other made-up goods (animal toys), made from textile materials, knitted"

Belt made of reconstituted leather, photo attached, - according to the application: - - with a thin outer layer of embossed cellular plastic (polyurethane) on a textile backing, - - with a middle layer of reconstituted leather, - - - apparently forming the thickest layer (more than half the total thickness), - - with a very thin inner layer of cellular plastic (polyurethane), - - with a belt buckle made of base metal, - - with punched holes, - - with a width of approximately 3.8 cm and a length of approximately 118 cm (including buckle), - without any indication of handwork, - the reconstituted leather gives the belt its essential character with regard to its size (thickness of the layer) and its importance in relation to its use (tensile strength). "Clothing accessory (belt), made of reconstituted leather, not handcrafted"

Electric power cart, so-called ride-on electric tractor, photo see attachment, - in the form of a single-seat, self-propelled, three-wheeled power cart without a loading platform or lifting device, with: - - three rubber-tired drive wheels, - - a steering column approximately 300 mm long and 100 mm wide, - - an overall length of approximately 1275 mm, a width of approximately 710 mm, and a maximum drawbar height of 1290 mm, - - a weight of 260 kg, - - an electric drive motor with a power output of 1 kW powered by three batteries (3 x 12 V / 90 Ah), - - a maximum speed of 8 km/h, - - with a trailer hitch (pin coupling), - - a turning circle less than the length of the vehicle, - neither suitable for transporting persons nor for transporting goods on public roads, - used for pulling or pushing For rolling loads up to a maximum weight of 2000 kg and on inclines of up to 8% in production halls, logistics centers, airports and on company premises. These are grids made of galvanized steel wire (maximum cross-sectional dimension: approximately 0.7 mm), welded at the intersections. Such products, classified as "other grids of steel wire, welded at the intersections, with a mesh size of less than 100 cm², of wire with a cross-sectional dimension of less than 3 mm, galvanized," fall under TARIC code 7314 3100 00.

These are approximately rectangular meshes made of galvanized steel wire (maximum cross-sectional dimension: 0.75 mm), the individual wires of which are welded together at the intersections to form square meshes (mesh size: 19 mm). "Bicycle rack" - a product made entirely of galvanized steel, consisting of two parallel, multi-perforated base rails made of square tubing and eight approximately U-shaped brackets, which are attached to the rails in pairs at regular intervals by means of mounting brackets - for mounting on the floor or on a wall - serves as a holding device for up to four bicycles, in which the tires are clamped between the brackets - dimensions: 950 mm x 330 mm x 270 mm. The article illustrated by images and a data sheet is a floor/furniture glide for office chairs. The product, approximately 55 mm high, consists of a solid, nearly cylindrical polyurethane base (approx. 50 mm in diameter), a plastic as defined in Note 1 to Chapter 39, and a metal pin (approx. 11 cm in diameter) for attaching the base. Given its size and importance in relation to its use (floor protection), the plastic determines the nature of the product, which is composed of various materials. Five glides are packaged as a set and are classified under customs tariff regulations as "other plastic goods, furniture fittings, other than those specified in TARIC codes 3926 3000 40 to 3926 3000 50".

These are approximately cuboid, lockable mailboxes made of steel (not stainless steel), with a letter slot and a flap around the front top edge bearing the word "POST". A roughly V-shaped metal plate for holding a daily newspaper is attached to the underside. The slightly outward-curving, hinged front panel features a lock with a key, a rectangular viewing window, and a nameplate, all made of plastic, as well as rubber feet. The mailboxes are packaged in a cardboard box for individual sale, including keys, assembly instructions, and mounting hardware (screws, wall plugs, and plastic spacers). Dimensions: 350 x 445 x 95 mm - Applicant's information - The nature of the goods as packaged for individual sale is determined by the quantity and significance of the mailboxes for their intended use. The use of materials other than stainless steel determines the nature of the mailboxes, which are composed of various materials, due to the quantity and significance of the package for their intended use. See attached illustration. Such products fall under TARIC code 7323 99 00 90 as "other household articles of steel (not stainless steel)".

This is a rectangular mailbox made of galvanized steel (not stainless steel) for wall mounting (dimensions: 21.5 x 8.4 x 32 cm). It features a mail slot on the top, covered by a flap.
