Description: Decorative plastic film for outdoor use, for laminating panels and profiles. Two-layer construction: PVC base film (thickest layer) coated with a pigmented polyurethane system. The plasticizer content is less than 6% by weight and the thickness is less than 1 mm. No sample was submitted. A photograph shows the product as a gray, rectangular film. Findings: Other films, not of cellular plastics, neither reinforced nor layered (laminated) or similarly bonded to other materials, without a backing, of vinyl chloride polymers, other, with a thickness of 1 mm or less.

According to the submitted sample and the applicant's supplementary information, the product is a white, approximately 19.3 cm long, round plastic tube. Its front surface is printed with a slightly raised pattern of square boxes (so-called X-ray markers) using pad printing (a printing process as defined in Chapter 49). The printing ink used contains tungsten powder and is applied in a total of ten layers. After import, the printed tube is cut to size and then adapted to a stent (not the subject of this binding tariff information) to improve its X-ray visibility using the printed X-ray markers. See attached image. Such goods are classified as "other printed images, other than those specified in code 4911 9100 10 0" under tariff heading 4911 91 00 90 0.

Charging socket, in the form of a combined unit, essentially consisting of a multi-part plastic housing with electrical contacts for receiving a charging plug, equipped with an electrical locking/positioning device for the plugged-in charging plug, a status indicator (using an LED/light guide), and integrated temperature sensors for recording heat generation within the charging socket during the charging process. The sensor data is transmitted to and evaluated by an external charging control unit. The defining primary function of the "charging socket" is to establish an electrical connection between the battery of an electric vehicle and a charging station. The product is designed for an operating voltage of less than 1000 V. The product is to be classified as "electrical device for connecting electrical circuits, for a voltage of 1000 V or less, plug-in device, not for coaxial cables or printed circuits." Appendix: 1 Figure

So-called actuating pin, consisting of a cylindrical body made of base metal, manufactured according to a technical drawing, with dimensions Ø 5 x 60 mm, a round knob with Ø 10 mm at one end, and a rounded end with a notch at the other. The actuating pin is installed in a protection and monitoring device, where it serves as the actuator for the test button and is not energized. The goods are clearly designed exclusively for this main product. The goods are to be classified as "part, clearly designed exclusively for use with equipment of heading 8536, not for wafer probers, not an electronic assembly."

Decorative pendant, photo see attachment, - attached to a printed cardboard tag, - consisting of a carabiner hook in the shape of a stylized bone (approx. 4.5 cm x 2.5 cm) made of base metal (according to the application, coated zinc), - with a disc-shaped decorative plaque (approx. 3.5 cm diameter) made of what appears to be plastic, suspended from the carabiner hook and attached to a small ring made of the aforementioned metal, - with an approx. 18 cm long pendant made of an approx. 18 cm long colorful round braid with a tight weave and firm structure (= twine of heading 5607; approx. 0.5 cm diameter) and with a core of textile materials; laid into a loop approximately in the middle, knotted in the manner of a so-called hangman's knot and decorated with a colorful woven label made of fabric; fitted at each end with a sleeve of base metal, - with a pendant in the form of a stylized dog (approx. 9 cm x 6 cm), made of napped knitted fabric of heading 5903, coated on one side (outside) with cellular plastic; backed with nonwovens and filled with wadding, and fitted with a sewn-in loop of the aforementioned knitted fabric, approx. 13 cm long, - all textile products consist of textile materials, - without indication of handwork, - made up, inter alia, by joining, - serves as a decorative pendant on, for example, a bag, - in particular with regard to the extent (in the sense of area), the twine and knitted fabrics of textile materials predominate equally over the plastic and the base metals (thus neither a product of Chapter 39 nor of Chapter 79); With regard to external appearance, scope, and quantity, the twine and the knitted fabrics of textile materials are to be considered equivalent; thus, neither the twine nor the knitted fabrics give the goods their essential character. It is therefore to be assigned to the last of the equally relevant headings (5609 and 6307) in this nomenclature. "Other made-up articles (decorative pendants), of textile materials, of knitted fabrics"

The product illustrated by the sample, image, and description is an electric wall/ceiling light consisting of a housing measuring approximately 156 x 7.3 x 7.5 cm (L x W x H) with a clear plastic cover and electrical components. These include through-wiring with terminal connections, a miniature fuse with holder, a proximity switch with a timer, two G13 sockets, and a replaceable LED light source. The light is rated IP65 for ceiling or wall mounting indoors and outdoors. Stainless steel clips are used for mounting. The light is packaged for sale together with instructions and mounting hardware in a clear plastic film and cardboard insert. The product is to be classified as "electric light, not elsewhere specified or included, ceiling and wall light, excluding those of a type used in public places or thoroughfares, intended exclusively for use with LED light sources, made of plastic, not for civil aircraft."

The product illustrated by the sample, image, and description is an electric ceiling and wall light measuring approximately 1260 x 97 x 80 mm (L x W x H). It consists of a trough-shaped, solid-color plastic housing with four G13 sockets, two replaceable 120 cm LED light sources with T8 bases, a clear, ribbed plastic cover, and electrical components. These components include an optical proximity switch whose settings (brightness, sensitivity, and switching duration) can be preset using DIP switches. Mixture based on flavorings; beverage base apple. The product is a liquid preparation of flavorings, water, coloring, and apple juice concentrate, intended for use in the industrial production of beverages. The product is to be used at a concentration of 2 kg per 1000 liters. It is a mixture based on flavorings, of a type used in the beverage industry, other than that which is to be classified under subheading 3302 1040 of the Combined Nomenclature.

The product (see attached image) is a composite item consisting of an electric desk lamp approximately 39 cm high and an integrated inductive charging station. The desk lamp essentially comprises a white rectangular plastic base, which serves as the lamp base and charging station; a white, movable, rod-shaped plastic lamp arm; a white, rod-shaped plastic lamp head with a permanently installed, white LED light source adjustable to three brightness levels; and a white, transparent plastic cover. The product is equipped with operating buttons (on/off switch/dimmer) and a transformer with a mains plug. It serves both as a charger (heading 8504) for charging devices such as mobile phones and as an electric table lamp (heading 9405). A defining characteristic, particularly with regard to its significance in relation to its use, cannot be determined. Therefore, it is classified under the last-mentioned heading of the equally applicable headings. The goods are to be classified as "Lamp, not elsewhere specified or included, electric desk lamp, intended exclusively for use with LED light sources, made of plastics".

The product is a facial cleansing foam and appears as a liquid with a mild scent. The product is used to cleanse facial skin and removes dirt, excess sebum and makeup. It is stated that the product (the foam) is applied to wet skin, massaged into the skin with the brush and rinsed away. The product contains, among other things, water, organic surfactants and fragrance. The product is packaged for retail sale. The product is available as a 150 ml bottle with a foam pump with an inclined oval dispenser. The dispenser has a removable, oval and soft silicone brush.

The product is a DC motor in a plastic housing with three mounting points and a port for connecting an electrical wire. A shaft or gear extends from the housing. The product is a so-called actuator used to adjust flaps or air dampers in a vehicle's heating, ventilation and air conditioning system in order to regulate the direction of the air flow in the passenger compartment, switch between fresh air and recirculation and control the passenger compartment temperature. The actuator is controlled by the vehicle's climate control system. The product is a compact electromechanical unit consisting of a small electric motor with a gear system in a plastic housing. The product is not a synchronous motor. The electrical power consumption is between 5 and 15 watts and the motor is powered by direct current. Dimensions (H x L x W): 31.9 mm x 82.1 mm x 59.5 mm.

The product is long, narrow sheets of metal with perpendicular waves in the longitudinal direction, with a wooden slat attached to the top of each wave. On one side, the metal sheet at the bottom of the wave has a small bend along the entire length of the product, while the other side of the metal sheet is slightly longer than the other bottoms of the wave and has an upward bend, so that several sheets can easily be hooked together. The wooden strips are attached with staples and glue. There are no holes or the like for installation. It is stated that the product is intended as facade cladding for buildings. According to the information, the product consists of aluminum and pine wood, and the aluminum makes up the largest part of the product by weight. It is stated that the product is packed in boxes measuring 2400 x 194.5 x 25 mm and weighing 2.75 kg. The sample submitted has black aluminum and natural-colored slats.

Steel wire agricultural and game fence netting, supplied in rolls. Material: high carbon steel 82B. The wires are connected at the intersections with a hinge joint knot; the intersections are not welded. Wires: upper and lower boundary wire Ø 3.0 mm (tensile strength 1050 N/mm²), horizontal wires Ø 2.5 mm (1150 N/mm²), vertical wires Ø 2.0 mm (400–800 N/mm²). Dimensions: roll height 2500 mm, length 50 m. Vertical wire pitch 150 mm. Horizontal wire pitch from top to bottom 3 × 200 mm, 4 × 150 mm, 13 × 100 mm. Surface coating: zinc-aluminium alloy Zn95/Al5 according to EVS-EN 10244; coating weight on fence wires 185 g/m², on horizontal and vertical wires 155 g/m². Use: fences for farm animals and game, attached to steel posts.

Steel fence post, made of welded round tube (steel Q235), cut to size and further processed. Each post has 4 wire hooks welded to it at a distance of 75, 825, 1475 and 2175 mm from the top of the post, to which the fence wire is attached. Variants: Post 48 – outer diameter 48 mm, wall 1.5 mm, length 3000 mm, weight 5.1 kg; Post 60 – outer diameter 60 mm, wall 2.0 mm, length 3000 mm, weight 8.5 kg. Surface coating: hot-dip galvanizing after manufacture, 420 g/m², EVS-EN 1461. Use: agricultural and game fence posts; installed in the ground and fence netting, clamps and diagonal supports are attached to them.

Steel fence diagonal brace, delivered as a factory-assembled, non-dismantling product. Consists of three parts: 1) diagonal tube Ø 48 × 1.5 mm, length 2500 mm, steel Q235, hot-dip galvanized 420 g/m² (EVS-EN 1461); 2) bell clamp 48 mm, steel Q195 with a thickness of 2.0 mm, hot-dip galvanized 420 g/m²; bolt hole at the end for attaching to the post clamp; 3) two blind rivets Ø 4.8 mm, stainless steel AISI 304, which permanently connect the clamp to the tube. Set weight 4.4 kg. Use: diagonal bracing of fence posts in agricultural and game fences. The clamp is attached to the clamp on the post with a bolt, the tube carries the supporting load.

Molded protective cap for the end of a round steel tube, material: vulcanized rubber SBR (styrene-butadiene rubber), black. Not hard rubber. Hardness 60 ± 5 Shore A, tensile strength ≥ 8 MPa, operating temperature −30 … +70 °C. Variants: cap Ø48 – for post Ø 48 mm, weight 0.010 kg; cap Ø60 – for post Ø 60 mm, weight 0.015 kg. Use: closing the top end of fence posts to prevent water and dirt from entering the tube and to protect animals from sharp edges.

Children's coloring set, which includes a 39 × 120 cm black and white coloring poster and three double-sided crayons measuring 100 × 14 mm. The set is packaged in a rectangular gift box, inside which there is a separate box of crayons.

This is an inflatable mattress with dimensions of approximately 183 × 55 × 8 cm and a weight of approximately 1000 g. The product is delivered folded and deflated in a transparent plastic package with instructions for use inside. The product is intended for use, for example, in camping, outdoor activities, on the beach, in a camper van, on car trips, etc. The mattress is made mainly of polyester fabric and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) film. The polyester outer fabric, which has been treated to be waterproof, provides durability and comfort, while the TPU film forms an airtight structure.

Nails made from polished steel and obtained by wire drawing. They are presented in 3 kg boxes, not stacked, bundled, or rolled. They have a round, grooved head and the following dimensions: 2 mm in diameter and 35 mm in length, 3 mm in diameter and 70 mm in length, or 4.4 mm in diameter and 100 mm in length.

A rotary incremental optical encoder (sensor) is used to convert the angular position of a shaft into a digital code. Angular motion detection is based on the photoelectric scanning principle, employing a glass disk marked with a series of uniform lines attached to the shaft. A light-emitting unit and a sensor generate an electrical pulse each time a line passes through the disk's field of view as the shaft rotates. The shaft's position is determined by counting the number of pulses relative to the zero mark. This device is used to control angular or linear displacements, when used with racks or lead screws. In combination with an electrical control circuit (not integrated into the encoder and not part of the encoder itself) that counts pulses, it allows for the determination of the angle, position, shaft speed (revolutions per minute), acceleration, and other parameters. The main applications of these rotary transducers are in machine tools, robots, motor systems, and measuring and control equipment. Resolution: up to 5,000 pulses per revolution. Outer diameter: 58 mm. Shaft diameter: 10 mm.

Textile sacks made of synthetic material, consisting of flexible intermediate containers for bulk products made of polypropylene strips. Not knitted. Used. The width of the strips is less than 5 mm. The container capacity is greater than 500 kg. Function or use: Used for sale as second-hand sacks to customers with bulky items.

Food supplement presented in packs of 60 vegetable capsules for human consumption. Composed of natural astaxanthin obtained from the microalga Haematococcus pluvialis (a natural carotenoid), vitamin E, and technological excipients. Free from milk fat or with a content of less than 1.5% by weight, sucrose or isoglucose or with a content of less than 5% by weight, starch or glucose or with a content of less than 5% by weight. Function or use: Intended for food use

Food supplement for human consumption presented in hard capsules. Each capsule contains berberine (500 mg) and silymarin (100 mg), along with excipients. Free from milk fat or with a content of less than 1.5% by weight, sucrose or isoglucose or with a content of less than 5% by weight, starch or glucose or with a content of less than 5% by weight. Product packaged for retail sale in packs of 60 capsules. Function or use: Intended for food use.

Ready-to-use, water-based filler for filling small holes or cracks and leveling irregularities. Available for retail sale in 250ml, 750ml, and 5L containers. Use: Filler for repairing and filling all types of small cracks, joints, and voids on various types of building elements, indoors, as well as for leveling minor irregularities. Once dry, it can be painted with any plastic paint or synthetic enamel.

Non-welded metal mesh. It is made of zinc-plated and plastic-coated steel. It is available in rolls of 10 m or 50 m in length and in heights of 0.5 m, 0.6 m, 0.8 m, 1 m, 1.2 m, 1.5 m, or 2 m. It is manufactured with wire of 0.7 mm, 0.75 mm, 0.8 mm, or 0.9 mm in diameter. The cells are formed by twisting the wires together to create hexagonal mesh.

Mosquito netting woven with 0.22 mm diameter stainless steel wire. Mesh size: 1 x 1.5 mm. Available in 30-meter rolls and widths of 0.6, 0.8, 1, 1.2, and 1.5 meters. Used for manufacturing roll-up and fixed-frame insect screens.

Mosquito netting woven with galvanized steel wire, 0.22 mm in diameter. Mesh size: 1 x 1.5 mm. Available in 30-meter rolls and widths of 0.6, 0.8, 1, 1.2, and 1.5 meters. Used for manufacturing roll-up and fixed-frame insect screens.

Stamped zinc-plated steel clamp, consisting of two semi-cylindrical pieces, each with a flange, two bolts, and a nut. The nut, with a different internal diameter depending on the clamp's diameter, is also zinc-plated steel and spot-welded to the clamp. Clamp diameters range from 3/4" to 8". Sold in boxes of 10 to 50 units. Used for securing or fixing pipes to walls, ceilings, etc., using anchoring systems.

Steel pipe clamp manufactured using a stamping method. It consists of three parts: a strap that encircles the pipe, a sleeve for mounting to ceilings or walls, and a nut that secures the sleeve. The strap, sleeve, and nut are made of zinc-plated steel. It is available in diameters from 1 to 8 inches. It is sold in boxes of 100 units and cases ranging from 10 to 200 units. It is used for securing or fixing pipes to walls, ceilings, etc., using anchoring systems.

Remote-controlled toy made primarily of plastic. It comes with a radio control and is available in three insect forms: grasshopper, fly, and cockroach. Both the insect and the remote control are battery-operated, and each insect is packaged for individual retail sale with its own remote. The insects can move forward, backward, and turn only clockwise, thanks to the wheels on their underside. The remote control operates on a 38 kHz signal and has a three-channel selector, labeled A, B, and C, allowing multiple remotes and toys to be used simultaneously. Each player can be assigned a different channel to avoid interference. Function/Use: Intended for the entertainment of children and adults.

A collectible item of historical interest consisting of a car manufactured in 1970 (over 30 years old). According to the owner's declaration, the vehicle is presented in its strictly original condition, without substantial alterations to the bodywork, passenger compartment, engine bay, wheels, visible mechanical components, chassis number, or overall condition. Function or use: It is used as a collectible item of historical interest. It is not an ordinary used vehicle intended solely for the transport of people or goods, but rather a vehicle with unique characteristics of historical, cultural, and ethnographic interest, derived both from its relevance within the history of the automobile and from the social and cultural phenomenon associated with this model during the second half of the 20th century.

Ground control station for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), presented as a single unit in a carrying case. It comprises: a ruggedized tablet running the ground control software and displaying video and telemetry to the operator; a handheld radio control unit, connected to the tablet via USB, for piloting the UAV; a radio box housing a digital radio transceiver module (1.6 to 2.5 GHz bands, up to 2 W transmission power) on its circuit board, powered by internal rechargeable 18650 batteries or by mains power; radio box antennas in a 2x2 MIMO configuration; and a carrying case that contains and protects the unit. The unit is designed to operate together for the command and control of UAVs. Function or use: According to the applicant's statement, its primary function is the radio control of the UAV and the reception of the video and telemetry it transmits.

A manufactured item, primarily produced by molding, consisting of a cast spheroidal graphite cable guard fork, a stainless steel pin and washer, and a galvanized steel screw and nut. It is roughly U-shaped, with one semicircular end containing a hole and larger than the other, where the screw, nut, etc., are installed. Function or use: According to the applicant, its main function is to connect, protect, support, and withstand the stress concentration within a cable loop and distribute mechanical forces.

Connector parts designed for high-voltage electrical substations (over 1,000 volts). They are manufactured from different materials (aluminum, steel, etc.) and come in various shapes, dimensions, and connector types (terminal-to-cable connector, straight terminal-to-cable connector, etc.) depending on the substation's specifications. Function or use: To complete or replace the part of the connector for which it is intended, always meeting the same standards as the original high-voltage substation connector being replaced and where it will be used.

Stainless steel clamp consisting of a screw held by two solid barrels, which are held together by a plate with three weld points. Its fastening system is based on a hexagonal head screw that, as tightened, closes the clamp upon itself. It has rounded and deburred edges to prevent cuts to pipes and hoses. The clamp body (the two semicircular elements) is stamped. It is available in diameters ranging from 23 mm to 130 mm, with two different product codes, in boxes of 50 units. Function or use: According to the applicant's statement, it is used for joining pipes to prevent the loss of any liquid, and is particularly suitable for agriculture and mining, as well as all types of fluid transport.

A three-dimensional structure formed from cobalt-chromium-nickel alloy wire, obtained through precision forming processes, and intended to constitute the structural framework of an implantable biological heart valve. It is presented finished for direct integration into the heart valve. Its shape, dimensions, and geometry are specifically designed to support and maintain the functional structure of the pericardial leaflets of the prosthetic valve. Function or use: According to the applicant's declaration, it constitutes the structural framework or support structure of an implantable biological pericardial heart valve. It allows for the maintenance of the valve geometry, the support of the pericardial biological tissues, the proper opening and closing of the valve leaflets, and the correct implantation and function of the prosthetic heart.

A ring, with a profile that is neither completely circular nor flat, shaped and welded, manufactured according to specific dimensions for certain sizes of implantable heart valves (27 and 29) to be permanently incorporated into them. It is made from a cobalt-chromium-nickel-molybdenum alloy specially designed for integration into an implantable biological heart valve. Function or use: According to the applicant's declaration, its functions are: to provide structural rigidity to the polyester support of the valve; to stabilize the prosthesis stent; to provide anchor points for multiple assembly sutures; and to contribute to maintaining the geometry and mechanical performance of the device.
The product is a paper infusion bag intended for making a drink, containing rooibos, cocoa, vanilla flavoring and vanilla. One consumer package contains 20 bags (net weight 40 g).
Overpressure valve (safety valve), designed to regulate the air pressure inside a robotic floor vacuum cleaner.

Powdered food preparation, intended for use as a bread improver, based on milk proteins, sunflower oil, dextrose, glucose syrup and thickener, containing less than 5% sucrose or isoglucose, more than 5% glucose or starch or flour and not containing milk fat, packaged for retail sale in 10 kg packs.

Chemical preparation, presented in liquid form, composed of Poria cocos sclerotium extract and propylene glycol, used as raw materials, intended for the industry for the manufacture of cosmetic products, packaged for retail sale in bottles weighing 1kg or less and in 25kg drums.

This lanyard is primarily made of synthetic fiber fabric (polyester) and consists of a flat, elastic webbing with an integrated energy absorber. The absorber is protected by a hinged pouch. This safety device allows for fall protection during movement. It is packaged in cartons of 10 units for import. Length under tension: 1.50 m. Length at rest: approx. 1.20 m. Weight: 1.70 kg. This composite item, a type of cat toy, is shaped like a fishing rod and is made from a plastic shaft, chicken feathers, and several ribbons of woven synthetic fiber (polyester). It is available in various colors and is packaged in batches of 180 units upon import.
A plastic support bracket designed to be attached to a rail inside a suitcase or ambulance. This item is compatible with specific pouches.

A mechanically manufactured garment accessory made of non-stretch knitted synthetic fibers (polyester), in the form of a black neck warmer. According to the manufacturer's specifications, the item contains neither rubber nor elastane. This neck warmer has a fleece lining made of synthetic fibers (polyester). The item is designed to protect the chin area from wind and is packaged in a carrying case.

This 75mm wide ribbon is made of woven synthetic fibers (100% polyester) and is woven on a loom. The product features woven selvedges, a result of the weaving process. It has no coating, adhesive, printing, or embroidery. Intended for decoration and gift wrapping, it comes in a 22-meter roll.
Aluminum handle for butterfly valve intended exclusively for a butterfly valve.

Chemical preparation composed mainly of organic constituents, presented in the form of a blue liquid, intended for the industry for the manufacture of cosmetic products, packaged for retail sale in 1kg to 25kg packaging according to customer demand.

Flat base mounting plate for a metal guardrail intended for the protection of roofs not accessible to the public, primarily on industrial buildings or multi-family dwellings. It takes the form of an ADC12 aluminum alloy fitting with 2 holes drilled in the flat base.

A garment designed to cover the upper body, indistinguishable as either men's or women's, resembling a jacket made of laminated fabric with a plastic coating. A pair of lace-up safety shoes, covering the ankle, not specifically designed for men or women, with a textile upper (water-repellent Oxford fabric) reinforced with plastic (TPU). The outsole is made of rubber. The shoe features a composite toe cap.

A colorless and odorless compressed gaseous mixture composed of krypton and xenon, extracted from atmospheric air using air separation units (mainly oxygen, nitrogen, argon), an intermediate product used to obtain pure krypton and xenon after the removal of impurities and separation of the 2 main constituents for final use in the fields of lighting and electronic applications. Cylindrical backpack made of textile covered with a smooth PVC film visible to the naked eye. The product features attachment loops for accessories, a carrying handle on one side, a drawstring closure, and a PVC cap. Dimensions: 29 x 62 cm; volume: 41 L; maximum load: 25 kg.

Food preparation based on cow's milk and vegetable fat, presented in paste form, containing less than 5% sucrose or isoglucose, less than 5% glucose or starch or flour, not containing milk fat, intended for human consumption, packaged for retail sale in 500g and 200g Tetrapaks.

Diamond core drill on a stand with a built-in 2300W electric motor. The maximum drilling diameter is 180 x 360 mm. The tool is designed for drilling brick, concrete, and stone. Diamond core bits are not included.

This electrodiagnostic device, a 4-in-1 multi-scan health system, features four integrated sensors and is designed for home use. This connected device, equipped with a pressure sensor, is placed under the mattress. It measures movement, respiratory rate, heart rate, and snoring, enabling sleep analysis. A liquid preparation based on a mixture of vegetable oils and essential oils, used for the care of horses' hooves, packaged for retail sale in an iron can with a capacity of 480ml.

A graphite (synthetic graphite) product in the form of a round or rectangular plate designed to distribute heat along a surface to improve the transfer of thermal energy to the ambient air for cooling electronic devices. A threaded article in the form of a captive steel screw comprising a hexagonal head, a machined shoulder, a smooth section, and an M6 thread. Food preparation based on pistachio, cashew nut and almond, presented in the form of an organic spread, packaged for retail sale in a glass jar weighing 200 grams.

Vitamin E derivative based on d-alpha-Tocopherol diluted in glycine soja oil, presented as a clear reddish-brown or amber oil, intended for the manufacture of cosmetic products, packaged for retail sale in 5kg aluminum cans.

A rectangular, giclée-printed image, similar to a woodblock print. Depending on the reference number, the print is either monochrome or polychrome and is produced on high-density technical paper. A textile garment, designed for children 24 months and older, with a body height under 86 cm, in the style of a long-sleeved vest, made primarily of knitted fabric (velvet or sherpa depending on the model) and synthetic fibers (polyester), with a lining and bias binding in woven fabric (double gauze cotton). 19” aluminum extension cord with eight UTE 2-pole + earth 10/16A sockets with shuttered sockets and a 2m H05-VVF 3G1.5² power cable. A corrugated adhesive cable guide is included. There is no switch. The supply voltage is 240V.

This item consists of a twisted textile rope, composed of 45.94% polyester and 19.69% cotton, knotted to form a loop for easy gripping. This bone-shaped dog toy consists of a 100% polyester fabric outer shell filled with 100% polyester wadding. It contains a built-in plastic (PET) squeaker. It is intended solely for the entertainment and play of dogs.
Pre-formed cap visor shell made of plastic material (polyethylene – PE).
Piece of 100% cotton twill fabric, 240 grams / m2, cut but not assembled.
Packaging item, presented in the form of a transparent polyethylene bag, rectangular in shape, intended for packaging various products.
This plush dog toy is made of synthetic fiber fabric (polyester) and is not handmade. Designed for chewing, it is shaped like a reindeer or a biscuit (Mannele), depending on the product code.

This men's jersey-style garment is made of 100% cotton. It features a loose-fitting turtleneck and long sleeves, and has no openings, closures, pockets, hood, or ribbed cuffs and hem. The cuffs and hem are finished with sewn seams. The garment is joined at the shoulders, sleeves, and sides.

Women's garment made of knitted fabric, composed of 60% polyester and 40% cotton. The garment has a relaxed fit, long sleeves, a stand-up collar, a front zipper closure, and ribbed cuffs and hem. It is sewn together from panels of lightweight fleece-type knit fabric. The garment is designed to cover the upper body. Bakery product made from a mixture of vegetables and cheese, in the form of patties, fried, entirely coated in breadcrumbs, containing less than 5% by weight of sucrose, invert sugar or isoglucose, packaged for retail sale in boxes of two pieces.
S-shaped steel hooks, used for hanging various small items, labels, or kitchen utensils. They can be used in the kitchen, bathroom, or shops. They are easy to remove and require no drilling.

Aluminum alloy air intake manifold, produced through casting and machining, designed for exclusive use on spark-ignition internal combustion engines in motor vehicles. This component distributes intake air to the cylinders.
Textile item, of the dog toy type, made of twisted rope of natural fiber textile material (cotton), also including a rubber ball and a polyester plush.

This is a handmade dog toy consisting of a wooden stick to which a playful section made of several textile elements is attached by a metal fastening system. This textile section includes padded shapes and soft straps designed to attract the animal's attention and stimulate its play instinct.

This dog toy consists of a fabric figure and a knotted rope, designed for play and chewing. The head/ball part is made of 100% polyester, and the rope part is made of 100% cotton. The toy is flexible, allowing the dog to grasp, pull, and chew on it.
Food preparation based on wheat bulgur and Roquefort cheese, precooked, presented in the form of a cake to be heated for consumption, packaged for retail sale.

Decorative wallcovering composed of a natural raffia fiber weave, bonded to a cotton textile backing with a polyamide film. These are two decorative, freestanding Christmas tree ornaments in a shimmering gold and white finish, which cannot be sold separately. This item is sold exclusively during the Christmas holiday season. Dimensions: 21 x 10.5 cm; Material: - 90% Polypropylene; - 3% Iron; - 7% Wood.

This item is sold exclusively during the Christmas holiday season. Dimensions: 4 x 16 x 8 cm. Materials: 50% polyester, 5% metal, 15% wood, 30% polyurethane foam (filling).

Hollow aluminum profiles, supplied as a kit, unassembled, for mounting a sliding shower door. The glass panel is not included. The product comes with all necessary mounting hardware and accessories. Hollow aluminum profiles, supplied as a kit, unassembled, used for mounting a pivot shower door. The glass panel is not included. The product comes with all necessary mounting hardware and accessories. The various components are packaged together for retail sale. The pre-packaged kit requires no further assembly or finishing. The device contains electronic circuits for wireless transmission and reception of radio signals and interfaces for connection to other devices. It is equipped with 2 RJ45 connectors for connection to an external control unit and video receiver, RP-SMA antenna connectors for connecting external antennas and an XT60 connector for auxiliary external power supply from the battery. It has a built-in OLED display and a small joystick for adjusting device parameters. The device enables two-way wireless communication and data transfer between the ground control unit and the drone. In the opposite direction, the device receives return telemetry data from the drone and forwards it via cable to the control unit. The device is intended for installation at a remote ground location, for example on a mast or tripod, and is connected to the control unit with a long cable (up to 600 m) that enables signal and power transmission, thus protecting the person operating the drone from being located by radio systems. .

According to information received from the Company, the DHD (Digital High Definition) DIGITAL DECORATING MACHINE is used to create digital prints on ceramic substrates (tiles). The product consists of: - Electronic control and monitoring of the printing cycle phases - A motorized conveyor line for moving the tiles in, towards the printing unit, and out - A color supply unit consisting of a series of color bars of variable number - A digital printing station (printing unit) where the digital print heads apply the ink to the tile. The print heads are controlled by a Personality Card (which can manage up to two print heads) by sending electronic signals - The tile is then evacuated from the conveyor system to be transported to the machine outlet.

According to the information provided by the Company, the DDG DIGITAL DECORATING MACHINE (Digital Graniglia Decorator) is used to create digital prints on ceramic supports (tiles) using granules and consists of: 1) Decorator (main element): Decoration unit using a digital system for applying granules to the surface of the tiles 2) Granule feeder: Device dedicated to feeding granules onto the Decorator (via hoppers or via Big Bag Emptyer).

Pneumatic brake pad kit consisting of steel supports coated with friction material and featuring four guide holes. For assembly in the brake unit of the roll stand of cardboard corrugating machines, where they act as braking elements to control the rotation of the paper reels.

A motor hoe consisting of a horizontal frame on wheels, with a drive train, and a rotary tiller assembly. It is a homogeneous, single, and inseparable mechanical assembly. Plastic container for cosmetic packaging. Plastic cosmetic packaging container (palette). Fixed steel road safety equipment, presented disassembled. Its constituent parts (longitudinal barrier, posts, spacers, bolts, tie rods, and other fastening elements), assembled together and anchored to the ground, are designed to form road safety barriers certified in accordance with the EN 1317 standard. These systems are specifically designed for road safety and are designed to mitigate the effects of vehicle impacts by dissipating energy in a controlled manner, limiting the deceleration transmitted to occupants, and ensuring performance compliant with the requirements of the relevant certification. Each system is designed and certified for specific containment classes, depending on the type of vehicle to be restrained, with differentiated performance in terms of impact resistance and energy absorption capacity. In the event of an impact, the posts undergo controlled plastic deformation, the spacers transfer and modulate the forces generated by the impact, and the longitudinal barrier distributes the energy along the entire system. The products are available in various models, each with specific construction and performance features, but all intended exclusively for the construction of road safety barriers.

Devices designed to project images received via connection to source devices onto an external screen. The light source is laser; the projection system used is DLP (Digital Light Processing). Models come in various sizes. Native resolution: WUXGA (1920 × 1200 pixels). Brightness: up to 6,000 ANSI lumens. Maximum projection size: up to 300 inches on an external screen. Contrast ratio: 3,000,000:1. Video and audio connections: models feature the following input/output ports, in a variable combination depending on the version: two or three HDMI inputs, one or two USB ports, an RS-232C input, and an RJ45 (LAN) connector. Connection can also be made wirelessly via Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, as well as via the AirPlay 2 (mirroring from iOS/macOS devices) and Miracast/WiDi (screen sharing from compatible Android/Windows devices) protocols.

A so-called "turbocharger repair kit" installed in passenger car engines. A door handle with a mechanical lock, designed for installation on the exterior of doors in vehicles such as coaches and delivery vans. A diamond cutting disc consisting of a steel core in the form of a disc, a steel mounting element with an M14 thread, and a cutting segment. This product is designed for installation on an angle grinder for cutting and grinding stone, ceramic, porcelain tiles, concrete, and other hard materials. The disc's working element consists of segments made of agglomerated synthetic diamond grit, which wear out during use – once worn, the disc itself becomes unusable. The disc features grooves and notches that are not cutting teeth. These grooves, among other things, enable more efficient dust and debris removal during cutting, improve cooling of the working part, and reduce the surface area of ​​simultaneous contact between the disc and the workpiece. Dimensions: diameter 125 mm, thickness 2.2 mm, diamond segment height: 10/25 mm. The product is packaged 25 pieces per box.

A plastic (cast nylon) roller, manufactured through a cutting or injection molding process. The product is a grooved wheel with a central mounting hole. Imitation firearms in the shape of various types of machine guns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, submachine guns, and electric shotguns. A concealed frame designed for the installation of wall-hung toilets (WCs). It is constructed from a rectangular steel structural frame made of square profiles. A steel product in the shape of a half-ring, with an elongated hole and a protruding edge at one end, designed to work with a limit switch. Designed for use in the scissor arm assembly of machines such as scissor lifts, this component is mounted on a shaft using mounting screws. Approximate dimensions: 68 x 35 x 33.5 mm. Placed in a storage basket for transport.

NTC thermistor (nonlinear fixed resistor) with a power output of 100 mW and a resistance of 100 kΩ (at 25°C). It consists of a miniature measuring core soldered to the copper wires of a signal cable, with internal insulation separating the wires and an outer protective coating of epoxy resin, thermoplastic, or elastomer, creating a sealed enclosure resistant to the ingress of moisture and gases. Its operating principle is based on the semiconductor effect and involves changes in electrical resistance due to changes in ambient temperature. The thermistor's resistance is not user-adjustable. It does not convert current to a temperature measurement or display it on the display. It is used in devices operating in conditions of high humidity, exposure to water condensation, or direct contact with liquids. Housing dimensions: length: max. 4.2 mm; diameter: max. 2 mm. Lead dimensions: length: 28±1 mm; diameter: 0.5 mm. Packed in plastic bags and then in a cardboard box.

A set of steel interchangeable tools, consisting of 30 screwdriver bits, 8 universal drill bits with a carbide working part, and a magnetic bit holder with a locking system. The set is packaged for retail sale in specially adapted plastic packaging, suitable for long-term use and storing tools in an organized condition. This blue chalk, designed to refill chalk lines, consists of calcium carbonate and dye. The chalk leaves a subtle but clearly visible mark on the marked surface, such as walls, floors, or wooden elements. It is used during construction, renovation, and carpentry work to facilitate the even arrangement of elements. The product is packaged in individual (retail) packaging in the form of a 60-gram plastic container with an applicator for easy refilling, placed in a cardboard blister pack with a hanger. Bulk packaging: 10 boxes containing 10 pieces each, packed in a single shipping carton (100 pieces total).

A positive displacement hydraulic piston pump consisting of a main shaft assembly, a feed pump assembly, a swashplate assembly, an adapter plate, a control valve, a bypass valve, relief valves, a front cover assembly, a rotating cylinder body assembly, an intermediate housing assembly, a cover, an identification plate, seals, o-rings, and bolts. The product converts mechanical energy into hydraulic energy. The drive shaft rotates the cylinder body, and the swashplate converts the rotational motion into the reciprocating motion of the pistons. The piston and cylinder bore form a closed working chamber – as the volume increases, oil is drawn in, and as the volume decreases, oil is forced out and pressurized. The oil distributor plate sequentially connects the high- and low-pressure ports, converting the rotational mechanical energy into hydraulic pressure energy. The pump is used in construction and agricultural machinery equipped with closed hydraulic systems, such as bulldozers, graders, road rollers, tractors, mowers, and aerial work platforms. Product dimensions: length 308.9 mm, width 239.7 mm, height 255 mm; weight: 37.24 kg. Product packaged in foil and 12 pieces per wooden crate. Import country: China.

A colorless liquid with a characteristic odor containing a mixture of pentanes, used to foam PIR and PUR foams used in construction, including the production of sandwich panels and insulation. According to tests, the product meets the parameters of special gasoline. The product is packaged in road tankers, rail tankers, metal drums, and isotonic tanks. This decision replaces binding tariff information no. PL BTI WIT-2023-001406 of October 12, 2023.

Cylindrical sleeves ("frames") are made of Q235 steel, using a closed die forging process. The product is designed for one-time assembly by clamping (creasing) it onto other components, such as a hose connector, a rope, a sling, etc., to maintain the appropriate force, pressure, or distance. After forging, the products are deburred and deburred, as well as electroplated (applied a zinc layer to protect against corrosion) and passivated (giving the products varying colors and sheen, from shiny silver to matte yellow). Some sleeve versions feature external or internal grooves and inspection holes (used to verify that the element inserted into the sleeve is inserted to the proper depth). Depending on the sleeve model, diameters range from 12 mm to 127 mm and lengths range from 30 mm to 110 mm. Packed collectively in cardboard boxes that are stacked on a pallet.

This shelving unit consists of a galvanized steel frame, six MDF shelves, and eight leg rests. Designed for floor placement in a workshop, garage, basement, or warehouse, it can be used to store a variety of items. It can be used as one tall shelving unit or two smaller units. The unit is delivered unassembled (for self-assembly) with assembly instructions. The unit is assembled without screws using push-in hooks. The height of each shelf is adjustable. The metal used to construct the steel frame provides the product's support structure, ensuring stability and durability. Color: silver. Dimensions after assembly (in a single, tall shelving configuration): width: 90 cm, height: 224 cm, depth: 40 cm. Weight: 15.7 kg. Load capacity per shelf: 175 kg. Packaged in a single cardboard box.

This shelving unit consists of a galvanized steel frame, five MDF shelves, and eight leg rests. It's designed for floor placement, e.g., in a workshop, garage, basement, or warehouse, to store a variety of items. It can be used as one tall shelving unit or two smaller units. It's supplied unassembled (for self-assembly) with assembly instructions. The shelving unit is assembled without screws using push-in hooks. The height of each shelf is adjustable. The metal used to construct the steel frame provides the product's support structure, ensuring stability and durability. Color: black. Dimensions after assembly (in a single, tall shelving configuration): width: 90 cm, height: 180 cm, depth: 40 cm. Weight: 10.8 kg. Load capacity per shelf: 175 kg. Packaged in a single cardboard box.

This shelving unit consists of a galvanized steel frame, five MDF shelves, and eight leg rests. It's designed for floor placement, for example, in a workshop, garage, basement, or warehouse, to store a variety of items. It can be used as one tall shelving unit or two smaller units. It's supplied unassembled (for self-assembly) with assembly instructions. The shelving unit is assembled without screws using push-in hooks. The height of each shelf is adjustable. The metal used to construct the steel frame provides the product's essential character, providing stability and durability. Color: silver. Dimensions after assembly (in a single, tall shelving configuration): width: 90 cm, height: 180 cm, depth: 40 cm. Weight: 10.8 kg. Load capacity per shelf: 175 kg. Packaged in a single cardboard box.

This shelving unit consists of a galvanized steel frame, five MDF shelves, and eight leg rests. Designed for floor placement, such as in a workshop, garage, basement, or warehouse, it can be used as a single tall shelving unit or two smaller units. The unit is delivered unassembled (for self-assembly) with assembly instructions. The unit is assembled without screws using push-in hooks. The height of each shelf is adjustable. The metal used to construct the steel frame provides the product's support structure, ensuring stability and durability. Color: silver. Dimensions after assembly (in a single, tall shelving configuration): width: 75 cm, height: 154 cm, depth: 30 cm. Weight: 8.1 kg. Load capacity per shelf: 175 kg. Packaged in a single cardboard box.

Tool container made of plastic (MC nylon). Cuboidal in shape with rounded edges and additional circular recesses on both sides. Designed for storing and setting aside handy tools such as screwdrivers, wrenches, and pliers. It can be attached to devices or objects requiring the storage of items or documents, such as a lift platform, as an additional accessory. One of the longer sides of the product features two holes for securing it to its intended location using screws (not subject to the decision). Dimensions: 560 mm × 150 mm × 120 mm. The product is not individually packaged and is shipped in a plastic container.

A steel scissor lift platform component in the form of a rectangular platform with side walls shaped to act as guides for the mobile platform and projections for mounting safety railings. Ultimately, when assembled with other components—the extendable platform, tubular railing elements, brackets, rollers, hinges, electrical cables, sockets, and electrical installation components (not subject to BTI)—the product will create a complete work platform for a lift designed for transporting and lifting people and goods. The component will be connected to the scissor lifting mechanism with screws and mechanically mounted in slide grooves, enabling the scissor mechanism to raise and lower. The product is presented separately (without other components necessary to create a complete platform). Dimensions: 1370x700x374 mm; weight: 55 kg. Packaged in metal frames. Country of import: China.

A creamy food preparation with a smooth consistency, suitable for spreading, as a filling, or for direct consumption as a snack. The cream is light purple in color and has the scent and flavor of lavender. Ingredients include vegetable oils, milk powder, sweeteners, and lavender flavor. The product is sugar-free. Available in individual packaging (glass jars) with a net weight of 200g or 320g, and in plastic containers (PET) with a net weight of 500g.

Luxury jewelry box. According to the analysis, the exterior surface, visible to the naked eye, is mainly composed (the largest surface area) of textile material. It has a decorative wooden lid. The box structure is made of rigid cardboard. The closure is made with a natural leather strap. The interior of the box is lined with textile material and includes a jewelry cushion. The luxury jewelry box is packaged in a cardboard box with a paper lining. It is used for the storage and presentation of jewelry and watches.

The product is a DDR5 SDRAM RAM memory module for automatic data processing systems (personal computers and workstations). It has a capacity of 32 GB, UDIMM (Unbuffered) type, 2Rx8 configuration (4G x 64 bits), 288-pin DIMM format, 5200 MT/s frequency, based on DRAM integrated circuits mounted on a printed circuit board. The module does not contain a processing unit, does not perform its own data processing and is not a permanent information storage device.

The product is a heatsink made of cast aluminum alloy (AlSi12Cu1 Fe), designed with a special geometry to be mounted inside the handle/housing of an electromechanical tool. The part is dedicated exclusively to the electronic motherboard (tool control module). It comes into direct contact with the power electronic components on the motherboard, taking over the heat generated by them during operation through conduction and dissipating it into the air flow inside the handle. Its role is to prevent overheating and destruction of electronic circuits. The part has cutouts, profiles and fixing points on the motherboard that will be mounted in the internal cavity of the device handle.

The product is a heat sink assembly for a server processor, compatible with HPE ProLiant DL3X0 Gen11, 1U format, used for CPU heat dissipation in standard configurations. It is compatible with processors with TDP up to 185 W. Dimensions: 22.2 × 25.2 × 6.5 cm Weight: 0.43 kg

Steel beams, fitted with profiled and perforated end plates, used in an automated storage and retrieval system of goods type ASRS (Automated Storage and Retrieval System). The goods are presented under three distinct types of parts: main beam, inner beam and connecting beam. These have a structural role, being intended to support and connect the elements of the system, including the running rails and are packed on pallets, in packages of 20 or 40 pieces.

The products are pieces of furniture intended for indoor use, designed to combine the function of sitting with that of storage. They are presented in two constructive variants: stools with a stylized exterior design, with decorative elements suggesting animal shapes, having the approximate dimensions: length 60-95 cm, width 33-35 cm, height 36-37 cm and bench with dimensions: 100 cm x 45 cm x 41 cm - L x w x h. The upholstery is made of textile material (velvet, fleece or synthetic fur). The pieces are equipped with a folding and upholstered upper cover, which serves as a seating surface and provides access to the internal storage compartment. The assembly is supported by rubber wood legs, finished with transparent varnish.

According to the applicant's description and the images uploaded to the database, the product is a stool-type furniture item, presented in two construction variants (diameter 37 cm x height 42 cm and diameter 36 cm x height 45 cm). It has a cylindrical shape and combines the function of sitting with that of storage. The product is upholstered with textile material (velvet). The upper part is provided with a removable, upholstered cover, which serves as a seating surface and provides access to an internal compartment for storage. The stool is supported by a painted metal support, gold in color.

Foil balloon in the shape of a green dinosaur. The foil balloon, measuring 76 x 105 cm, is reportedly made of aluminized plastic foil and is filled with air via an included tube. The product is packaged for retail sale.

Contact rail made of copper-zinc alloy (brass), according to the information intended for installation in safety switches/load switches intended for 16 A. The switch is intended for voltages up to 500 V AC and is rated for 16 A AC-23A. It can also be used for motor loads up to 7.5 kW at 400 V. The contact rail is stamped and bent, approximately 51 mm long and provided with 2 holes with M4x0.7 – 6H. The contact rail's task is to conduct electrical current between the various contact parts of the switch. The rail is mounted with screws and comes into direct contact with these parts to maintain the electrical connection.

Two-wheeled incomplete electric vehicle without steering system, intended for passenger transport. At the time of import, the vehicle lacks an electric drive system (trip computer, control box, torque/PAS sensor, etc.) and pedals. The vehicle is equipped with, among other things, a 250 W electric hub motor, frame, brake system, 36V/11.5 Ah battery and other mechanical parts.

Steel bracket, according to the information, intended for wall mounting a TV set. The product is dimensioned for a TV in the size range of 40-65 inches. Depending on the design, the wall bracket can enable adjustment of the attached screen such as lateral movement, angle and tilt up or down, or hold the device in a fixed and fixed position against the wall. The product consists of stamped, bent and powder-coated steel that is provided with fastening devices and is delivered together with screws and washers in a common package.

Bushing, a vital part of a high-voltage switch, reportedly in the form of a circular end cap with turned internal and external sealing grooves. The part is mounted as an end cap on an oil damper with the function of retaining the oil in the damper by sealing both against the moving piston rod and against the damper cylinder. The item is made of pressure vessel aluminum, with specific dimensional and surface finish requirements and anodized for increased corrosion protection. The item is a necessary part for the function of the switch.

Arm, vital part, reportedly uniquely designed to fit the applicant's high-voltage circuit breaker. The function of the arm is to transfer the mechanical force from the drive shaft (connected to the circuit breaker operating device) to the insulating tie rod that goes up into the circuit breaker and then pulls/pushes the contacts. The part is mounted in the linkage, in the so-called lower mechanism housing. The product is made of pressure vessel aluminum, with specific dimensional and surface finish requirements and anodized for increased corrosion protection. The product is a necessary part for the circuit breaker to function.

Spring bracket in aluminium. A vital part made of aluminium, designed to fit the applicant's high voltage circuit breaker. The item is mounted at the bottom of the disconnect device and acts as a bracket and pressure plate for the spring. The item is a necessary part for the function of the circuit breaker.

Corona ring intended for use exclusively with the applicant's high-voltage circuit breaker. The purpose of the product is to equalize the electric field on the outside of the circuit breaker and prevent flashover. The ring is mounted under the circuit breaker's connection flanges. The corona ring is made of aluminum and consists of one or more pipe fittings. The corona ring is specifically designed as a part of a model of high-voltage circuit breaker. The product is a necessary part for the circuit breaker to function.

Circular flange with turned sealing grooves etc., uniquely designed to fit a specific high voltage circuit breaker. The part is mounted inside the T-breaker support column. The function of the flange is to guide the inward insulating tie rod and to form an interface for the sealing surface. The flange is made of pressure vessel aluminum, with specific dimensional and surface finish requirements and anodized for increased corrosion protection. The part is necessary for the function of the circuit breaker.

Connection flange, part designed to fit the applicant's high-voltage circuit breaker. The flange is mounted on the T-breaker with double switching elements. It constitutes the contact point for electrical connection of the breaker. The product is made of pressure vessel aluminum, with dimensional and surface finish requirements and anodized for increased corrosion protection. The product is a necessary part for the function of the circuit breaker.

Physical exercise equipment in the form of dumbbells. The dumbbells are intended for strength training, shaping and functional exercises in physical training. The dumbbells reportedly have handles made of FSC-certified oak wood and weights made of chrome-plated steel (base metal). The product is available in five different weight classes: • 1 kg with a total length of 156 mm and a diameter of 69 mm. • 2 kg with a total length of 176 mm and a diameter of 79 mm. • 3 kg with a total length of 188 mm and a diameter of 89 mm. • 4 kg with a total length of 196 mm and a diameter of 99 mm. • 5 kg with a total length of 200 mm and a diameter of 109 mm. The training equipment does not have an adjustable load system.

Training equipment in the form of a kettlebell. The equipment is intended for training, swings and functional strength exercises at home, at the gym or in the studio. The kettlebell reportedly has handles made of FSC-certified oak wood and weights made of chrome-plated steel (base metal). The equipment is available in weights of 6 kg, 8 kg and 10 kg. The product does not have an adjustable load system.

Plastic board, reportedly equipped with splice cassettes and intended for installation in ground cabinets. The board measures 84 x 44 x 15 cm and weighs 4.5 kg. The board contains no electronics, is not equipped with connectors for optical fibers and lacks connectors and contact elements for wires and cables.

Plastic Christmas ornament depicting a hot air balloon with Santa Claus, children with Santa hats, fir trees and packages. The hot air balloon is marked with the text "Merry Christmas" and eleven LED lights. The item measures 31.5 x 16 (H x W) cm. The item is intended for indoor use. The LED lighting is powered by three AA batteries (not included) or the included USB cable (1.8 m) and has a timer function. The item is delivered in retail packaging.

Electric lighting item made of plastic in the form of a 180 cm long string of lights with decorative balls and leaves. The string of lights has 20 warm white LEDs. The item is intended for indoor use. The string of lights is powered by three AA batteries (not included) and has a timer function.

Electric lighting item in the form of a grey-lacquered seven-branched Advent candlestick, reportedly made mainly of wood. The candlestick has seven plastic candles that are equipped with replaceable bulbs and black decorative sleeves. The candlestick measures 56 x 56.5 x 13.2 cm (W x H x D) and has a 1.7 m connection cord with a switch. The candlestick is intended for indoor use. The lighting item can be folded in the middle at the top for easy storage. The item is supplied in retail packaging.

Lighting item in the form of a decorative wreath. The lighting item consists of a frame with three wavy gold-colored metal wires, a plastic loop with leaves and a light string with 40 warm white LED lights in a berry-like shape. The light string has a yellow-colored cable between the lights. The wreath has a diameter of 45 cm and a 5 m connection cable with transformer. The item is intended for indoor use. The item is delivered in retail packaging.

Vegan salad, a ready-made meal based on a vegetable mixture in a retail package, plastic container closed with printed aluminum foil, content weight 140 g. Heterogeneous mixture with components that are reasonably solid, not crumbled, with the smell and taste of the raw materials. The product is intended for direct human consumption. The salad is prepared by mixing vegetables (peas, carrots, onions, red pepper, corn) 21.5% with vegan mayonnaise sauce 38.5% and vegan salami cut into pieces 38%.

Cod roll is a food preparation, a ready-made meal in a retail package, plastic packaging marked with a label, content weight 230 g. The goods consist of a baked bakery product, a roll filled with cod exclusive, a prepared product from heat-treated fish meat, vegetables, seasonings and mayonnaise. The proportion of fish meat in the product is 23.49%. In the preparation of the fish filling, Alaskan cod meat (Theragra chalcogramma) is used.

The product is a pencil case for children for school or leisure. The pencil case has three zippers. Each case will have a tag and a piece of foam plastic filling will be inserted in each compartment. Product composition: 3% PVC + 97% polyester, the surface is made of plastic foil. Product dimensions: 21.5*6.5*9.5 cm, color: baby pink, candy, pink, purple, powder. Packing quantity: 4 pcs - 1 pc of each color is packed in one OPP bag + label.

A screen free coding robot for children. Designed to encourage early programming skills in young learners to develop critical thinking and problem solving. The robot features LED lights on the top that show the direction of each step and with a special sensor underneath, draw a bold black line and watch the robot follow it. Set includes coding robot, remote programmer, detachable robot arms, 40 coding cards and a multilingual activity guide includes a variety of activity ideas. Detachable robot arms enable robot to move objects. The robot measures 13cm W x 7cm H x 8.5cm D. and requires 3 AAA batteries (not included). Remote programmer requires 2 AAA batteries (not included). Product is made from plastic. Retail cardboard packaging.

A screen free coding robot for children which encourages critical thinking and problem-solving skills. With a remote programmer to programme a sequence of up to 150 steps in six directions and watch it put on a light show, set it new challenges and unlocking features. The robot eyes light up and can change the colour. Contains one coding robot, remote programmer, two face plates, 40 coding cards, six double-sided boards, 27 obstacle building pieces, and starter guide with coding challenges. Robot measures 13cm W x 7cm H x 8.5cm D. Requires 5 AAA batteries not included. Features multilingual packaging and guide. Product is made from plastic. Retail cardboard packaging.

A screen-free coding toy robot for children to promote critical thinking and problem-solving skills, encouraging learning through play. With a remote programmer which is used to programme a sequence of up to 150 steps in six directions. Robot eyes light up when lights are off. Programme by colour and the robot put on a cool light show and dance to the beat. With hidden features and turn robot into a ghost, police car and more. Navigate obstacles with its advanced object detection function. Contains one robot, remote programmer, two detachable face plates, and 40 coding cards. Robot measures 13cm W x 7cm H x 8.5cm D Requires 5 AAA batteries (3 for robot and 2 for the remote) not included. Features multilingual packaging and guide. Product is made from plastic. Retail packaging made from card.

A screen-free coding toy designed to introduce children to early coding skills through hands-on play. The motorised fox follows black-line paths, allowing children to complete story-based coding challenges using coding tiles and an activity book. The set includes Scrambles the Fox, 16 coding puzzle tiles, a coding activity book, and a multilingual quick-start guide. The tiles measure approximately 7.5 cm × 7.5 cm, while Scrambles measures approximately 7.5 cm (L) × 5 cm (H) × 5 cm (W). The product is made of plastic and is supplied in retail cardboard packaging.
